format.definition:
start: pragma_source | plain_source
pragma_source: PRAGMA_LINE NEWLINE SOURCE
plain_source: SOURCE

PRAGMA_LINE: /[ \t]*\/\/ @exec:[^\r\n]*/
NEWLINE: /\r?\n/
SOURCE: /[\s\S]+/

tools.name: exec

tools.description:
Waits on a yielded `exec` cell and returns new output or completion.
- Use `wait` only after `exec` returns `Script running with cell ID ...`.
- `cell_id` identifies the running `exec` cell to resume.
- `yield_time_ms` controls how long to wait for more output before yielding again. Defaults to 10000 ms.
- `max_tokens` limits how much new output this wait call returns. Defaults to 10000 tokens.
- `terminate: true` stops the running cell; false or omitted waits for output.
- `wait` returns only the new output since the last yield, or the final completion or termination result for that cell.
- If the cell is still running, `wait` may yield again with the same `cell_id`.
- If the cell has already finished, `wait` returns the completed result and closes the cell.
tools.name: wait

cell_id.description: Identifier of the running exec cell.

max_tokens.description: Output token budget for this wait call. Defaults to 10000 tokens.

terminate.description: True stops the running exec cell; false or omitted waits for output.

yield_time_ms.description: Wait before yielding more output. Defaults to 10000 ms.

tools.description: Request user input for one to three short questions and wait for the response. This tool is only available in Plan mode.
tools.name: request_user_input

questions.description: Questions to show the user. Prefer 1 and do not exceed 3

header.description: Short header label shown in the UI (12 or fewer chars).

options.description: Provide 2-3 mutually exclusive choices. Put the recommended option first and suffix its label with "(Recommended)". Do not include an "Other" option in this list; the client will add a free-form "Other" option automatically.

description.description: One short sentence explaining impact/tradeoff if selected.

question.description: Single-sentence prompt shown to the user.

tools.description: Ask the user one or more questions during ongoing work. Use this tool only to request missing information, preferences, constraints, clarification, or approval. The tool returns immediately without ending the turn or waiting for a reply; any reply arrives asynchronously as a new user message. Keep questions concise, self-contained, and easy to understand, using a level of detail appropriate to the user and task. The UI always allows a free-text answer, including when suggested options are provided. A preselected option is not submitted automatically.
tools.name: request_user_input_async

questions.description: One or more self-contained questions to present together, in display order.

options.description: Suggested answers, in display order. Put the recommended answer first; the first option is preselected by default. The user can select one option or enter a free-text answer. Do not include an Other option or a free-text placeholder; the UI provides free-text input automatically. Omit options for a free-text-only question.

title.description: The complete question shown to the user, including any context needed to answer it.

tools.description: Tools for reading and waiting on time.
tools.name: clock

tools.description: Pause execution for a specified duration. The sleep ends early when new input arrives for the active turn. Returns the elapsed wall-clock time.
tools.name: sleep

duration_ms.description: How long to sleep in milliseconds. Must be between 1 and 43200000.

tools.description: Tools for spawning and managing sub-agents.
tools.name: collaboration

tools.description: Send a follow-up task to an existing non-root target agent and trigger a turn if it is idle. If the target is already running, deliver the task promptly at message boundaries while sampling, or after the pending tool call completes.
tools.name: followup_task

message.description: Message text to send to the target agent.

target.description: Agent id or canonical task name to send a follow-up task to (from spawn_agent).

tools.description: Interrupt an agent's current turn, if any, and return its previous status. The agent remains available for messages and follow-up tasks.
tools.name: interrupt_agent

target.description: Agent id or canonical task name to interrupt (from spawn_agent).

tools.description: List live agents in the current root thread tree. Optionally filter by task-path prefix.
tools.name: list_agents

path_prefix.description: Task-path prefix filter without a trailing slash. Omit to list all live agents.

tools.description: Send a message to an existing agent. The message will be delivered promptly. Does not trigger a new turn.
tools.name: send_message

message.description: Message text to queue on the target agent.

target.description: Relative or canonical task name to message (from spawn_agent).

tools.description:
Available model overrides (optional; inherited parent model is preferred):
- `gpt-6.1-sol`: Latest workhorse model for coding and everyday work. Reasoning efforts: low (default), medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra. Service tiers: priority.
- `gpt-6-astra`: Frontier intelligence for the most demanding work. Reasoning efforts: low (default), medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra. Service tiers: priority.
- `gpt-6-sol`: Previous generation workhorse model. Reasoning efforts: low, medium (default), high, xhigh, max, ultra. Service tiers: priority.
- `gpt-6-luna`: Fast and affordable model for easier tasks. Reasoning efforts: low, medium (default), high, xhigh, max. Service tiers: priority.
- `gpt-5.6-sol`: Older generation workhorse model. Reasoning efforts: low (default), medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra. Service tiers: priority.
        Spawns an agent to work on the specified task. If your current task is `/root/task1` and you spawn_agent with task_name "task_3" the agent will have canonical task name `/root/task1/task_3`.
You are then able to refer to this agent as `task_3` or `/root/task1/task_3` interchangeably. However an agent `/root/task2/task_3` would only be able to communicate with this agent via its canonical name `/root/task1/task_3`.
The spawned agent will have the same tools as you and the ability to spawn its own subagents.

It will be able to send you and other running agents messages, and its final answer will be provided to you when it finishes.
The new agent's canonical task name will be provided to it along with the message.

Note that passing `fork_turns="none"` will not pass any surrounding context to the spawned subagent, which may cause the agent to lack the context it needs to complete its task, whereas `fork_turns="all"` will provide the subagent with all surrounding context.
tools.name: spawn_agent

fork_turns.description: Parent history to inherit. Defaults to `all`; use `none` to start without parent history. Only `all` and `none` are supported.

message.description: Initial plain-text task for the new agent.

model.description: Model override for the new agent. Omit unless an explicit override is needed.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort override for the new agent. Omit to inherit the parent effort.

task_name.description: Task name for the new agent. Use lowercase letters, digits, and underscores.

tools.description: Wait for a mailbox update from any live agent, including queued messages and final-status notifications. The wait also ends early when new user input is steered into the active turn. Does not return the content; returns either a summary of which agents have updates (if any), an interruption summary for steered input, or a timeout summary if no activity arrives before the deadline.
tools.name: wait_agent

timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000, min 10000, max 3600000.

tools.description: UI automation through cua_repl using the initialized cua API.
tools.name: mcp__cua_repl

tools.description:

# FORGE v4 — Persistent Router Agent System

FORGE is a self-built, general-purpose autonomous Agent desktop application.

## Engineering status — 2026-11-15

Continued acceptance: the unchanged v12 backend baseline was rerun with 955 tests
passing and the existing TestClient deprecation warning (236.32 seconds). V13 adds
an advisory review-capacity snapshot to the Worker's existing allowance message.
It measures verified settled evidence without generating a delivery, reserving
tokens or changing execution/review state. Running estimates exclude the future
delivery and are neither admission lower nor upper bounds; the complete real
review packet, original 65,536-byte cap, provenance and PASS binding still apply.
No new dependency or startup configuration is required. The prior v12 verification
and its documentation are preserved in `docs/audit/phase2/checkpoint-v12/`.

V14 addresses known model usage settling after a Worker pause or process restart.
Schema 12 stores new local model reservations with their call and assignment
identity. One matching settled Gateway attempt can reconcile only that reservation
once; response handling still requires the original execution fence. Unknown
outcomes retain their reservations, and historical calls without this binding are
not inferred or refunded. No new startup setting or dependency is required.

Phase 2 Agent Intelligence is in progress. The existing native runtime now connects a separate Planner, source-bound constraints and bounded memory, observation-informed team proposals, fresh-context independent review and typed durable Agent coordination. An earlier strict L1 live run passed with review revision and Worker self-repair, without compaction or restart; the concurrent L2 and later L3 attempts failed. Later L2/L3 reruns also failed before review at packet/context and cumulative-budget limits. The [v5 full backend suite](docs/audit/phase2/frozen-tests-v5.xml) passed 820 tests with one warning in 219.96 seconds, before later v6 changes. The [v6 full suite](docs/audit/phase2/frozen-tests-v6.xml) retained 848 passed, one failed, one warning / 283.77 seconds; all three v6 live reruns failed. V7 corrects independent Worker/Gateway concurrency and extends bounded handoff/budget guidance. The [v7 full suite](docs/audit/phase2/frozen-tests-v7.xml) passed 849 tests / one warning / 216.87 seconds, while all three v7 live attempts failed. The [v8 full suite](docs/audit/phase2/frozen-tests-v8.xml) passed 886 tests / one warning / 283.46 seconds; all three v8 live attempts failed, despite real review/revision and Worker archiving in L1/L2. L1/L2 each retain an unresolved Router-notice attempt and no mid-execution Core restart occurred. The v9 full suite passed 895 tests / one warning / 237.83 seconds; both v9 L2/L3 live runs still failed before review at the unchanged raw-packet cap. Thirty-nine finished driver records are published without changing original outcomes. The v10 full suite passed 915 tests / one warning / 279.54 seconds, while all three v10 strict live attempts failed. L2 did demonstrate actual research PASS, a settled mid-execution Core restart with two-source Router archive/readback and preserved counters, followed by architect continuation; the successor later blocked on the original receipt-read bound. Forty-two driver records are now published. V11 passed 941 tests / one warning / 199.39 seconds. Its L1 strict run passed after two real review revisions; L2 advanced through research/analysis revisions, report creation and a preserved restart, then hit final Worker context admission. L3 was blocked by an overly conservative serial-capacity precheck rather than actual Gateway budget exhaustion. V12 frozen testing passed 955 / one warning / 251.43 seconds. Its strict L1 passed after real review revision; L2 retained another restart/readback and real successor artifact but lacked review budget, while revised L3 hit original capacity/budget limits. Fifty driver records are published, including two further failed L2/L3 samples on the same frozen source. The last L3 retained a real research PASS, mid-execution restart/readback and mathematical successor continuation, then failed review-budget admission. Nine recorded unresolved attempts across the historical set are a lower bound; six early records lack usage statistics, so true aggregate usage/cost remain unknown. The final evidence record preserves this partial state and open gates. Phase 2 remains incomplete. The local Provider's small live protocol probes passed [11/11 with the proxy default](docs/audit/phase2/provider-probe.json) and [10/11 with explicit `reasoning_effort=none`](docs/audit/phase2/provider-probe-reasoning-none.json); the latter retained a failed exact-text dialogue check. Focused local/Mock suites and exploratory synthetic benchmarks are recorded separately. See the [Phase 2 report](docs/PHASE2_AGENT_INTELLIGENCE_REPORT.md), [status](docs/PHASE2_STATUS.md), [experiments](docs/PHASE2_EXPERIMENTS.md) and [architecture decision](docs/adr/ADR-009-agent-intelligence-contracts-and-review.md).

Phase 1 Milestones 1–6 provide the persistence, governance, Registry, DAG, native Workers, tool/evidence and context/budget foundation. Historical M6 verification passed 372 tests; one bounded live continuation succeeded after five retained diagnostic failures. The [M7 backend hardening round](docs/PHASE1_MILESTONE7_BACKEND_HARDENING.md) passed 488 local tests. Desktop Alpha, final native integration and packaging are deferred; these historical backend results do not establish a desktop release.

See [current status](docs/STATUS.md), the [Phase 0 audit report](docs/PHASE0_AUDIT.md), and the report's dependency-ordered development plan. The release references `codex/MASTER_PROMPT.md`, but that file is missing from the supplied archive.

**The user has one persistent conversation.** A persistent Router Agent owns that conversation and coordinates multiple long-running Quests and hidden Worker Sessions. Workers have isolated execution contexts, but they are never presented as separate user conversations.

## Product invariants

1. One persistent user-facing conversation per workspace.
2. One persistent Router identity and resumable state per workspace.
3. Multiple durable Quests can run behind that conversation.
4. Worker Sessions are private execution contexts, not user-facing chats.
5. Worker events are selectively relayed into the single conversation timeline.
6. Model Provider, Model Profile, Role Template, Agent Instance, Quest and Session are separate domain entities.
7. Model Registry uses provider metadata, FORGE benchmark results, online performance and explicit user overrides.
8. Team composition combines reusable role templates with bounded dynamic role synthesis.
9. FORGE owns its Agent Loop, Router, Worker Runtime, Tool Engine, Memory, Governance and Evidence.
10. Codex, DSH and Claude Code are architectural references only, never execution backends.

## What this release contains

- Typed Python domain layer and repository interfaces.
- SQLite persistence with schema versioning and transaction boundaries.
- Persistent `main` conversation and Router identity.
- Quest lifecycle state machine and hidden Worker Session records.
- Durable event log with sequence cursor.
- Model Registry and explainable capability-fit team composition baseline.
- Provider gateway and explicit unconfigured provider; Mock protocol tests are labelled.
- FastAPI API with input validation and consistent error handling.
- React single-conversation UI with background Quest panel.
- Automated tests for persistence, lifecycle, router classification and team composition.
- Architecture, threat model, ADRs, detailed roadmap and Codex execution prompts.

## Important maturity statement

This is an engineering foundation with bounded context recovery, sourced lexical recall and evidence-gated execution. The Router uses a configured Provider or explicitly fails. Mock tests, synthetic experiments and real-provider observations are identified separately. The current independent reviewer uses the approved Worker's model in a fresh context. General autonomous replanning, learned semantic retrieval, arbitrary-scale continuity and complex-task correctness remain open. Plan/team/replacement approval stays authenticated and Review mode remains enabled. A proposal record alone never proves execution.

## Backend setup

The model-driven Router requires explicit provider configuration. Set the process environment
variables `FORGE_PROVIDER_ID`, `FORGE_PROVIDER_KIND` (for example `openai_compatible`),
`FORGE_PROVIDER_BASE_URL`, `FORGE_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_REF` (for example
`FORGE_PROVIDER_KEY_EXAMPLE`), `FORGE_ROUTER_MODEL_ID`, and
`FORGE_ROUTER_CONTEXT_LIMIT` (an operator-supplied maximum context window). Put the actual
credential only in the process environment variable named by the credential reference. Set
`FORGE_PROVIDER_SUPPORTS_TOOLS=true` and `FORGE_PROVIDER_SUPPORTS_JSON_SCHEMA=true` only when
the provider supports them. Without configuration the Core starts but Router message calls fail
explicitly; no keyword or mock provider is selected automatically. The optional `request_id`
in a message request allows safe retry: reuse it only for the same input.
For live calls, register an enabled model with the same provider and model ID and explicitly set
both `tool_calling_support` and `structured_output_support` to supported. Unknown capabilities
are rejected. Values submitted through the model API are recorded as user overrides.

Provider timing, Worker ownership and review/output limits use the process environment:

| Variable | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `FORGE_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | Per-attempt timeout in seconds; finite and greater than `0`, at most `600`; defaults to `30`. A timeout does not prove the upstream operation stopped. |
| `FORGE_PROVIDER_MAX_RETRIES` | Additional Gateway retries, integer `0`–`3`; defaults to `1`. Each HTTP attempt requires its own budget admission. |
| `FORGE_WORKER_LEASE_SECONDS` | Worker ownership lease, finite and greater than `0`, at most `600`; defaults to `60`. Valid current owners renew between steps, capped by the task deadline. The local call wait is bounded by the current lease; an upstream operation may remain unresolved after that wait ends. |

## Phase 2: From Agent Infrastructure to Autonomous Intelligence

你现在正式进入 FORGE 的下一阶段开发。

本轮不以桌面端发布为目标，而是以真正跑通自主多智能体系统为目标。

用户已经授权你使用本地配置的 Provider。你可以使用现有 Provider 进行真实模型调用、协议测试、Agent 实验和端到端任务验证。

本轮必须把重心从基础设施转移到 Agent Intelligence。

不要继续大规模开发 UI，不要优先处理安装包和 Tauri 外观问题。

核心任务是让 FORGE 真正成为一个能够长期自主工作的 Agent 系统。

---

# 一、首先重新审计当前代码

当前开发分支：

`codex/phase1-continuous`

先读取：

- docs/STATUS.md
- docs/ROADMAP.md
- docs/QUALITY_GATES.md
- docs/PRODUCT_ARCHITECTURE.md
- docs/ROUTER_AND_WORKER_PROTOCOL.md
- docs/MODEL_REGISTRY_AND_TEAM_COMPOSITION.md
- docs/CONTEXT_MEMORY_GOVERNANCE.md
- 所有 Phase 1 Milestone 报告

重点阅读源码：

- forge_core/router.py
- forge_core/worker_runtime.py
- forge_core/team_composition.py
- forge_core/quest_graph.py
- forge_core/dispatcher.py
- forge_core/context_service.py
- forge_core/memory.py
- forge_core/providers/
- forge_core/tool_engine.py
- forge_core/evidence.py
- forge_core/governance.py

先建立一份真正的 Agent 执行链路图。

区分：
1. 已经真实实现的功能。
2. 通过 Mock 验证的功能。
3. 已经通过真实 Provider 验证的功能。
4. 只有接口或数据模型的功能。
5. 目前无法端到端工作的功能。

不要重新实现已经完成的模块。

不要为了让报告好看而隐藏已有缺陷。

审计完成后直接进入开发，不需要等待用户再次批准。

# 二、本地 Provider：正式启用真实模型

用户已经允许使用本地 Provider。

要求：

1. 检查 FORGE 当前 Provider 配置。
2. 检查本地 Provider 服务是否可用。
3. 获取可用模型列表。
4. 检查模型的 Tool Calling、Structured Output、Streaming 能力。
5. 检查模型实际上下文和输出限制。
6. 检查 Token 预算和并发限制。
7. 运行真实模型的最小对话测试。
8. 运行真实模型的 Router 决策测试。
9. 运行真实 Worker 工具调用测试。

如果本地 Provider 是 OpenAI-compatible 服务，优先使用现有 Adapter。

不要新建一套绕过 Gateway 的 Provider 实现。

安全要求：

- 不要打印 API Key。
- 不要把凭据写入源码、日志、Git 或实验报告。
- 不要读取与 FORGE Provider 配置无关的个人文件。
- 不要修改用户原有 Provider 服务配置。
- 不要自动增加无限 Token 预算。
- 不要将 Mock 响应标记为真实模型结果。

如果某个模型不支持 Tool Calling，应该由 Router 选择兼容模型或采用安全的结构化调用适配方案，不要假设所有模型都具备相同能力。

本地 Provider 可能是代理服务，必须区分：
- FORGE 到本地代理的请求成功。
- 上游真实模型调用成功。
- 模型实际返回正确结果。

三者不能混为一谈。

# 三、核心任务：升级 Persistent Router

当前 Router 已经具备模型驱动决策基础，但还需要进一步增强。

目标：

Router 不应该只是一个分类器，而应该成为一个长期存在的自主 Agent。

## 3.1 Router Agent Loop

实现完整的循环：

Observe
→ Understand
→ Retrieve
→ Reason
→ Decide
→ Act
→ Observe Result
→ Reflect
→ Continue

Router 必须具备：

- 持续理解用户目标。
- 自动关联历史 Quest。
- 判断是否创建新 Quest。
- 判断是否继续现有 Quest。
- 识别用户约束。
- 识别任务优先级。
- 识别阻塞条件。
- 根据执行结果调整计划。
- 主动决定何时请求用户帮助。
- 在适当时机主动汇报进展。

不要把所有推理都写成固定 Prompt。

需要建立结构化决策协议，并对模型输出进行严格校验。

## 3.2 Router 与 Planner 分离

Router 负责：
- 用户意图理解。
- 任务生命周期管理。
- Quest 选择。
- 团队协调。
- 结果汇总。
- 用户交互。

Planner 负责：
- 目标分析。
- 子任务拆解。
- DAG 生成。
- 依赖关系推导。
- 成功标准定义。
- 任务执行顺序优化。

Planner 可以作为后台专用 Agent，但不能取代 Router。

## 3.3 复杂任务识别

支持：
- 普通聊天。
- 单步骤执行。
- 多步骤任务。
- 长期研究任务。
- 软件开发任务。
- 多模态任务。
- 多 Quest 并行任务。

不要为了增加 Agent 数量而把简单问题拆成复杂任务。

简单任务应该直接回答。

复杂任务才启动团队。

# FORGE v4 — Persistent Router Agent System

FORGE is a self-built, general-purpose autonomous Agent desktop application.

## Engineering status — 2026-11-15

V15 acceptance: **1,031 backend tests passed**, one existing TestClient warning,
227.13 seconds. Ruff, 164-file formatting, dependency and whitespace checks passed
on the frozen 167-file source. Its strict live L1/L2/L3 runs all failed: unnecessary
L1 help and an approved concurrency above its scenario cap; insufficient cumulative
L2 review budget; L3 revision followed by review-capacity exhaustion. No current-source
live level is accepted, and neither complex run reached its mid-execution restart.
Phase 2 remains incomplete. See the [current acceptance record](docs/audit/phase2/acceptance-v15.md)
and [verification v15](docs/audit/phase2/verification-v15.json). Earlier-round results
below are historical; all 53 finished driver records are preserved in snapshot-v7.

Continued acceptance: the unchanged v12 backend baseline was rerun with 955 tests
passing and the existing TestClient deprecation warning (236.32 seconds). V13 adds
an advisory review-capacity snapshot to the Worker's existing allowance message.
It measures verified settled evidence without generating a delivery, reserving
tokens or changing execution/review state. Running estimates exclude the future
delivery and are neither admission lower nor upper bounds; the complete real
review packet, original 65,536-byte cap, provenance and PASS binding still apply.
No new dependency or startup configuration is required. The prior v12 verification
and its documentation are preserved in `docs/audit/phase2/checkpoint-v12/`.

V14 addresses known model usage settling after a Worker pause or process restart.
Schema 12 stores new local model reservations with their call and assignment
identity. One matching settled Gateway attempt can reconcile only that reservation
once; response handling still requires the original execution fence. Unknown
outcomes retain their reservations, and historical calls without this binding are
not inferred or refunded. No new startup setting or dependency is required.

Phase 2 Agent Intelligence is in progress. The existing native runtime now connects a separate Planner, source-bound constraints and bounded memory, observation-informed team proposals, fresh-context independent review and typed durable Agent coordination. An earlier strict L1 live run passed with review revision and Worker self-repair, without compaction or restart; the concurrent L2 and later L3 attempts failed. Later L2/L3 reruns also failed before review at packet/context and cumulative-budget limits. The [v5 full backend suite](docs/audit/phase2/frozen-tests-v5.xml) passed 820 tests with one warning in 219.96 seconds, before later v6 changes. The [v6 full suite](docs/audit/phase2/frozen-tests-v6.xml) retained 848 passed, one failed, one warning / 283.77 seconds; all three v6 live reruns failed. V7 corrects independent Worker/Gateway concurrency and extends bounded handoff/budget guidance. The [v7 full suite](docs/audit/phase2/frozen-tests-v7.xml) passed 849 tests / one warning / 216.87 seconds, while all three v7 live attempts failed. The v9 full suite passed 895 tests / one warning / 237.83 seconds; both v9 L2/L3 live runs still failed before review at the unchanged raw-packet cap. Thirty-nine finished driver records are published without changing original outcomes. The v10 full suite passed 915 tests / one warning / 279.54 seconds, while all three v10 strict live attempts failed. L2 did demonstrate actual research PASS, a settled mid-execution Core restart with two-source Router archive/readback and preserved counters, followed by architect continuation; the successor later blocked on the original receipt-read bound. Its L1 strict run passed after two real review revisions; L2 advanced through research/analysis revisions, report creation and a preserved restart, then hit final Worker context admission. L3 was blocked by an overly conservative serial-capacity precheck rather than actual Gateway budget exhaustion. V12 frozen testing passed 955 / one warning / 251.43 seconds. Fifty driver records are published, including two further failed L2/L3 samples on the same frozen source. The final evidence record preserves this partial state and open gates. Phase 2 remains incomplete. The local Provider's small live protocol probes passed [11/11 with the proxy default](docs/audit/phase2/provider-probe.json) and [10/11 with explicit `reasoning_effort=none`](docs/audit/phase2/provider-probe-reasoning-none.json); the latter retained a failed exact-text dialogue check. **The user has one persistent conversation.** A persistent Router Agent owns that conversation and coordinates multiple long-running Quests and hidden Worker Sessions. Workers have isolated execution contexts, but they are never presented as separate user conversations.

## Product invariants

1. One persistent user-facing conversation per workspace.
2. One persistent Router identity and resumable state per workspace.
3. Multiple durable Quests can run behind that conversation.
4. Worker Sessions are private execution contexts, not user-facing chats.
5. Worker events are selectively relayed into the single conversation timeline.
6. Model Provider, Model Profile, Role Template, Agent Instance, Quest and Session are separate domain entities.
7. Model Registry uses provider metadata, FORGE benchmark results, online performance and explicit user overrides.
8. Team composition combines reusable role templates with bounded dynamic role synthesis.
9. FORGE owns its Agent Loop, Router, Worker Runtime, Tool Engine, Memory, Governance and Evidence.
10. Codex, DSH and Claude Code are architectural references only, never execution backends.

## What this release contains

- Typed Python domain layer and repository interfaces.
- SQLite persistence with schema versioning and transaction boundaries.
- Persistent `main` conversation and Router identity.
- Quest lifecycle state machine and hidden Worker Session records.
- Durable event log with sequence cursor.
- Model Registry and explainable capability-fit team composition baseline.
- Provider gateway and explicit unconfigured provider; Mock protocol tests are labelled.
- FastAPI API with input validation and consistent error handling.
- React single-conversation UI with background Quest panel.

# 九、真正跑通复杂任务

本轮必须新增真实端到端实验。

不要只写单元测试。

建立三种任务难度：

## Level 1：简单任务

例如：

“分析这个 Python 项目，指出三个最值得优先修复的问题。”

验证：
- Router 判断。
- Quest 创建。
- 单 Worker 执行。
- 结果回传。

## Level 2：多 Agent 协作

例如：

“调研一个开源 Agent 框架，比较其架构，写一份技术分析报告。”

验证：
- Research Agent。
- Architect Agent。
- Coding/Writer Agent。
- Reviewer Agent。
- Router 汇总。

## Level 3：复杂自主开发

例如：

“研究一个新的 Agent 算法，提出技术方案，实现实验代码，运行实验，并分析结果。”

验证：
- Planner。
- Research Agent。
- Math Agent。
- Architect Agent。
- Coding Agent。
- Experiment Agent。
- Reviewer Agent。

复杂任务必须真实调用 Provider、真实执行工具、真实产生文件。

必须能在中途重启 Core 后继续执行。

## 实验数据

每次实验保存：

- Run ID
- Provider
- Model ID
- Execution Mode
- Model Calls
- Tool Calls
- Token Usage
- Duration
- Retry Count
- Review Results
- Artifact Hashes
- Final Status

真实模型实验与 Mock 实验分开统计。

失败实验必须保留。

---

# 十、算法研究：不要只做工程拼装

FORGE 有三个值得深入的自主研究方向：

1. Capability-Aware Dynamic Team Composition。
2. Evidence-Driven Autonomous Governance。
3. Task-Centric Context Compression。

本轮建立真正可复现的 Benchmark。

重点：

### Team Composition
比较：
- Single Model
- Static Team
- Greedy Selection
- Capability Coverage
- Complementarity
- Dynamic Recomposition

### Context Compression
比较：
- Full Context
- Recency Truncation
- Conventional Summary
- Task-Centric Compression
- Task-Centric Compression + Source Recall

### Agent Governance
比较：
- Model Claim Only
- Tool Receipt Verification
- Independent Reviewer
- Evidence-Gated Completion

至少建立多个不同难度和领域的任务。

使用固定测试集、统一预算和独立评分。

报告成功率、成本、延迟、Token、返工次数和证据完整率。

小样本结果必须明确标记为探索性实验，不允许夸大统计结论。

---

# 十一、本轮明确不做的事情

暂时不投入主要开发资源于：

- UI 视觉重构。
- Tauri 安装包优化。
- NSIS 发布。
- 动画效果。
- 桌面端页面扩展。
- 非必要的数据库重构。

现有桌面端保持可用即可。

如果发现会阻塞 Agent 运行的底层缺陷，可以修复，但不要将桌面测试变成主线。

---

# 十二、执行顺序

请连续执行以下阶段，不需要每个阶段都等待用户确认：

Sprint A：Provider 和 Agent Loop 深度审计及真实调用。

Sprint B：Persistent Router + Planner 智能化。

Sprint C：Dynamic Team Intelligence。

Sprint D：Native Worker 自主执行与自我修正。

Sprint E：Independent Reviewer 与返工闭环。

Sprint F：Context Compaction + Long-term Memory。

Sprint G：Agent Communication Protocol + 故障恢复。

Sprint H：真实复杂任务端到端验收。

Sprint I：三项核心算法 Benchmark 与消融实验。

每个阶段必须有独立测试和可复现报告。

如果发现现有架构不支持目标，应先提出最小必要架构调整，并通过 ADR 记录，不要推倒重写。

---

# 十三、工程约束

1. 保持一个长期用户对话入口。
2. Router 是唯一面向用户的 Agent。
3. Worker 是真正的后台执行 Agent。
4. 不允许通过创建多个用户 Conversation 规避上下文问题。
5. 不允许把 Codex、DSH 或 Claude Code 当作执行后端。
6. 不允许使用伪造的执行记录。
7. 不允许把 Mock 结果标记为 Live。
8. 不允许绕过 Approval、Policy 和 Evidence。
9. 不允许无限 Agent 派生。
10. 不允许无限重试。
11. 不允许无预算模型调用。
12. 保留历史测试和审计证据。
13. 不自动推送或合并 GitHub。
14. 不删除用户原有数据和实验记录。

可以使用多个 Codex 子任务并行分析和实现，但必须指定唯一集成负责人，避免多人同时修改相同核心文件。

---

# 十四、最终交付标准

最终必须让 FORGE 能够：

1. 长期与用户保持同一个对话。
2. 理解用户复杂目标。
3. 自动生成 Quest。
4. 自动规划 DAG。
5. 从模型库选择模型。

7. 后台并行执行任务。
8. Agent 之间结构化协作。

11. 不合格任务自动返工。
12. 上下文压缩后恢复工作。
13. 长期记忆跨任务复用。
14. Core 重启后继续执行。
15. 所有成果具备可信证据。

最终报告必须明确区分真实模型验证、Mock 验证、合成实验和未完成项目。

# Capacity design notes for v13

This is a read-only diagnosis of retained v12 failures. Planner preflight is **not implemented**. The current implementation scope remains a separately reviewed capacity preview; no budget or approval is expanded. Numeric observations and limitations are retained in `capacity-design-v13.json`.

| Observation | L2 draft report | L3 research |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Complete canonical packet bytes | 54,421 | 68,149 |
| Existing projected messages, placeholder system only | 51,017 | 65,302 |
| Complete receipt field | 23,997 | 34,631 |
| Artifact canonical content | 12,461 | 12,329 |
| Structured delivery | 4,038 | 6,953 |
| Constraints before / after existing projection | 7,998 / 2,997 | 7,725 / 2,991 |
| Ideal saving from repeated long string leaves | 406 | 532 |
| Remaining node allowance at failure | 37,061 | 40,238 |

The measured raw packet hashes remain `29cb5b35d1ac9f431064d9ffa137d92aa8c0717edebf51690725207f411f3575` for L2 and `f6d0fd266015410da021b87f4e9e8d9c91c005a3aef626e12b011ee29f15005a` for L3. These observations preserve every packet field. Historical review/PASS binding must continue to hash the original packet, even if a lossless wire representation changes.

Existing constraint projection already saves about 5 KiB. The original goal is distinct text and is not a substring of the original request. The artifact and delivery repeat conclusions semantically, but no measured delivery string of at least 64 bytes appears exactly or as a substring in its artifact. Omitting either would change the content. Exact path/hash deduplication yields only the small upper bounds above, before reference overhead. The L3 raw-packet cap also rejects before wire projection.

L2 allocated 130k/90k/90k under a 360k global cap, leaving 50k for coordination. The source node used 39,869 reported tokens including review. The draft node had a fixed JSON check but no fresh model review, then emitted `review_contract_or_budget_failed`. Its local 52,939 counter exceeds its 37,510 reported Worker usage by 15,429; this report does not establish the cause or infer an unsettled Gateway attempt.

L3 allocated 120k/55k/50k/110k/90k/85k/65k under 630k, leaving 55k. Research consumed 79,762 tokens including one genuine `NEEDS_REVISION` review. After its revised delivery, the fixed review-input floor was 48,956, exceeding the remaining 40,238 even before revision-receipt and verdict allowances. It therefore did not enter a capacity revision.

The minimum useful future Planner preflight needs a structured `required_input_paths` node contract and a verified input inventory. Current Planner input contains filenames as text, with no actual byte snapshot. Read only explicitly supplied local paths under existing governance bounds; verify actual bytes/hash rather than trusting manifest claims or the larger repository `source_bytes` associated with excerpts. New plans can then bind each node to original inputs or declared predecessor artifacts without guessing roles from objective prose.

Calculate a documented admission envelope from the same serialized inputs, source receipts, Provider framing and output contracts used at runtime. Include a complete Worker request, a fresh review and one bounded correction/review cycle where the contract permits correction. This is a reserve policy, not proof of future model usage. Unknown artifact sizes remain unknown. Reject an impossible envelope through the existing bounded Planner repair, preserving the original total cap and required specializations. Recheck with the Composer's actual selected model and contract.

The global check must include already charged calls, opening usage and unresolved reservations in every applicable Gateway scope. Declared node budgets plus an explicit coordination reserve must fit that residual allowance; a preview cannot refund calls or authorize spending. A new artifact-writing contract may put full conclusions in the artifact and keep the delivery concise with exact artifact/receipt references. It must preserve every assigned requirement and use the normal approval path.

Meaningful tests cover actual Unicode/escaping cost, manifest tampering and path bounds, an underfunded node with a valid global sum, one bounded repair within the same cap, unknown future output size, a later smaller model window, concurrent unresolved reservations, and unchanged legacy/manual contracts and historical packet hashes. No source or runtime state was changed for this analysis.

The subsequent shared-collector/preview refactor was checked against both retained failures using SQLite `mode=ro` and `BEGIN`. # FORGE — Agent Intelligence Sprint
## Phase 2: From Agent Infrastructure to Autonomous Intelligence

你现在正式进入 FORGE 的下一阶段开发。

本轮不以桌面端发布为目标，而是以真正跑通自主多智能体系统为目标。

用户已经授权你使用本地配置的 Provider。你可以使用现有 Provider 进行真实模型调用、协议测试、Agent 实验和端到端任务验证。

本轮必须把重心从基础设施转移到 Agent Intelligence。

不要继续大规模开发 UI，不要优先处理安装包和 Tauri 外观问题。

核心任务是让 FORGE 真正成为一个能够长期自主工作的 Agent 系统。

---

# 一、首先重新审计当前代码

当前开发分支：

`codex/phase1-continuous`

先读取：

- docs/STATUS.md
- docs/ROADMAP.md
- docs/QUALITY_GATES.md
- docs/PRODUCT_ARCHITECTURE.md
- docs/ROUTER_AND_WORKER_PROTOCOL.md
- docs/MODEL_REGISTRY_AND_TEAM_COMPOSITION.md
- docs/CONTEXT_MEMORY_GOVERNANCE.md
- 所有 Phase 1 Milestone 报告

重点阅读源码：

- forge_core/router.py
- forge_core/worker_runtime.py
- forge_core/team_composition.py
- forge_core/quest_graph.py
- forge_core/dispatcher.py
- forge_core/context_service.py
- forge_core/memory.py
- forge_core/providers/
- forge_core/tool_engine.py
- forge_core/evidence.py
- forge_core/governance.py

先建立一份真正的 Agent 执行链路图。

区分：
1. 已经真实实现的功能。
2. 通过 Mock 验证的功能。
3. 已经通过真实 Provider 验证的功能。
4. 只有接口或数据模型的功能。
5. 目前无法端到端工作的功能。

不要重新实现已经完成的模块。

不要为了让报告好看而隐藏已有缺陷。

审计完成后直接进入开发，不需要等待用户再次批准。

# 二、本地 Provider：正式启用真实模型

用户已经允许使用本地 Provider。

要求：

1. 检查 FORGE 当前 Provider 配置。
2. 检查本地 Provider 服务是否可用。
3. 获取可用模型列表。
4. 检查模型的 Tool Calling、Structured Output、Streaming 能力。
5. 检查模型实际上下文和输出限制。
6. 检查 Token 预算和并发限制。
7. 运行真实模型的最小对话测试。
8. 运行真实模型的 Router 决策测试。
9. 运行真实 Worker 工具调用测试。

如果本地 Provider 是 OpenAI-compatible 服务，优先使用现有 Adapter。

不要新建一套绕过 Gateway 的 Provider 实现。

安全要求：

- 不要打印 API Key。
- 不要把凭据写入源码、日志、Git 或实验报告。
- 不要读取与 FORGE Provider 配置无关的个人文件。
- 不要修改用户原有 Provider 服务配置。
- 不要自动增加无限 Token 预算。
- 不要将 Mock 响应标记为真实模型结果。

如果某个模型不支持 Tool Calling，应该由 Router 选择兼容模型或采用安全的结构化调用适配方案，不要假设所有模型都具备相同能力。

本地 Provider 可能是代理服务，必须区分：
- FORGE 到本地代理的请求成功。
- 上游真实模型调用成功。
- 模型实际返回正确结果。

三者不能混为一谈。

# 三、核心任务：升级 Persistent Router

当前 Router 已经具备模型驱动决策基础，但还需要进一步增强。

目标：

Router 不应该只是一个分类器，而应该成为一个长期存在的自主 Agent。

## 3.1 Router Agent Loop

实现完整的循环：

Observe
→ Understand
→ Retrieve
→ Reason
→ Decide
→ Act
→ Observe Result
→ Reflect
→ Continue

Router 必须具备：

- 持续理解用户目标。
- 自动关联历史 Quest。
- 判断是否创建新 Quest。
- 判断是否继续现有 Quest。
- 识别用户约束。
- 识别任务优先级。
- 识别阻塞条件。
- 根据执行结果调整计划。
- 主动决定何时请求用户帮助。
- 在适当时机主动汇报进展。

不要把所有推理都写成固定 Prompt。

需要建立结构化决策协议，并对模型输出进行严格校验。

## 3.2 Router 与 Planner 分离

Router 负责：
- 用户意图理解。
- 任务生命周期管理。
- Quest 选择。
- 团队协调。
- 结果汇总。
- 用户交互。

Planner 负责：
- 目标分析。
- 子任务拆解。
- DAG 生成。
- 依赖关系推导。
- 成功标准定义。
- 任务执行顺序优化。

Planner 可以作为后台专用 Agent，但不能取代 Router。

## 3.3 复杂任务识别

支持：
- 普通聊天。
- 单步骤执行。
- 多步骤任务。
- 长期研究任务。
- 软件开发任务。
- 多模态任务。
- 多 Quest 并行任务。

不要为了增加 Agent 数量而把简单问题拆成复杂任务。

简单任务应该直接回答。

复杂任务才启动团队。

---

# 四、Dynamic Team Intelligence

这是 FORGE 最重要的创新方向之一。

目前已经具备模型注册、角色合同和基础组队算法。

接下来需要让团队真正根据任务需求动态形成。

## 4.1 Model Intelligence

完善模型画像：

- Coding
- Mathematics
- Research
- Architecture
- Planning
- Design
- Vision
- Writing
- Tool Calling
- Instruction Following

增加实际线上表现：

- Task Success Rate
- Tool Call Success Rate
- Retry Rate
- Schema Compliance
- Average Latency
- P95 Latency
- Token Consumption
- Cost
- Review Pass Rate

注意：

能力评分必须有来源、样本数、测试时间和置信度。

真实数据与用户手动评分分开保存。

不能把一次成功调用直接当成模型能力评分。

## 4.2 Dynamic Team Composer

Router 将 Quest 交给 Composer。

Composer 根据：

- Task Requirements
- Model Capabilities
- Model Reliability
- Tool Compatibility
- Token Budget
- Time Budget
- Coordination Overhead

选择团队。

支持：

- Single Agent
- Sequential Team
- Parallel Team
- Hierarchical Team
- Specialist Team
- Dynamic Expansion

要求模型与角色彻底解耦。

一个模型可以承担多个角色，一个角色也可以根据任务动态切换模型。

## 4.3 团队自适应

执行过程中：

- Worker 可以请求帮助。
- Router 可以增加专家。
- Router 可以替换表现不佳的模型。
- Router 可以重新分配未完成节点。
- Reviewer 可以要求返工。
- Planner 可以重新规划剩余 DAG。

但已完成节点、历史证据和已执行的外部动作不能因为重组而丢失。

团队规模、派生深度、预算和重试次数必须有界。

---

# 五、真正的 Native Worker Agent Loop

不要只把 Worker 当作任务执行函数。

Worker 必须拥有自己的推理循环和工作上下文。

完整过程：

接收任务
→ 理解任务合同
→ 检索必要上下文
→ 选择工具
→ 请求模型
→ 执行工具
→ 读取结果
→ 判断是否完成
→ 必要时修正
→ 输出结构化结果
→ 提交证据
→ 通知 Router

## 5.1 Worker 类型

完善以下角色：

Research Agent：
- 检索资料。
- 整理来源。
- 分析相关工作。
- 提供研究结论。

Math Agent：
- 数学推导。
- 公式验证。
- 数值计算。
- 检查推理漏洞。

Architect Agent：
- 设计系统架构。
- 定义接口。
- 分析依赖。
- 检查技术风险。

Coding Agent：
- 阅读代码。
- 编写代码。
- 修改代码。
- 运行测试。
- 修复错误。

Experiment Agent：
- 设计实验。
- 执行实验。
- 记录结果。
- 生成可复现报告。

Reviewer Agent：
- 检查成果。
- 对照成功标准。
- 检查证据。
- 给出通过或返工决定。

Planner Agent：
- 拆解任务。
- 更新 DAG。
- 管理依赖。
- 处理失败后的重新规划。

## 5.2 Worker 自我修正

Worker 不能遇到错误就直接失败。

应该能够：

1. 读取错误信息。
2. 判断错误类型。
3. 分析可能原因。
4. 选择修复策略。
5. 再次执行。
6. 对比修复前后的结果。
7. 判断是否需要求助。

区分：
- 代码错误。
- 工具错误。
- Provider 错误。
- 任务理解错误。
- 预算耗尽。
- 依赖阻塞。
- 外部资源不可用。

不同错误采用不同恢复策略。

禁止无限循环。

## 5.3 Worker 交付协议

每个 Worker 必须提交：

- Summary
- Findings
- Decisions
- Artifacts
- Evidence References
- Unresolved Issues
- Confidence
- Next Actions

不能只返回一段自由文本。

---

# 六、Reviewer：建立真正的独立审查机制

Reviewer 不应该只是让另一个模型重新总结一次结果。

它必须检查：

1. 是否完成原始目标。
2. 是否满足成功标准。
3. 是否存在未经验证的假设。
4. 产物是否真实存在。
5. 产物是否与执行记录对应。
6. 测试是否真实运行。
7. 是否存在逻辑错误。
8. 是否存在明显遗漏。
9. 是否存在安全问题。

Reviewer 应当拥有独立的上下文。

不要将 Coding Agent 的全部内部推理直接复制给 Reviewer。

Reviewer 应获得：
- 原始任务合同。
- 成功标准。
- 实际产物。
- 可信工具回执。
- 必要的研究来源。
- 测试结果。

审查结果：

PASS
NEEDS_REVISION
REJECT
BLOCKED

NEEDS_REVISION 必须能够创建有明确修改目标的返工任务。

设置最大审查轮次。

Reviewer 不能通过模型自述或 Mock 证据判定成功。

---

# 七、Context Compaction 与 Memory 深度增强

目前 M6 已经实现了有界 Context Archive、Recall 和预算管理。

但长期单一对话仍然有容量边界。

本轮重点解决这个问题。

## 7.1 Task-Centric Compaction

不要简单按时间截断历史。

采用多层上下文：

L0：Recent Interaction
L1：Active Quest Context
L2：Project Memory
L3：Long-term Experience

保留：
- 原始用户目标。
- 用户明确约束。
- 重要决策。
- 已完成节点。
- 当前阻塞。
- 产物路径。
- 证据来源。
- 失败经验。
- 后续行动。

每个压缩摘要必须保留来源引用。

压缩后必须能恢复到原始证据。

## 7.2 解决历史消息无限增长

不要为了保存所有用户约束而无限注入原始消息。

建立约束抽取和引用机制：

- 将用户约束单独索引。
- 保留原始消息 ID。
- 生成有来源的结构化 Constraint Record。
- 检测约束冲突。
- 检测约束是否过期。
- 必要时重新读取原始消息。

模型抽取出的约束先标记为待验证。

用户明确确认的约束与模型推测严格区分。

## 7.3 Memory Retrieval

改进 Recall：

- 语义检索。
- 关键词检索。
- Quest 关联检索。
- 时间检索。
- 来源可靠性过滤。
- 冲突检测。
- 过期过滤。

建立 Retrieval Evaluation Dataset。

测试 Router 是否能准确找到历史 Quest、决策、文件和用户约束。

不要只根据摘要文本相似度判断召回成功。

---

# 八、Agent 之间的协作机制

建立正式的 Agent Communication Protocol。

不允许把自由文本群聊作为主要协调机制。

支持：

TASK_ASSIGNMENT
TASK_ACCEPTED
TASK_COMPLETED
HELP_REQUEST
REVIEW_REQUEST
REVISION_REQUEST
DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED
MODEL_UNAVAILABLE
BUDGET_WARNING
AGENT_FAILED

重要消息持久化。

Router 负责协调。

Worker 不能绕过 Router 自行修改其他 Worker 的任务。

对于跨 Worker 共享的产物，必须通过有权限的 Artifact 和 Receipt 接口访问。

---

# 九、真正跑通复杂任务

本轮必须新增真实端到端实验。

不要只写单元测试。

建立三种任务难度：

## Level 1：简单任务

例如：

“分析这个 Python 项目，指出三个最值得优先修复的问题。”

验证：
- Router 判断。
- Quest 创建。
- 单 Worker 执行。
- 结果回传。

## Level 2：多 Agent 协作

例如：

“调研一个开源 Agent 框架，比较其架构，写一份技术分析报告。”

验证：
- Research Agent。
- Architect Agent。
- Coding/Writer Agent。
- Reviewer Agent。
- Router 汇总。

## Level 3：复杂自主开发

例如：

“研究一个新的 Agent 算法，提出技术方案，实现实验代码，运行实验，并分析结果。”

验证：
- Planner。
- Research Agent。
- Math Agent。
- Architect Agent。
- Coding Agent。
- Experiment Agent。
- Reviewer Agent。

复杂任务必须真实调用 Provider、真实执行工具、真实产生文件。

必须能在中途重启 Core 后继续执行。

## 实验数据

每次实验保存：

- Run ID
- Provider
- Model ID
- Execution Mode
- Model Calls
- Tool Calls
- Token Usage
- Duration
- Retry Count
- Review Results
- Artifact Hashes
- Final Status

真实模型实验与 Mock 实验分开统计。

失败实验必须保留。

---

# 十、算法研究：不要只做工程拼装

FORGE 有三个值得深入的自主研究方向：

1. Capability-Aware Dynamic Team Composition。
2. Evidence-Driven Autonomous Governance。
3. Task-Centric Context Compression。

本轮建立真正可复现的 Benchmark。

重点：

### Team Composition
比较：
- Single Model
- Static Team
- Greedy Selection
- Capability Coverage
- Complementarity
- Dynamic Recomposition

### Context Compression
比较：
- Full Context
- Recency Truncation
- Conventional Summary
- Task-Centric Compression
- Task-Centric Compression + Source Recall

### Agent Governance
比较：
- Model Claim Only
- Tool Receipt Verification
- Independent Reviewer
- Evidence-Gated Completion

至少建立多个不同难度和领域的任务。

使用固定测试集、统一预算和独立评分。

报告成功率、成本、延迟、Token、返工次数和证据完整率。

小样本结果必须明确标记为探索性实验，不允许夸大统计结论。

---

# 十一、本轮明确不做的事情

暂时不投入主要开发资源于：

- UI 视觉重构。
- Tauri 安装包优化。
- NSIS 发布。
- 动画效果。
- 桌面端页面扩展。
- 非必要的数据库重构。

现有桌面端保持可用即可。

如果发现会阻塞 Agent 运行的底层缺陷，可以修复，但不要将桌面测试变成主线。

---

# 十二、执行顺序

请连续执行以下阶段，不需要每个阶段都等待用户确认：

Sprint A：Provider 和 Agent Loop 深度审计及真实调用。

Sprint B：Persistent Router + Planner 智能化。

Sprint C：Dynamic Team Intelligence。

Sprint D：Native Worker 自主执行与自我修正。

Sprint F：Context Compaction + Long-term Memory。

Sprint G：Agent Communication Protocol + 故障恢复。

Sprint H：真实复杂任务端到端验收。

Sprint I：三项核心算法 Benchmark 与消融实验。

每个阶段必须有独立测试和可复现报告。

如果发现现有架构不支持目标，应先提出最小必要架构调整，并通过 ADR 记录，不要推倒重写。

---

1. 保持一个长期用户对话入口。
2. Router 是唯一面向用户的 Agent。
3. Worker 是真正的后台执行 Agent。
4. 不允许通过创建多个用户 Conversation 规避上下文问题。

6. 不允许使用伪造的执行记录。
7. 不允许把 Mock 结果标记为 Live。
8. 不允许绕过 Approval、Policy 和 Evidence。
9. 不允许无限 Agent 派生。
10. 不允许无限重试。
11. 不允许无预算模型调用。
12. 保留历史测试和审计证据。
13. 不自动推送或合并 GitHub。
14. 不删除用户原有数据和实验记录。

可以使用多个 Codex 子任务并行分析和实现，但必须指定唯一集成负责人，避免多人同时修改相同核心文件。

# 十四、最终交付标准

最终必须让 FORGE 能够：

1. 长期与用户保持同一个对话。

14. Core 重启后继续执行。
15. 所有成果具备可信证据。

如果本地 Provider 是 OpenAI-compatible 服务，优先使用现有 Adapter。

不要新建一套绕过 Gateway 的 Provider 实现。

安全要求：

- 不要打印 API Key。
- 不要把凭据写入源码、日志、Git 或实验报告。
- 不要读取与 FORGE Provider 配置无关的个人文件。

# 三、核心任务：升级 Persistent Router

当前 Router 已经具备模型驱动决策基础，但还需要进一步增强。

目标：

Router 不应该只是一个分类器，而应该成为一个长期存在的自主 Agent。

## 3.1 Router Agent Loop

实现完整的循环：

Observe
→ Understand
→ Retrieve
→ Reason
→ Decide
→ Act
→ Observe Result
→ Reflect
→ Continue

Router 必须具备：

- 持续理解用户目标。
- 自动关联历史 Quest。
- 判断是否创建新 Quest。
- 判断是否继续现有 Quest。
- 识别用户约束。
- 识别任务优先级。
- 识别阻塞条件。
- 根据执行结果调整计划。
- 主动决定何时请求用户帮助。
- 在适当时机主动汇报进展。

不要把所有推理都写成固定 Prompt。

需要建立结构化决策协议，并对模型输出进行严格校验。

## 3.2 Router 与 Planner 分离

Router 负责：
- 用户意图理解。
- 任务生命周期管理。
- Quest 选择。
- 团队协调。
- 结果汇总。
- 用户交互。

Planner 负责：
- 目标分析。
- 子任务拆解。
- DAG 生成。
- 依赖关系推导。
- 成功标准定义。
- 任务执行顺序优化。

Planner 可以作为后台专用 Agent，但不能取代 Router。

## 3.3 复杂任务识别

支持：
- 普通聊天。
- 单步骤执行。
- 多步骤任务。
- 长期研究任务。
- 软件开发任务。
- 多模态任务。
- 多 Quest 并行任务。

不要为了增加 Agent 数量而把简单问题拆成复杂任务。

简单任务应该直接回答。

复杂任务才启动团队。

---

# 四、Dynamic Team Intelligence

这是 FORGE 最重要的创新方向之一。

目前已经具备模型注册、角色合同和基础组队算法。

接下来需要让团队真正根据任务需求动态形成。

## 4.1 Model Intelligence

完善模型画像：

- Coding
- Mathematics
- Research
- Architecture
- Planning
- Design
- Vision
- Writing
- Tool Calling
- Instruction Following

增加实际线上表现：

- Task Success Rate
- Tool Call Success Rate
- Retry Rate
- Schema Compliance
- Average Latency
- P95 Latency
- Token Consumption
- Cost
- Review Pass Rate

注意：

能力评分必须有来源、样本数、测试时间和置信度。

真实数据与用户手动评分分开保存。

不能把一次成功调用直接当成模型能力评分。

## 4.2 Dynamic Team Composer

Router 将 Quest 交给 Composer。

Composer 根据：

- Task Requirements
- Model Capabilities
- Model Reliability
- Tool Compatibility
- Token Budget
- Time Budget
- Coordination Overhead

选择团队。

支持：

- Single Agent
- Sequential Team
- Parallel Team
- Hierarchical Team
- Specialist Team
- Dynamic Expansion

要求模型与角色彻底解耦。

一个模型可以承担多个角色，一个角色也可以根据任务动态切换模型。

## 4.3 团队自适应

执行过程中：

- Worker 可以请求帮助。
- Router 可以增加专家。
- Router 可以替换表现不佳的模型。
- Router 可以重新分配未完成节点。
- Reviewer 可以要求返工。
- Planner 可以重新规划剩余 DAG。

但已完成节点、历史证据和已执行的外部动作不能因为重组而丢失。

团队规模、派生深度、预算和重试次数必须有界。

---

# 五、真正的 Native Worker Agent Loop

不要只把 Worker 当作任务执行函数。

Worker 必须拥有自己的推理循环和工作上下文。

完整过程：

接收任务
→ 理解任务合同
→ 检索必要上下文
→ 选择工具
→ 请求模型
→ 执行工具
→ 读取结果
→ 判断是否完成
→ 必要时修正
→ 输出结构化结果
→ 提交证据
→ 通知 Router

## 5.1 Worker 类型

完善以下角色：

Research Agent：
- 检索资料。
- 整理来源。
- 分析相关工作。
- 提供研究结论。

Math Agent：
- 数学推导。
- 公式验证。
- 数值计算。
- 检查推理漏洞。

Architect Agent：
- 设计系统架构。
- 定义接口。
- 分析依赖。
- 检查技术风险。

Coding Agent：
- 阅读代码。
- 编写代码。
- 修改代码。
- 运行测试。
- 修复错误。

Experiment Agent：
- 设计实验。
- 执行实验。
- 记录结果。
- 生成可复现报告。

Reviewer Agent：
- 检查成果。
- 对照成功标准。
- 检查证据。
- 给出通过或返工决定。

Planner Agent：
- 拆解任务。
- 更新 DAG。
- 管理依赖。
- 处理失败后的重新规划。

## 5.2 Worker 自我修正

Worker 不能遇到错误就直接失败。

应该能够：

1. 读取错误信息。
2. 判断错误类型。
3. 分析可能原因。
4. 选择修复策略。
5. 再次执行。
6. 对比修复前后的结果。
7. 判断是否需要求助。

区分：
- 代码错误。
- 工具错误。
- Provider 错误。
- 任务理解错误。
- 预算耗尽。
- 依赖阻塞。
- 外部资源不可用。

不同错误采用不同恢复策略。

禁止无限循环。

## 5.3 Worker 交付协议

每个 Worker 必须提交：

- Summary
- Findings
- Decisions
- Artifacts
- Evidence References
- Unresolved Issues
- Confidence
- Next Actions

不能只返回一段自由文本。

# 六、Reviewer：建立真正的独立审查机制

Reviewer 不应该只是让另一个模型重新总结一次结果。

它必须检查：

1. 是否完成原始目标。
2. 是否满足成功标准。
3. 是否存在未经验证的假设。
4. 产物是否真实存在。
5. 产物是否与执行记录对应。
6. 测试是否真实运行。
7. 是否存在逻辑错误。
8. 是否存在明显遗漏。
9. 是否存在安全问题。

Reviewer 应当拥有独立的上下文。

不要将 Coding Agent 的全部内部推理直接复制给 Reviewer。

Reviewer 应获得：
- 原始任务合同。
- 成功标准。
- 实际产物。
- 可信工具回执。
- 必要的研究来源。
- 测试结果。

审查结果：

PASS
NEEDS_REVISION
REJECT
BLOCKED

NEEDS_REVISION 必须能够创建有明确修改目标的返工任务。

设置最大审查轮次。

Reviewer 不能通过模型自述或 Mock 证据判定成功。

---

# 七、Context Compaction 与 Memory 深度增强

目前 M6 已经实现了有界 Context Archive、Recall 和预算管理。

但长期单一对话仍然有容量边界。

本轮重点解决这个问题。

## 7.1 Task-Centric Compaction

不要简单按时间截断历史。

采用多层上下文：

L0：Recent Interaction
L1：Active Quest Context
L2：Project Memory
L3：Long-term Experience

保留：
- 原始用户目标。
- 用户明确约束。
- 重要决策。
- 已完成节点。
- 当前阻塞。
- 产物路径。
- 证据来源。
- 失败经验。
- 后续行动。

每个压缩摘要必须保留来源引用。

压缩后必须能恢复到原始证据。

## 7.2 解决历史消息无限增长

不要为了保存所有用户约束而无限注入原始消息。

建立约束抽取和引用机制：

- 将用户约束单独索引。
- 保留原始消息 ID。
- 生成有来源的结构化 Constraint Record。
- 检测约束冲突。
- 检测约束是否过期。
- 必要时重新读取原始消息。

模型抽取出的约束先标记为待验证。

用户明确确认的约束与模型推测严格区分。

## 7.3 Memory Retrieval

改进 Recall：

- 语义检索。
- 关键词检索。
- Quest 关联检索。
- 时间检索。
- 来源可靠性过滤。
- 冲突检测。
- 过期过滤。

建立 Retrieval Evaluation Dataset。

测试 Router 是否能准确找到历史 Quest、决策、文件和用户约束。

不要只根据摘要文本相似度判断召回成功。

---

# 八、Agent 之间的协作机制

建立正式的 Agent Communication Protocol。

不允许把自由文本群聊作为主要协调机制。

支持：

TASK_ASSIGNMENT
TASK_ACCEPTED
TASK_COMPLETED
HELP_REQUEST
REVIEW_REQUEST
REVISION_REQUEST
DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED
MODEL_UNAVAILABLE
BUDGET_WARNING
AGENT_FAILED

重要消息持久化。

Router 负责协调。

Worker 不能绕过 Router 自行修改其他 Worker 的任务。

对于跨 Worker 共享的产物，必须通过有权限的 Artifact 和 Receipt 接口访问。

---

# 九、真正跑通复杂任务

本轮必须新增真实端到端实验。

不要只写单元测试。

建立三种任务难度：

## Level 1：简单任务

例如：

“分析这个 Python 项目，指出三个最值得优先修复的问题。”

验证：
- Router 判断。
- Quest 创建。
- 单 Worker 执行。
- 结果回传。

## Level 2：多 Agent 协作

例如：

“调研一个开源 Agent 框架，比较其架构，写一份技术分析报告。”

验证：
- Research Agent。
- Architect Agent。
- Coding/Writer Agent。
- Reviewer Agent。
- Router 汇总。

## Level 3：复杂自主开发

例如：

“研究一个新的 Agent 算法，提出技术方案，实现实验代码，运行实验，并分析结果。”

验证：
- Planner。
- Research Agent。
- Math Agent。
- Architect Agent。
- Coding Agent。
- Experiment Agent。
- Reviewer Agent。

复杂任务必须真实调用 Provider、真实执行工具、真实产生文件。

必须能在中途重启 Core 后继续执行。

## 实验数据

每次实验保存：

- Run ID
- Provider
- Model ID
- Execution Mode
- Model Calls
- Tool Calls
- Token Usage
- Duration
- Retry Count
- Review Results
- Artifact Hashes
- Final Status

真实模型实验与 Mock 实验分开统计。

失败实验必须保留。

---

# 十、算法研究：不要只做工程拼装

FORGE 有三个值得深入的自主研究方向：

1. Capability-Aware Dynamic Team Composition。
2. Evidence-Driven Autonomous Governance。
3. Task-Centric Context Compression。

本轮建立真正可复现的 Benchmark。

重点：

### Team Composition
比较：
- Single Model
- Static Team
- Greedy Selection
- Capability Coverage
- Complementarity
- Dynamic Recomposition

### Context Compression
比较：
- Full Context
- Recency Truncation
- Conventional Summary
- Task-Centric Compression
- Task-Centric Compression + Source Recall

### Agent Governance
比较：
- Model Claim Only
- Tool Receipt Verification
- Independent Reviewer
- Evidence-Gated Completion

至少建立多个不同难度和领域的任务。

使用固定测试集、统一预算和独立评分。

报告成功率、成本、延迟、Token、返工次数和证据完整率。

小样本结果必须明确标记为探索性实验，不允许夸大统计结论。

---

# 十一、本轮明确不做的事情

暂时不投入主要开发资源于：

- UI 视觉重构。
- Tauri 安装包优化。
- NSIS 发布。
- 动画效果。
- 桌面端页面扩展。
- 非必要的数据库重构。

现有桌面端保持可用即可。

如果发现会阻塞 Agent 运行的底层缺陷，可以修复，但不要将桌面测试变成主线。

---

# 十二、执行顺序

请连续执行以下阶段，不需要每个阶段都等待用户确认：

Sprint A：Provider 和 Agent Loop 深度审计及真实调用。

Sprint B：Persistent Router + Planner 智能化。

Sprint C：Dynamic Team Intelligence。

Sprint D：Native Worker 自主执行与自我修正。

Sprint E：Independent Reviewer 与返工闭环。

Sprint F：Context Compaction + Long-term Memory。

Sprint G：Agent Communication Protocol + 故障恢复。

Sprint H：真实复杂任务端到端验收。

Sprint I：三项核心算法 Benchmark 与消融实验。

每个阶段必须有独立测试和可复现报告。

如果发现现有架构不支持目标，应先提出最小必要架构调整，并通过 ADR 记录，不要推倒重写。

---

# 十三、工程约束

1. 保持一个长期用户对话入口。
2. Router 是唯一面向用户的 Agent。
3. Worker 是真正的后台执行 Agent。
4. 不允许通过创建多个用户 Conversation 规避上下文问题。
5. 不允许把 Codex、DSH 或 Claude Code 当作执行后端。
6. 不允许使用伪造的执行记录。
7. 不允许把 Mock 结果标记为 Live。
8. 不允许绕过 Approval、Policy 和 Evidence。
9. 不允许无限 Agent 派生。
10. 不允许无限重试。
11. 不允许无预算模型调用。
12. 保留历史测试和审计证据。
13. 不自动推送或合并 GitHub。
14. 不删除用户原有数据和实验记录。

可以使用多个 Codex 子任务并行分析和实现，但必须指定唯一集成负责人，避免多人同时修改相同核心文件。

---

# 十四、最终交付标准

最终必须让 FORGE 能够：

1. 长期与用户保持同一个对话。
2. 理解用户复杂目标。
3. 自动生成 Quest。
4. 自动规划 DAG。
5. 从模型库选择模型。
6. 动态组建 Agent 团队。
7. 后台并行执行任务。
8. Agent 之间结构化协作。
9. 自动发现错误并修复。
10. Reviewer 独立检查结果。
11. 不合格任务自动返工。
12. 上下文压缩后恢复工作。
13. 长期记忆跨任务复用。
14. Core 重启后继续执行。
15. 所有成果具备可信证据。

生成：

`docs/PHASE2_AGENT_INTELLIGENCE_REPORT.md`

`docs/PHASE2_STATUS.md`

`docs/PHASE2_EXPERIMENTS.md`

`docs/audit/phase2/verification.json`

最终报告必须明确区分真实模型验证、Mock 验证、合成实验和未完成项目。

现在开始执行。

本轮的成功标准不是增加了多少代码，而是 FORGE 是否真正能够自主完成一个复杂任务，并且在失败、返工、上下文压缩和 Core 重启后仍然保持任务连续性。要多开子代理并行，本地provider直接用本地workbuddy-api 的wb-in里面的deepseek-v4.1-flash

"""Typed projection of durable Core events into Agent coordination messages.

The append-only event/outbox store is the transport. This projection adds no
separate chat, mutation authority or model-to-model task editing channel.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import StrEnum

from .domain import DomainError


class AgentMessageType(StrEnum):
    TASK_ASSIGNMENT = "TASK_ASSIGNMENT"
    TASK_ACCEPTED = "TASK_ACCEPTED"
    TASK_COMPLETED = "TASK_COMPLETED"
    HELP_REQUEST = "HELP_REQUEST"
    REVIEW_REQUEST = "REVIEW_REQUEST"
    REVISION_REQUEST = "REVISION_REQUEST"
    DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED = "DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED"
    MODEL_UNAVAILABLE = "MODEL_UNAVAILABLE"
    BUDGET_WARNING = "BUDGET_WARNING"
    AGENT_FAILED = "AGENT_FAILED"


_TYPES = {
    "worker.proposed": AgentMessageType.TASK_ASSIGNMENT,
    "worker.accepted": AgentMessageType.TASK_ACCEPTED,
    "task.verified": AgentMessageType.TASK_COMPLETED,
    "worker.help_requested": AgentMessageType.HELP_REQUEST,
    "worker.result": AgentMessageType.REVIEW_REQUEST,
    "worker.review_requested": AgentMessageType.REVIEW_REQUEST,
    "worker.revision_requested": AgentMessageType.REVISION_REQUEST,
    "worker.blocked": AgentMessageType.DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED,
    "worker.failed": AgentMessageType.AGENT_FAILED,
    "review.blocked": AgentMessageType.DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED,
}
COORDINATION_EVENTS = frozenset(_TYPES)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AgentMessage:
    message_id: str
    message_type: AgentMessageType
    sender_id: str
    receiver_id: str
    quest_id: str
    plan_id: str
    task_node_key: str
    correlation_id: str
    payload: dict

    @classmethod
    def from_event(cls, event, payload):
        kind = _TYPES.get(event["event_type"])
        if kind is None:
            return None
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            raise DomainError("Invalid Agent coordination payload")
        if event["event_type"] == "worker.blocked":
            category = payload.get("failure_category")
            if category == "provider":
                kind = AgentMessageType.MODEL_UNAVAILABLE
            elif category == "budget":
                kind = AgentMessageType.BUDGET_WARNING
        identifiers = (
            event["id"],
            event["quest_id"],
            event["worker_id"],
            payload.get("plan_id"),
            payload.get("task_node_key"),
        )
        if any(not isinstance(value, str) or not 1 <= len(value) <= 256 for value in identifiers):
            raise DomainError("Agent coordination requires durable task identity")
        assignment = kind == AgentMessageType.TASK_ASSIGNMENT
        return cls(
            event["id"],
            kind,
            "router" if assignment else event["worker_id"],
            event["worker_id"] if assignment else "router",
            event["quest_id"],
            payload["plan_id"],
            payload["task_node_key"],
            payload.get("correlation_id") or payload.get("run_id") or event["id"],
            payload,
        )

"""Bounded Core observations, kept separate from manually supplied ability scores.

Transport success is never interpreted as task success. These snapshots describe
recorded executions, not a benchmark estimate of general model capabilities.
"""

import hashlib
import json
import math


def _rate(successes, samples):
    if not samples:
        return None
    # Wilson 95% interval is intentionally wide for small samples.
    z = 1.959963984540054
    value = successes / samples
    divisor = 1 + z * z / samples
    center = (value + z * z / (2 * samples)) / divisor
    half = z * math.sqrt(value * (1 - value) / samples + z * z / (4 * samples**2)) / divisor
    return {
        "value": value,
        "n_samples": samples,
        "confidence": {
            "method": "wilson_95",
            "lower": max(0, center - half),
            "upper": min(1, center + half),
        },
    }


def performance_snapshot(connection, provider_id, model_id, *, mode="live", limit=256):
    """Read a bounded recent sample in the caller's transaction without editing profiles.

    All joins bind provider, model and execution mode. Unknown token prices,
    missing usage, task quality and schema outcomes remain unknown. Source IDs
    and a digest make the exact proposal-time snapshot auditable after restart.
    """
    if mode not in {"live", "mock"} or type(limit) is not int or not 1 <= limit <= 1024:
        raise ValueError("Invalid performance snapshot bounds or provenance")
    observations = connection.execute(
        """SELECT * FROM model_observations WHERE provider_id=? AND model_id=? AND mode=?
        ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT ?""",
        (provider_id, model_id, mode, limit + 1),
    ).fetchall()
    runs = connection.execute(
        """SELECT * FROM worker_runs WHERE provider_id=? AND model_id=? AND execution_mode=?
        ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT ?""",
        (provider_id, model_id, mode, limit + 1),
    ).fetchall()
    omitted = {"gateway": len(observations) > limit, "workers": len(runs) > limit}
    observations, runs = observations[:limit], runs[:limit]
    metrics = {}
    rates = {
        "transport_success_rate": _rate(
            sum(row["outcome"] == "success" for row in observations), len(observations)
        ),
        "task_success_rate": _rate(
            sum(row["state"] == "succeeded" for row in runs),
            sum(row["state"] in {"succeeded", "failed"} for row in runs),
        ),
    }
    elapsed = sorted(
        row["latency_seconds"] for row in observations if row["latency_seconds"] is not None
    )
    if elapsed:
        metrics["average_latency_seconds"] = {
            "value": sum(elapsed) / len(elapsed),
            "n_samples": len(elapsed),
            "confidence": None,
        }
        metrics["p95_latency_seconds"] = {
            "value": elapsed[math.ceil(0.95 * len(elapsed)) - 1],
            "n_samples": len(elapsed),
            "confidence": None,
        }
    source_rows = [dict(row) for row in observations]
    source_rows.extend(dict(row) for row in runs)
    refs = [f"model_observation:{row['id']}" for row in observations]
    refs.extend(f"worker_run:{row['id']}" for row in runs)
    if runs:
        run_ids = [row["id"] for row in runs]
        worker_ids = [row["worker_id"] for row in runs]

"""Interpret historic model profiles without discarding invalid source records."""

import json
import math

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, ValidationError, model_validator

from .domain import ModelProfile, new_id, now_iso


def decode_profile(raw, model_id):
    try:
        profile = ModelProfile.model_validate_json(raw)
        if profile.id != model_id:
            raise ValueError("Stored identity differs from row identity")
        return profile
    except (ValidationError, ValueError, TypeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return ModelProfile.model_construct(
            id=model_id,
            provider="unknown",
            display_name=model_id,
            enabled=False,
            quarantined_raw=raw,
            quarantine_reason="Stored profile is invalid; correct and save it before use",
        )


class GatewayObservation(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(allow_inf_nan=False, extra="forbid")
    outcome: str
    latency_seconds: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0)
    ttft_seconds: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0)
    output_tokens: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=0)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_observation(self):
        if self.outcome not in {"success", "timeout", "error"}:
            raise ValueError("Unknown outcome")
        if self.ttft_seconds is not None and (
            self.latency_seconds is None or self.ttft_seconds > self.latency_seconds
        ):
            raise ValueError("TTFT cannot exceed total latency")
        return self


class ObservationStore:
    """Internal receiver for gateway observations, separated by execution provenance."""

    def __init__(self, store):
        self.store = store

    def record(self, gateway, model_id, provider_id, observation):
        mode = getattr(gateway, "execution_mode", None)
        if mode not in {"mock", "live"} or not model_id or not provider_id:
            raise ValueError("Gateway provenance and model identity required")
        item = GatewayObservation.model_validate(observation)
        identifier = new_id("observation")
        with self.store.unit_of_work() as work:
            work.connection.execute(
                "INSERT INTO model_observations VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                (
                    identifier,
                    model_id,
                    provider_id,
                    mode,
                    item.outcome,
                    item.latency_seconds,
                    item.ttft_seconds,
                    item.output_tokens,
                    now_iso(),
                ),
            )
        return identifier

    def summarize(self, model_id, provider_id, *, mode):
        if mode not in {"mock", "live"}:
            raise ValueError("Unknown execution provenance")
        with self.store.connection() as connection:
            rows = connection.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM model_observations WHERE model_id=? AND provider_id=? AND mode=? ORDER BY created_at,id",
                (model_id, provider_id, mode),
            ).fetchall()
        if not rows:
            return None
        elapsed = sorted(
            row["latency_seconds"] for row in rows if row["latency_seconds"] is not None
        )
        first = [row["ttft_seconds"] for row in rows if row["ttft_seconds"] is not None]
        speeds = [
            row["output_tokens"] / (row["latency_seconds"] - row["ttft_seconds"])
            for row in rows
            if row["outcome"] == "success"
            and row["output_tokens"] is not None
            and row["latency_seconds"] is not None
            and row["ttft_seconds"] is not None
            and row["latency_seconds"] > row["ttft_seconds"]
        ]

        def percentile(q):
            return elapsed[max(0, math.ceil(q * len(elapsed)) - 1)] if elapsed else None

        values = {
            "reliability": sum(row["outcome"] == "success" for row in rows) / len(rows),
            "timeout_rate": sum(row["outcome"] == "timeout" for row in rows) / len(rows),
            "ttft_seconds": sum(first) / len(first) if first else None,
            "tokens_per_second": sum(speeds) / len(speeds) if speeds else None,
            "latency_p50_seconds": percentile(0.5),
            "latency_p95_seconds": percentile(0.95),
        }
        counts = {
            "reliability": len(rows),
            "timeout_rate": len(rows),
            "ttft_seconds": len(first),
            "tokens_per_second": len(speeds),
            "latency_p50_seconds": len(elapsed),
            "latency_p95_seconds": len(elapsed),
        }
        return {
            "source": "gateway_observation",
            "mode": mode,
            "n_samples": len(rows),
            "observed_at": rows[-1]["created_at"],
            **values,
            "measurements": {
                name: {
                    "value": value,
                    "source": "gateway_observation",
                    "mode": mode,
                    "n_samples": counts[name],
                    "observed_at": rows[-1]["created_at"],
                    "confidence": None,
                    "benchmark_version": None,
                }
                for name, value in values.items()
                if value is not None
            },
        }

import hashlib
import json
import re
import sqlite3
import uuid
from contextlib import closing, contextmanager
from datetime import UTC, datetime


def _terms(text):
    words = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9_./\\:-]+", text.casefold())
    words.extend(re.findall(r"[a-z0-9_]+", text.casefold()))
    for run in re.findall(r"[\u4e00-\u9fff]+", text):
        words.extend(run[i : i + 2] for i in range(len(run) - 1))
    return sorted(set(words))[:128]


def _index_terms(db, ref, text):
    db.execute("DELETE FROM memory_terms WHERE ref=?", (ref,))
    db.executemany(
        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO memory_terms VALUES (?,?)", ((word, ref) for word in _terms(text))
    )


def _query_terms(text):
    """Bounded bilingual lexical expansion; this is not embedding retrieval."""
    terms = set(_terms(text))
    lowered = text.casefold()
    for aliases in (
        ("budget", "spending", "预算", "成本", "费用"),
        ("deadline", "due date", "截止", "期限"),
        ("retain", "preserve", "keep", "保留"),
        ("delete", "remove", "删除"),
        ("implementation", "coding", "代码", "实现"),
    ):
        if any(alias in lowered for alias in aliases):
            for alias in aliases:
                terms.update(_terms(alias))
    return sorted(terms)[:128]

    return (

    def __init__(self, store):

    @contextmanager

        if connection is not None:
            yield connection

            "PYTHONIOENCODING": "utf-8",
            "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
        }
        values.update(self.provider_env)
        values.update(self.extra_env)
        base = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("FORGE_")}
        base.update(values)
        return base

    def start(self, timeout=120):
        # Kept open for the child lifetime and closed by stop(), including failures.
        self.stdout = open(self.log_path, "ab")  # noqa: SIM115
        env = self.env()
        creation = 0
        if os.name == "nt":
            creation = subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW
        self.process = subprocess.Popen(
            [str(PYTHON), "-m", "forge_api", "--workspace-root", str(self.workspace)],
            cwd=str(BACKEND),
            env=env,
            stdout=self.stdout,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            creationflags=creation,
        )
        deadline = time.time() + timeout
        while time.time() < deadline:
            if self.process.poll() is not None:
                raise RuntimeError("Core exited during startup")
            try:
                response = httpx.get(self.base_url + "/health", timeout=2, trust_env=False)
                if response.status_code == 200:
                    self.session = response.json()["session"]
                    raw = bytes.fromhex(self.secret)
                    self.bearer = hmac.new(raw, self.session.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
                    return self
            except (httpx.TransportError, httpx.TimeoutException):
                pass
            time.sleep(0.25)
        raise RuntimeError("Core did not become healthy")

    def client(self, timeout=240):
        return httpx.Client(
            base_url=self.base_url,
            headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + self.bearer},
            timeout=httpx.Timeout(connect=5, read=timeout, write=10, pool=5),
            trust_env=False,
            follow_redirects=False,
        )

    def call(self, method, path, payload=None, timeout=240):
        with self.client(timeout=timeout) as client:
            response = client.request(method, path, json=payload)
        try:
            body = response.json()
        except ValueError:
            body = {"raw": response.text[:400]}
        return {"status": response.status_code, "body": body}

    def stop(self, *, graceful=True):
        if self.process is None:
            return
        if self.process.poll() is None:
            if graceful:
                self.process.terminate()
            else:
                self.process.kill()
            try:
                self.process.wait(timeout=30)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                self.process.kill()
                self.process.wait(timeout=15)
        if self.stdout:
            self.stdout.close()
            self.stdout = None

Transport success is never interpreted as task success. These snapshots describe
recorded executions, not a benchmark estimate of general model capabilities.

import hashlib

def _rate(successes, samples):
    if not samples:
        return None
    # Wilson 95% interval is intentionally wide for small samples.
    z = 1.959963984540054
    value = successes / samples
    divisor = 1 + z * z / samples
    center = (value + z * z / (2 * samples)) / divisor
    half = z * math.sqrt(value * (1 - value) / samples + z * z / (4 * samples**2)) / divisor
    return {
        "value": value,
        "n_samples": samples,
        "confidence": {
            "method": "wilson_95",
            "lower": max(0, center - half),
            "upper": min(1, center + half),
        },
    }

class GatewayObservation(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(allow_inf_nan=False, extra="forbid")
    outcome: str
    latency_seconds: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0)
    ttft_seconds: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0)
    output_tokens: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=0)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_observation(self):
        if self.outcome not in {"success", "timeout", "error"}:
            raise ValueError("Unknown outcome")
        if self.ttft_seconds is not None and (
            self.latency_seconds is None or self.ttft_seconds > self.latency_seconds
        ):
            raise ValueError("TTFT cannot exceed total latency")
        return self


class ObservationStore:
    """Internal receiver for gateway observations, separated by execution provenance."""

    def __init__(self, store):
        self.store = store

    def record(self, gateway, model_id, provider_id, observation):
        mode = getattr(gateway, "execution_mode", None)
        if mode not in {"mock", "live"} or not model_id or not provider_id:
            raise ValueError("Gateway provenance and model identity required")
        item = GatewayObservation.model_validate(observation)
        identifier = new_id("observation")

            work.connection.execute(
                "INSERT INTO model_observations VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                (
                    identifier,
                    model_id,
                    provider_id,
                    mode,
                    item.outcome,
                    item.latency_seconds,
                    item.ttft_seconds,
                    item.output_tokens,
                    now_iso(),
                ),
            )
        return identifier

    def summarize(self, model_id, provider_id, *, mode):
        if mode not in {"mock", "live"}:
            raise ValueError("Unknown execution provenance")

            rows = connection.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM model_observations WHERE model_id=? AND provider_id=? AND mode=? ORDER BY created_at,id",

            and row["latency_seconds"] is not None
            and row["ttft_seconds"] is not None

            "reliability": sum(row["outcome"] == "success" for row in rows) / len(rows),
            "timeout_rate": sum(row["outcome"] == "timeout" for row in rows) / len(rows),
            "ttft_seconds": sum(first) / len(first) if first else None,
            "tokens_per_second": sum(speeds) / len(speeds) if speeds else None,

            "timeout_rate": len(rows),

            "latency_p95_seconds": len(elapsed),
        }

            "source": "gateway_observation",
            "mode": mode,
            "n_samples": len(rows),
            "observed_at": rows[-1]["created_at"],
            **values,

def _terms(text):
    words = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9_./\\:-]+", text.casefold())
    words.extend(re.findall(r"[a-z0-9_]+", text.casefold()))
    for run in re.findall(r"[\u4e00-\u9fff]+", text):
        words.extend(run[i : i + 2] for i in range(len(run) - 1))
    return sorted(set(words))[:128]


def _index_terms(db, ref, text):
    db.execute("DELETE FROM memory_terms WHERE ref=?", (ref,))

        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO memory_terms VALUES (?,?)", ((word, ref) for word in _terms(text))
    )


def _query_terms(text):
    """Bounded bilingual lexical expansion; this is not embedding retrieval."""
    terms = set(_terms(text))
    lowered = text.casefold()
    for aliases in (
        ("budget", "spending", "预算", "成本", "费用"),
        ("deadline", "due date", "截止", "期限"),
        ("retain", "preserve", "keep", "保留"),
        ("delete", "remove", "删除"),
        ("implementation", "coding", "代码", "实现"),
    ):
        if any(alias in lowered for alias in aliases):
            for alias in aliases:
                terms.update(_terms(alias))
