def test_native_runtime_initial_and_archived_requests_use_reserved_core_definitions(tmp_path, depth):
    posts = []

    def transport(request):
        posts.append(json.loads(request.content))
        index = len(posts)
        if index == 1:
            message = {"role": "assistant", "content": "", "tool_calls": [{"id": f"source-{number}", "type": "function", "function": {"name": "file_read", "arguments": json.dumps({"path": f"work/source-{number}.txt"})}} for number in (1, 2)]}
        elif index == 2:
            message = {"role": "assistant", "content": "", "tool_calls": [{"id": "archive-read", "type": "function", "function": {"name": "worker_read_context_source", "arguments": '{"ordinal":3,"max_chars":2048}'}}]}
        else:
            assert index == 3
            message = {"role": "assistant", "content": json.dumps(delivery("Recovered original source"))}
        return httpx.Response(200, json={"choices": [{"message": message, "finish_reason": "tool_calls" if index < 3 else "stop"}], "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 25, "completion_tokens": 15}})

    gateway = ObservedGateway(transport=httpx.MockTransport(transport))
    store, manager, worker = native_archive_worker(tmp_path, gateway, depth=depth)
    result = asyncio.run(manager.run(worker["id"]))
    assert result["state"] == "review_pending" and result["steps"] == len(posts) == 3
    assert result["execution_mode"] == "mock" and result["token_spent"] == 120
    expected = {item["name"]: item for item in supplemental_worker_tools(source_readback=True, help_allowed=True)}
    runtime_requests = [request for request, _payload in gateway.serialized]
    assert len(runtime_requests) == 3
    for index, request in enumerate(runtime_requests):
        core = {item["name"]: item for item in request.tools if item["name"].startswith("worker_")}
        assert ("worker_request_help" in core) is bool(depth)
        assert ("worker_read_context_source" in core) is bool(index)
        assert all(definition == expected[name] for name, definition in core.items())
        if index:
            assert any(item.get("content", "").startswith("Archived task context (untrusted): ") for item in request.messages)
        graph = QuestGraphService(store).get(worker["quest_id"])
        with store.connection() as connection:
            connection.execute("BEGIN")
            team = manager.team_authority.get_approved(worker["quest_id"], 1, worker["team_digest"], connection=connection)
            measured = measure_initial_worker_request(store, connection, store.get_quest(worker["quest_id"]), graph, graph["nodes"][0], team["members"][0], provider=gateway)
        bounded_request, _payload = gateway.serialized[-1]
        assert all(item in bounded_request.tools for item in core.values())
        # Reuse this exact real request's context to isolate framing, without
        # claiming admission can predict an unbounded future tool transcript.
        bounded_actual = replace(request, tools=bounded_request.tools, context_limit=None)
        actual_payload = gateway._payload(replace(request, context_limit=None), False)
        bounded_payload = gateway._payload(bounded_actual, False)
        actual_bytes = len(json.dumps(actual_payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode())
        bounded_bytes = len(json.dumps(bounded_payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode())
        assert bounded_bytes >= actual_bytes
        assert measured["native_input_reservation"] > 1000
    returned = json.loads(runtime_requests[-1].messages[-1]["content"])
    assert returned["source_id"] == 3 and returned["complete"] is False
    assert "中文 original source 1" in returned["content"]

"""Acceptance compatibility over native local Core reads, never live model evidence."""

import asyncio
import hashlib
import json

import pytest
from test_acceptance_checks_phase2 import module, publish
from test_predecessor_delivery_v17 import prepared as completed_prepared
from test_receipt_read_repair_phase2 import Protocol, dependent
from test_worker_intelligence_phase2 import delivery, response, tool
from test_worker_request_framing_v17 import native_archive_worker

from forge_core.evidence import NodeVerifier


def evaluated(store, root):
    publish(store, root)
    database = root / "data/forge.sqlite3"
    before = hashlib.sha256(database.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    report = module("acceptance_checks").evaluate_scenario(
        module("acceptance_scenarios").describe_scenario(3), {}, root
    )
    assert hashlib.sha256(database.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == before
    return report


@pytest.mark.parametrize("tamper", [False, True])
def test_evaluator_revalidates_complete_delivery_instead_of_demanding_action_receipt(
    tmp_path, tamper
):
    store, manager, model, quest, _plan, producer, reader, _expected = completed_prepared(
        tmp_path
    )
    model.responses.extend(
        [
            tool("worker_read_completed_delivery", {"node_key": "producer"}),
            tool("file_write", {"path": "work/review.json", "content": '{"checked":true}'}, 2),
            response(delivery("Read the full original predecessor")),
        ]
    )
    assert asyncio.run(manager.run(reader["id"]))["state"] == "review_pending"
    NodeVerifier(store).verify(quest.id, "reader")
    if tamper:
        with store.unit_of_work() as work:
            work.connection.execute(
                "UPDATE events SET payload=json_set(payload,'$.claim','{}') "
                "WHERE event_type='worker.result' AND worker_id=?",
                (producer["worker_id"],),
            )
    report = evaluated(store, tmp_path)
    expected = "failed" if tamper else "passed"
    assert report["checks"]["receipt_integrity"]["status"] == expected
    core = report["checks"]["core_context_read_integrity"]
    assert core["status"] == expected
    if not tamper:
        assert len(core["evidence"]["verified"]) == 1
        assert core["evidence"]["verified"][0]["tool_name"] == "worker_read_completed_delivery"
    # Core reads do not satisfy seeded file source, required final artifact or
    # independently reviewed final-report requirements of strict L3.
    assert report["checks"]["required_final_artifacts"]["status"] != "passed"
    assert not report["passed"]


def test_evaluator_accepts_verified_receipt_read_without_counting_it_as_file_source(tmp_path):
    store, manager, model, quest, _, _, _, reader, receipts, _ = dependent(tmp_path)
    model.responses.extend(
        [
            tool("worker_read_action_receipt", {"receipt_id": receipts["file_write"]}),
            tool("file_write", {"path": "work/review.json", "content": '{"checked":true}'}, 2),
            response(delivery()),
        ]
    )
    assert asyncio.run(manager.run(reader["id"]))["state"] == "review_pending"
    NodeVerifier(store).verify(quest.id, "reader")
    report = evaluated(store, tmp_path)
    assert report["checks"]["receipt_integrity"]["status"] == "passed"
    core = report["checks"]["core_context_read_integrity"]
    assert core["status"] == "passed"
    assert core["evidence"]["verified"][0]["tool_name"] == "worker_read_action_receipt"
    assert report["checks"]["input_sources_read"]["status"] != "passed"
    assert not report["passed"]


def test_evaluator_accepts_actual_archive_source_and_rejects_changed_source_hash(tmp_path):
    # This explicitly scripted adapter's live tag exercises the durable live
    # provenance gate. It performs no HTTP and is not real acceptance evidence.
    model = Protocol(
        [
            response("", calls=[{"id": f"source-{n}", "name": "file_read", "arguments": {"path": f"work/source-{n}.txt"}} for n in (1, 2)]),
            tool("worker_read_context_source", {"ordinal": 3, "max_chars": 2048}),
            response(delivery()),
        ]
    )
    store, manager, worker = native_archive_worker(tmp_path, model, depth=0)
    assert asyncio.run(manager.run(worker["id"]))["state"] == "review_pending"
    report = evaluated(store, tmp_path)
    assert report["checks"]["receipt_integrity"]["status"] == "passed"
    core = report["checks"]["core_context_read_integrity"]
    assert core["status"] == "passed"
    assert core["evidence"]["verified"][0]["tool_name"] == "worker_read_context_source"
    with store.unit_of_work() as work:
        row = work.connection.execute(
            "SELECT call_id,result_json FROM worker_tool_calls WHERE run_id=? AND tool_name=?",
            (worker["id"], "worker_read_context_source"),
        ).fetchone()
        result = json.loads(row["result_json"])
        result["source_sha256"] = "0" * 64
        work.connection.execute(
            "UPDATE worker_tool_calls SET result_json=? WHERE call_id=?",
            (json.dumps(result), row["call_id"]),
        )
    report = evaluated(store, tmp_path)
    assert report["checks"]["receipt_integrity"]["status"] == "failed"
    assert report["checks"]["core_context_read_integrity"]["status"] == "failed"

"""Create immutable inputs in an isolated workspace, returning the Router prompt.

    Existing scenario directories are rejected. No original repo/workspace files
    are overwritten, and no plan, team, approval, receipt or execution is forged.
    """
    root = Path(workspace_root).resolve()
    repository = Path(repo_root).resolve() if repo_root is not None else REPO
    descriptor = describe_scenario(level)
    inputs = root / "inputs" / f"scenario-{level}"
    # Fail before writing any files if a required repository source is missing.
    documents = [
        _source(repository, relative, symbols=symbols)
        for relative, symbols in descriptor["sources"]
    ]
    inputs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    (root / "work").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    manifest = []
    for index, document in enumerate(documents, 1):
        relative = f"inputs/scenario-{level}/{index:02d}-{Path(document['source_path']).stem}.json"
        data = (json.dumps(document, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
        with (root / relative).open("xb") as handle:
            handle.write(data)
        manifest.append(
            {
                "path": relative,
                "sha256": _sha(data),
                "bytes": len(data),
                "source_path": document["source_path"],
                "source_sha256": document["source_sha256"],
                "source_bytes": document["source_bytes"],
                "contains_excerpts": "fragments" in document,
            }
        )
    manifest_path = inputs / "manifest.json"
    with manifest_path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write(
            json.dumps(
                {"scenario_id": descriptor["scenario_id"], "inputs": manifest},
                ensure_ascii=False,
                indent=2,
            )
            + "\n"
        )
    return {
        **descriptor,
        "input_manifest": manifest,
        "input_directory": f"inputs/scenario-{level}",
        "prompt": descriptor["prompt"]
        + " Experiment limits (hard upper bounds, including coordination and review): "
        + json.dumps(descriptor["limits"], separators=(",", ":"))
        + f" Read inputs/scenario-{level}/manifest.json first. Local source files: "
        + ", ".join(item["path"] for item in manifest)
        + ".",
        "seeding_mode": "real_repository_sources_only; no_provider_calls",
    }

Current acceptance — v15, 2026-11-15: **1,031 backend tests passed**, one
existing TestClient warning, 227.13 seconds. Ruff, formatting of 164 Python files,
dependency and whitespace checks passed on the unchanged 167-file frozen source.

its approved concurrency exceeded the scenario cap; L2 lacked cumulative review budget;

complex run reached its mid-execution restart. Phase 2 remains incomplete.

and documents remain byte-identical under `audit/phase2/checkpoint-v12/`.

Integration owner: root agent. **Phase 2 is in progress. V15 frozen backend checks
passed; all three current-source strict live runs failed. Historical L1 passes
remain recorded without certifying this source.**

## Scope and architectural change

This sprint moves the existing backend toward autonomous task execution. Desktop
visual changes, packaging and the deferred M7 desktop Alpha are outside this sprint's
acceptance. Existing Phase 1 reports and failed experiments remain preserved.

The source audit and complete execution diagram are in the
[execution-chain audit](audit/phase2/execution-chain-audit.md). The minimum change is
recorded in [ADR 009](adr/ADR-009-agent-intelligence-contracts-and-review.md):

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    U[One user conversation] --> R[Persistent Router]
    R --> P[Separate Planner and proposed DAG]
    P --> A[Authenticated plan and team approval]
    A --> W[Native private Worker loops]
    W --> T[Governed tools and receipts]
    T --> V[Fresh independent review]
    V -->|concrete revision goals| W
    V --> N[NodeVerifier and CompletionGate]
    N --> R
```

All model requests use the existing Gateway and durable admission ledger. The
Router remains the only user-facing Agent. Workers, reviewers and durable events
do not create extra user conversations or use another Agent product as a backend.

## Implemented mechanisms

| Area | Current behavior | Verification boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Router and Planner | Strict decisions, one bounded repair, atomic turn commits, original and latest goal-update request IDs/hashes, offered-tool/capability checks, DAG limit of eight nodes/sixteen edges | Mock reasoning and local persistence regressions; live protocol coverage below |
| Team intelligence | Existing single-model/greedy/coverage/complementarity strategies consume sourced online observations with counts and Wilson intervals; proposals retain profile/source hashes | Synthetic selection proxies and local/Mock integration; no measured general model-quality gain |
| Team adaptation | Approved replacement may cover remaining nodes while retaining completed assignments and historical approvals | Local regression; general autonomous remaining-DAG replanning and hierarchical expansion incomplete |
| Native Worker | Private model/tool loop, checkpoints, fenced lease renewal between settled steps, bounded repair, distinct failure categories and structured delivery | One earlier strict L1 pass with self-repair; v8 failed L1/L2 show actual Worker archives and NEEDS_REVISION, without mid-execution Core restart; v10 L2 shows settled restart/Router archive/readback and architect continuation before later receipt-read block; whole-task continuity pending |
| Artifact revision | Separately approved R1 `file_revise` atomically replaces the same Worker's own latest produced artifact using an intact receipt chain and unchanged hash | Local/Mock race, provenance and immutable-history checks; general repository editing remains absent |
| Independent review | Fresh packet from original goal, criteria, real artifacts and receipts; PASS/NEEDS_REVISION/REJECT/BLOCKED; concrete revision goals, default two-round limit, hard maximum four | Current same approved underlying model in a separate context; independent model diversity is absent |
| Evidence gate | Review provenance plus fixed semantic verifiers and final receipt/artifact/approval checks govern completion | Mock/adversarial regressions and actual local tool checks; self-report never establishes live completion |
| Context and constraints | Bounded Router/Worker highlights, original-source readback, sourced literal/pending/confirmed clauses, potential conflicts, expiry and revocation | 53 combined Router/Planner/context/memory tests; 9 exploratory synthetic source-identity cases |
| Memory | L0 current interaction, L1 Quest, L2 project/history and L3 failure observations; bounded keyword/alias/Quest/time/type filtering | Lexical retrieval; embeddings and learned semantic relevance absent |
| Agent protocol/recovery | Typed projection of existing event transport with task identities, fenced leases and deduplication; unresolved effects retain reservations | Per-type payload validation remains partial; arbitrary in-flight external-effect recovery is unproven |

The delivery vocabulary contains `summary`, `findings`, `decisions`, `artifacts`,
`evidence_references`, `unresolved_issues`, `confidence` and `next_actions`.
`delivery_review` enforces all eight. Legacy/default compatibility schemas still
require only `summary`; missing fields are not evidence of completed work.

For new native TeamWire proposals, only explicit `output_schema_json=null`
selects a deep copy of `STRICT_DELIVERY_OUTPUT_SCHEMA`: the model must supply
all eight delivery fields and confidence within 0–1, with no Core-inserted defaults.

# FORGE — Agent Intelligence Sprint
## Phase 2: From Agent Infrastructure to Autonomous Intelligence

你现在正式进入 FORGE 的下一阶段开发。

本轮不以桌面端发布为目标，而是以真正跑通自主多智能体系统为目标。

用户已经授权你使用本地配置的 Provider。你可以使用现有 Provider 进行真实模型调用、协议测试、Agent 实验和端到端任务验证。

本轮必须把重心从基础设施转移到 Agent Intelligence。

不要继续大规模开发 UI，不要优先处理安装包和 Tauri 外观问题。

核心任务是让 FORGE 真正成为一个能够长期自主工作的 Agent 系统。

---

# 一、首先重新审计当前代码

当前开发分支：

`codex/phase1-continuous`

先读取：

- docs/STATUS.md
- docs/ROADMAP.md
- docs/QUALITY_GATES.md
- docs/PRODUCT_ARCHITECTURE.md
- docs/ROUTER_AND_WORKER_PROTOCOL.md
- docs/MODEL_REGISTRY_AND_TEAM_COMPOSITION.md
- docs/CONTEXT_MEMORY_GOVERNANCE.md
- 所有 Phase 1 Milestone 报告

重点阅读源码：

- forge_core/router.py
- forge_core/worker_runtime.py
- forge_core/team_composition.py
- forge_core/quest_graph.py
- forge_core/dispatcher.py
- forge_core/context_service.py
- forge_core/memory.py
- forge_core/providers/
- forge_core/tool_engine.py
- forge_core/evidence.py
- forge_core/governance.py

先建立一份真正的 Agent 执行链路图。

区分：
1. 已经真实实现的功能。
2. 通过 Mock 验证的功能。
3. 已经通过真实 Provider 验证的功能。
4. 只有接口或数据模型的功能。
5. 目前无法端到端工作的功能。

不要重新实现已经完成的模块。

不要为了让报告好看而隐藏已有缺陷。

审计完成后直接进入开发，不需要等待用户再次批准。

# 二、本地 Provider：正式启用真实模型

用户已经允许使用本地 Provider。

要求：

1. 检查 FORGE 当前 Provider 配置。
2. 检查本地 Provider 服务是否可用。
3. 获取可用模型列表。
4. 检查模型的 Tool Calling、Structured Output、Streaming 能力。
5. 检查模型实际上下文和输出限制。
6. 检查 Token 预算和并发限制。
7. 运行真实模型的最小对话测试。
8. 运行真实模型的 Router 决策测试。
9. 运行真实 Worker 工具调用测试。

如果本地 Provider 是 OpenAI-compatible 服务，优先使用现有 Adapter。

不要新建一套绕过 Gateway 的 Provider 实现。

安全要求：

- 不要打印 API Key。
- 不要把凭据写入源码、日志、Git 或实验报告。
- 不要读取与 FORGE Provider 配置无关的个人文件。
- 不要修改用户原有 Provider 服务配置。
- 不要自动增加无限 Token 预算。
- 不要将 Mock 响应标记为真实模型结果。

如果某个模型不支持 Tool Calling，应该由 Router 选择兼容模型或采用安全的结构化调用适配方案，不要假设所有模型都具备相同能力。

本地 Provider 可能是代理服务，必须区分：
- FORGE 到本地代理的请求成功。
- 上游真实模型调用成功。
- 模型实际返回正确结果。

三者不能混为一谈。

# 三、核心任务：升级 Persistent Router

当前 Router 已经具备模型驱动决策基础，但还需要进一步增强。

目标：

Router 不应该只是一个分类器，而应该成为一个长期存在的自主 Agent。

## 3.1 Router Agent Loop

实现完整的循环：

Observe
→ Understand
→ Retrieve
→ Reason
→ Decide
→ Act
→ Observe Result
→ Reflect
→ Continue

Router 必须具备：

- 持续理解用户目标。
- 自动关联历史 Quest。
- 判断是否创建新 Quest。
- 判断是否继续现有 Quest。
- 识别用户约束。

| Context and constraints | Bounded Router/Worker highlights, original-source readback, sourced literal/pending/confirmed clauses, potential conflicts, expiry and revocation | 53 combined Router/Planner/context/memory tests; 9 exploratory synthetic source-identity cases |
| Memory | L0 current interaction, L1 Quest, L2 project/history and L3 failure observations; bounded keyword/alias/Quest/time/type filtering | Lexical retrieval; embeddings and learned semantic relevance absent |
| Agent protocol/recovery | Typed projection of existing event transport with task identities, fenced leases and deduplication; unresolved effects retain reservations | Per-type payload validation remains partial; arbitrary in-flight external-effect recovery is unproven |

## Level 3：复杂自主开发

例如：

“研究一个新的 Agent 算法，提出技术方案，实现实验代码，运行实验，并分析结果。”

验证：
- Planner。
- Research Agent。
- Math Agent。
- Architect Agent。
- Coding Agent。
- Experiment Agent。
- Reviewer Agent。

复杂任务必须真实调用 Provider、真实执行工具、真实产生文件。

必须能在中途重启 Core 后继续执行。

## 实验数据

每次实验保存：

- Run ID
- Provider
- Model ID
- Execution Mode
- Model Calls
- Tool Calls
- Token Usage
- Duration
- Retry Count
- Review Results
- Artifact Hashes
- Final Status

真实模型实验与 Mock 实验分开统计。

失败实验必须保留。

---

# 十、算法研究：不要只做工程拼装

FORGE 有三个值得深入的自主研究方向：

1. Capability-Aware Dynamic Team Composition。
2. Evidence-Driven Autonomous Governance。
3. Task-Centric Context Compression。

本轮建立真正可复现的 Benchmark。

重点：

### Team Composition
比较：
- Single Model
- Static Team
- Greedy Selection
- Capability Coverage
- Complementarity
- Dynamic Recomposition

### Context Compression
比较：
- Full Context
- Recency Truncation
- Conventional Summary
- Task-Centric Compression
- Task-Centric Compression + Source Recall

### Agent Governance
比较：
- Model Claim Only
- Tool Receipt Verification
- Independent Reviewer
- Evidence-Gated Completion

至少建立多个不同难度和领域的任务。

使用固定测试集、统一预算和独立评分。

报告成功率、成本、延迟、Token、返工次数和证据完整率。

小样本结果必须明确标记为探索性实验，不允许夸大统计结论。

---

# 十一、本轮明确不做的事情

暂时不投入主要开发资源于：

- UI 视觉重构。
- Tauri 安装包优化。
- NSIS 发布。
- 动画效果。
- 桌面端页面扩展。
- 非必要的数据库重构。

现有桌面端保持可用即可。

如果发现会阻塞 Agent 运行的底层缺陷，可以修复，但不要将桌面测试变成主线。

---

# 十二、执行顺序

请连续执行以下阶段，不需要每个阶段都等待用户确认：

Sprint A：Provider 和 Agent Loop 深度审计及真实调用。

Sprint B：Persistent Router + Planner 智能化。

Sprint C：Dynamic Team Intelligence。

Sprint D：Native Worker 自主执行与自我修正。

Sprint E：Independent Reviewer 与返工闭环。

Sprint F：Context Compaction + Long-term Memory。

Sprint G：Agent Communication Protocol + 故障恢复。

Sprint H：真实复杂任务端到端验收。

Sprint I：三项核心算法 Benchmark 与消融实验。

每个阶段必须有独立测试和可复现报告。

如果发现现有架构不支持目标，应先提出最小必要架构调整，并通过 ADR 记录，不要推倒重写。

---

# 十三、工程约束

1. 保持一个长期用户对话入口。
2. Router 是唯一面向用户的 Agent。
3. Worker 是真正的后台执行 Agent。
4. 不允许通过创建多个用户 Conversation 规避上下文问题。
5. 不允许把 Codex、DSH 或 Claude Code 当作执行后端。
6. 不允许使用伪造的执行记录。
7. 不允许把 Mock 结果标记为 Live。
8. 不允许绕过 Approval、Policy 和 Evidence。
9. 不允许无限 Agent 派生。
10. 不允许无限重试。
11. 不允许无预算模型调用。
12. 保留历史测试和审计证据。
13. 不自动推送或合并 GitHub。
14. 不删除用户原有数据和实验记录。

可以使用多个 Codex 子任务并行分析和实现，但必须指定唯一集成负责人，避免多人同时修改相同核心文件。

---

# 十四、最终交付标准

最终必须让 FORGE 能够：

1. 长期与用户保持同一个对话。
2. 理解用户复杂目标。
3. 自动生成 Quest。
4. 自动规划 DAG。
5. 从模型库选择模型。
6. 动态组建 Agent 团队。
7. 后台并行执行任务。
8. Agent 之间结构化协作。
9. 自动发现错误并修复。
10. Reviewer 独立检查结果。
11. 不合格任务自动返工。
12. 上下文压缩后恢复工作。
13. 长期记忆跨任务复用。
14. Core 重启后继续执行。
15. 所有成果具备可信证据。

生成：

`docs/PHASE2_AGENT_INTELLIGENCE_REPORT.md`

`docs/PHASE2_STATUS.md`

`docs/PHASE2_EXPERIMENTS.md`

`docs/audit/phase2/verification.json`

最终报告必须明确区分真实模型验证、Mock 验证、合成实验和未完成项目。

    with store.unit_of_work() as work:
        work.connection.execute(

            (now_iso(), time.time()),
        )
        row = work.connection.execute(
            """SELECT * FROM event_inbox WHERE consumer_id='planner'
            AND event_type IN ('quest.proposed','quest.proposal_updated','quest.replan_requested') AND processed_at IS NULL AND notice_dead_at IS NULL
            AND notice_attempts<5 AND notice_next_attempt<=? ORDER BY seq LIMIT 1""",
            (time.time(),),
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return False
        notice = dict(row)
        quest = work.get_quest(notice["quest_id"])
        existing = work.connection.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM quest_plans WHERE quest_id=? AND revision=? LIMIT 1",
            (notice["quest_id"], quest["plan_revision"] if quest else -1),
        ).fetchone()
        replanning = notice["event_type"] == "quest.replan_requested"
        valid_replan = False
        if replanning and quest:
            from forge_core.adaptive_planning import remaining_replan_context

            payload = json.loads(notice["payload"])
            actual = remaining_replan_context(
                store, work.connection, quest["id"], payload.get("source_event_id")
            )
            valid_replan = actual is not None and all(
                payload.get(key) == value for key, value in actual.items()
            )
        if quest is None or (

            else quest["status"] not in {"proposed", "awaiting_approval"} or existing
        ):
            work.connection.execute(
                "UPDATE event_inbox SET processed_at=? WHERE consumer_id='planner' AND event_id=?",
                (now_iso(), notice["event_id"]),
            )
            return True
        attempts = notice["notice_attempts"] + 1
        notice_token = REDACTED
        work.connection.execute(
            "UPDATE event_inbox SET notice_attempts=?,notice_next_attempt=?,notice_token=REDACTED WHERE consumer_id='planner' AND event_id=?",
            (
                attempts,
                time.time() + 2 * _stage_call_timeout() + 15,
                notice_token,
                notice["event_id"],
            ),
        )
    try:
        with store.connection() as connection:
            connection.execute("BEGIN")
            snapshot = router._snapshot(connection)

        if getattr(router.provider, "execution_mode", None) == "mock":

        else:
            source = profile.structured_output_support.source
        await asyncio.wait_for(
            quest_graph.generate(
                notice["quest_id"],
                expected_version=quest["version"],
                provider=router.provider,
                model_id=router.model_id,

                capabilities={"json_schema": True},
                capability_sources={"json_schema": source},
                operator_max_total_tokens=model_budget.token_limit or None,
                require_capacity_contract=True,
                remaining_dag=replanning,
                source_event_id=notice["event_id"],
                source_event_token=REDACTED,
                context_limit=min(router.context_limit, profile.context_window)
                if profile and profile.context_window
                else router.context_limit,
                output_limit=min(8192, profile.max_output_tokens)
                if profile and profile.max_output_tokens
                else 8192,
            ),
            timeout=2 * _stage_call_timeout(),
        )
        return True
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - preserve a non-sensitive bounded failure record
        busy = isinstance(exc, ProviderError) and exc.code == "concurrency_unavailable"
        with store.unit_of_work() as work:

                (

                    now_iso() if not busy and attempts >= 5 else None,
                    notice["event_id"],

import json

from .domain import DomainError


def remaining_replan_context(store, connection, quest_id, source_event_id):
    """Offer remaining planning only for a stopped approved, partially done DAG."""
    from .quest_graph import QuestGraphService

    quest = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM quests WHERE id=?", (quest_id,)).fetchone()
    event = connection.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM events WHERE id=? AND quest_id=?", (source_event_id, quest_id)
    ).fetchone()
    if (
        quest is None
        or quest["status"] not in {"blocked", "needs_input", "paused"}
        or event is None
        or event["event_type"] not in {"worker.blocked", "worker.help_requested", "worker.failed"}
    ):
        return None
    try:
        parent = QuestGraphService._remaining_parent(connection, quest)
    except DomainError:
        return None
    payload = json.loads(event["payload"])
    run = connection.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM worker_runs WHERE id=? AND quest_id=? AND worker_id=?",
        (payload.get("run_id"), quest_id, event["worker_id"]),
    ).fetchone()
    if (
        run is None
        or run["plan_id"] != parent["id"]
        or run["state"] not in {"blocked", "failed"}
        or payload.get("plan_id") != parent["id"]
        or payload.get("task_node_key") != run["node_key"]
        or connection.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM quest_plans WHERE quest_id=? AND status='proposed' LIMIT 1", (quest_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        or connection.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM team_proposals WHERE quest_id=? AND plan_revision=? "
            "AND status='proposed' LIMIT 1",
            (quest_id, parent["revision"]),
        ).fetchone()
    ):
        return None
    nodes = connection.execute(
        "SELECT node_key,status FROM task_nodes WHERE plan_id=? ORDER BY node_key", (parent["id"],)
    ).fetchall()
    completed = [row["node_key"] for row in nodes if row["status"] == "succeeded"]
    if not completed or all(row["status"] == "succeeded" for row in nodes):
        return None
    return {
        "parent_plan_id": parent["id"],
        "parent_digest": parent["digest"],
        "parent_revision": parent["revision"],
        "source_event_id": source_event_id,
        "completed_node_keys": completed,
        "failed_node_key": run["node_key"],
        "instruction": "replan_remaining requests a new proposal only. Completed evidence, all counters and original task ceilings remain. The user must approve the replacement plan and team before execution.",
    }

"""Exactly-once local accounting; settled usage never authorizes a response."""

import json

from .domain import DomainError, now_iso

_CONTEXT_FIELDS = (
    "quest_id",
    "worker_id",
    "plan_id",
    "node_key",
    "plan_revision",
    "plan_digest",
    "team_digest",
)


def _json(value):
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)


def reserve_worker_model_call(connection, row, call_id, reserve, output_limit, cost, ledgers):
    """Bind the local increment in the caller's same write transaction."""
    context = {key: row[key] for key in _CONTEXT_FIELDS}
    context["workspace_id"] = connection.execute(
        "SELECT id FROM workspace WHERE singleton=1"
    ).fetchone()[0]
    scopes = [{key: ledger[key] for key in ("scope", "scope_id", "currency")} for ledger in ledgers]
    connection.execute(
        "INSERT INTO worker_model_reservations(call_id,run_id,generation,lease_token,provider_id,"
        "model_id,execution_mode,reserved_tokens,output_limit,reserved_cost_microunits,currency,"
        "price_bounds_json,cost_scopes_json,context_json,state,created_at) "
        "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'reserved',?)",
        (
            call_id,
            row["id"],
            row["generation"],
            row["lease_token"],
            row["provider_id"],
            row["model_id"],
            row["execution_mode"],
            reserve,
            output_limit,
            cost,
            row["currency"],
            row["price_bounds_json"],
            _json(scopes),
            _json(context),
            now_iso(),
        ),
    )


def _bound_run(connection, record):
    row = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM worker_runs WHERE id=?", (record["run_id"],)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None
    context = json.loads(record["context_json"])
    workspace = connection.execute("SELECT id FROM workspace WHERE singleton=1").fetchone()
    if (
        set(context) != {*_CONTEXT_FIELDS, "workspace_id"}
        or workspace is None
        or context["workspace_id"] != workspace[0]
        or any(context[key] != row[key] for key in _CONTEXT_FIELDS)
        or any(
            record[key] != row[key]
            for key in ("provider_id", "model_id", "execution_mode", "currency")
        )
        or row["generation"] < record["generation"]
    ):
        return None
    return row


def _usage(record, value):
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return None
    inp, out = value.get("input_tokens"), value.get("output_tokens")
    if (
        type(inp) is not int
        or type(out) is not int
        or not 0 <= inp <= record["reserved_tokens"] - record["output_limit"]
        or not 0 <= out <= record["output_limit"]
    ):
        return None
    return inp, out


def _gateway_usage(connection, record, row):
    attempts = connection.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM model_budget_attempts WHERE call_id=?", (record["call_id"],)
    ).fetchall()
    if len(attempts) != 1:
        return None, bool(attempts)
    attempt = attempts[0]
    context = json.loads(record["context_json"])
    if (
        attempt["state"] != "settled"
        or attempt["purpose"] != "worker"
        or attempt["workspace_id"] != context["workspace_id"]
        or attempt["quest_id"] != row["quest_id"]
        or attempt["worker_run_id"] != row["id"]
        or attempt["provider_id"] != record["provider_id"]
        or attempt["model_id"] != record["model_id"]
    ):
        return None, True
    value = _usage(
        record,
        {"input_tokens": attempt["input_charged"], "output_tokens": attempt["output_charged"]},
    )
    if (
        value is None
        or value[0] > attempt["input_reserved"]
        or value[1] > attempt["output_reserved"]
    ):
        return None, True
    if record["reserved_cost_microunits"] is not None:
        price = json.loads(record["price_bounds_json"])
        if (
            attempt["currency"] != record["currency"]
            or attempt["input_price"] != price["input_microunits_per_million"]
            or attempt["output_price"] != price["output_microunits_per_million"]

import json

from .domain import DomainError, now_iso

_CONTEXT_FIELDS = (
    "quest_id",
    "worker_id",
    "plan_id",
    "node_key",
    "plan_revision",
    "plan_digest",
    "team_digest",
)


def _json(value):
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)


def reserve_worker_model_call(connection, row, call_id, reserve, output_limit, cost, ledgers):
    """Bind the local increment in the caller's same write transaction."""
    context = {key: row[key] for key in _CONTEXT_FIELDS}
    context["workspace_id"] = connection.execute(
        "SELECT id FROM workspace WHERE singleton=1"
    ).fetchone()[0]
    scopes = [{key: ledger[key] for key in ("scope", "scope_id", "currency")} for ledger in ledgers]
    connection.execute(
        "INSERT INTO worker_model_reservations(call_id,run_id,generation,lease_token,provider_id,"
        "model_id,execution_mode,reserved_tokens,output_limit,reserved_cost_microunits,currency,"
        "price_bounds_json,cost_scopes_json,context_json,state,created_at) "
        "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'reserved',?)",
        (
            call_id,
            row["id"],
            row["generation"],
            row["lease_token"],
            row["provider_id"],
            row["model_id"],
            row["execution_mode"],
            reserve,
            output_limit,
            cost,
            row["currency"],
            row["price_bounds_json"],
            _json(scopes),
            _json(context),
            now_iso(),
        ),
    )


def _bound_run(connection, record):
    row = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM worker_runs WHERE id=?", (record["run_id"],)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None
    context = json.loads(record["context_json"])
    workspace = connection.execute("SELECT id FROM workspace WHERE singleton=1").fetchone()
    if (
        set(context) != {*_CONTEXT_FIELDS, "workspace_id"}
        or workspace is None
        or context["workspace_id"] != workspace[0]
        or any(context[key] != row[key] for key in _CONTEXT_FIELDS)
        or any(
            record[key] != row[key]
            for key in ("provider_id", "model_id", "execution_mode", "currency")
        )
        or row["generation"] < record["generation"]
    ):
        return None
    return row


def _usage(record, value):
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return None
    inp, out = value.get("input_tokens"), value.get("output_tokens")
    if (
        type(inp) is not int
        or type(out) is not int
        or not 0 <= inp <= record["reserved_tokens"] - record["output_limit"]
        or not 0 <= out <= record["output_limit"]
    ):
        return None
    return inp, out


def _gateway_usage(connection, record, row):
    attempts = connection.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM model_budget_attempts WHERE call_id=?", (record["call_id"],)
    ).fetchall()
    if len(attempts) != 1:
        return None, bool(attempts)
    attempt = attempts[0]

        or attempt["worker_run_id"] != row["id"]

    ):

    )

        or value[0] > attempt["input_reserved"]
        or value[1] > attempt["output_reserved"]
    ):
        return None, True

"""Phase 2 live Core harness: spawn an isolated Core, authenticate, drive the API.

Credential handling: the provider key is read from a process environment variable
named by FORGE_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_REF. Nothing secret is written to disk or logs.

import hashlib

import os

import time
from pathlib import Path

import httpx

def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class LiveCore:
    def __init__(
        self, workspace, *, provider_env, token_limit, concurrency, log=None, extra_env=None
    ):
        self.workspace = Path(workspace)
        self.workspace.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.port = free_port()
        self.secret = REDACTED
        self.base_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}"
        self.session = None
        self.bearer = None
        self.process = None
        self.provider_env = provider_env
        self.token_limit = token_limit
        self.concurrency = concurrency
        self.log_path = log or self.workspace / "core.log"
        self.extra_env = extra_env or {}
        self.stdout = None

    def env(self):
        raw = bytes.fromhex(self.secret)
        assert len(raw) == 32
        values = {
            "FORGE_WORKSPACE_ROOT": str(self.workspace),
            "FORGE_DB_PATH": "data/forge.sqlite3",
            "FORGE_HOST": "127.0.0.1",
            "FORGE_PORT": str(self.port),
            "FORGE_CORE_SECRET": self.secret,
            "FORGE_ROUTER_MODEL_ID": MODEL_ID,
            "FORGE_ROUTER_CONTEXT_LIMIT": "65536",
            "FORGE_ROUTER_OUTPUT_RESERVE": "4096",
            "FORGE_WORKER_LEASE_SECONDS": "150",
            "FORGE_REVIEW_MAX_ROUNDS": "3",
            "FORGE_MODEL_TOKEN_LIMIT": str(self.token_limit),
            "FORGE_MODEL_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT": str(self.concurrency),
            "PYTHONIOENCODING": "utf-8",
            "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
        }
        values.update(self.provider_env)
        values.update(self.extra_env)
        base = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("FORGE_")}
        base.update(values)
        return base

    def start(self, timeout=120):
        # Kept open for the child lifetime and closed by stop(), including failures.
        self.stdout = open(self.log_path, "ab")  # noqa: SIM115
        env = self.env()
        creation = 0
        if os.name == "nt":
            creation = subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW
        self.process = subprocess.Popen(
            [str(PYTHON), "-m", "forge_api", "--workspace-root", str(self.workspace)],
            cwd=str(BACKEND),
            env=env,
            stdout=self.stdout,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            creationflags=creation,
        )
        deadline = time.time() + timeout
        while time.time() < deadline:
            if self.process.poll() is not None:
                raise RuntimeError("Core exited during startup")
            try:
                response = httpx.get(self.base_url + "/health", timeout=2, trust_env=False)
                if response.status_code == 200:
                    self.session = response.json()["session"]
                    raw = bytes.fromhex(self.secret)
                    self.bearer = hmac.new(raw, self.session.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
                    return self
            except (httpx.TransportError, httpx.TimeoutException):
                pass
            time.sleep(0.25)
        raise RuntimeError("Core did not become healthy")

    def client(self, timeout=240):
        return httpx.Client(
            base_url=self.base_url,
            headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + self.bearer},
            timeout=httpx.Timeout(connect=5, read=timeout, write=10, pool=5),
            trust_env=False,
            follow_redirects=False,
        )

    def call(self, method, path, payload=None, timeout=240):
        with self.client(timeout=timeout) as client:
            response = client.request(method, path, json=payload)
        try:
            body = response.json()
        except ValueError:
            body = {"raw": response.text[:400]}
        return {"status": response.status_code, "body": body}

    def stop(self, *, graceful=True):
        if self.process is None:
            return
        if self.process.poll() is None:
            if graceful:
                self.process.terminate()
            else:
                self.process.kill()
            try:
                self.process.wait(timeout=30)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                self.process.kill()
                self.process.wait(timeout=15)
        if self.stdout:
            self.stdout.close()
            self.stdout = None

    def tail_log(self, limit=4000):
        if not self.log_path.exists():
            return ""
        data = self.log_path.read_bytes()[-limit:]
        return data.decode("utf-8", "replace")

"""Router consumes actual bounded semantic selections; lexical retrieval remains."""

import asyncio
import json

from test_router_intelligence_phase2 import ScriptedMock, decision

from forge_core.domain import Quest
from forge_core.registry import ModelRegistry, TeamComposer
from forge_core.router import RouterService
from forge_core.runtime import ModelResponse
from forge_core.settings import Workspace
from forge_core.store import Store


class RouterSelector:
    execution_mode = "mock"

    def __init__(self, selected, final=None):
        self.selected, self.final = selected, final or decision()
        self.requests = []

    async def generate(self, request):
        self.requests.append(request)
        if request.budget_context.purpose == "memory_semantic_retrieval":
            candidates = json.loads(request.messages[1]["content"])["candidates"]
            result = {"candidate_ids": [self.selected] if self.selected in candidates else []}
        else:
            result = self.final
        return ModelResponse(text=json.dumps(result), tool_calls=[], usage={}, finish_reason="mock")


def prepared(tmp_path, provider):
    store = Store(tmp_path / "router.sqlite3", workspace=Workspace.from_path(tmp_path))
    router = RouterService(
        store,
        TeamComposer(ModelRegistry(store)),
        provider=provider,
        model_id="explicit-mock",
        context_limit=65536,
        semantic_recall=True,
    )
    return store, router


def test_router_includes_zero_overlap_semantic_memory_with_original_trust(tmp_path):
    provider = RouterSelector("placeholder")
    _, router = prepared(tmp_path, provider)
    identity = router.memory_service.remember(
        "Never disclose passwords or credentials in logs.",
        kind="decision",
        layer="L2",
        source_refs=["message:earlier"],
        status="hypothesis",
    )
    provider.selected = "memory:" + identity
    query = "How should we avoid spilling confidential material?"
    assert router.memory_service.retrieve_context(query)["items"] == []
    result = asyncio.run(router.handle_user_message(query, request_id="semantic"))
    assert result["intent"] == "chat"
    assert len(provider.requests) == 2
    actual = json.loads(provider.requests[-1].messages[1]["content"])
    assert actual["semantic_recall"]["status"] == "selected"
    item = next(item for item in actual["memory"] if item["id"] == identity)
    assert item["status"] == "hypothesis" and item["source_refs"] == ["message:earlier"]


def test_semantic_task_identity_can_reopen_an_older_quest(tmp_path):
    provider = RouterSelector("placeholder")
    store, router = prepared(tmp_path, provider)
    target = Quest(title="Nebula", goal="Construct a safe priority queue")
    store.save_quest(target)
    with store.unit_of_work() as work:
        work.connection.execute("UPDATE quests SET status='completed' WHERE id=?", (target.id,))
    for index in range(3):
        store.save_quest(Quest(title=f"Recent unrelated {index}", goal="Other work"))
    router._sync_memory()
    provider.selected = "quest:" + target.id
    provider.final = decision("continue_quest", quest_id=target.id, candidates=[target.id])
    query = "Resume the starvation resistant scheduling exploration"
    with store.connection() as connection:
        assert target.id not in {row["id"] for row in router._snapshot(connection, query)["quests"]}
    result = asyncio.run(router.handle_user_message(query, request_id="old-semantic"))
    seen = json.loads(provider.requests[-1].messages[1]["content"])
    assert result["intent"] == "continue_quest" and result["quest_id"] == target.id, json.dumps(
        {
            "target": target.id,
            "semantic": seen.get("semantic_recall"),
            "quests": [item["id"] for item in seen.get("quests", [])],
            "memory": [
                {"id": item["id"], "related": item["related_quest_ids"]}
                for item in seen.get("memory", [])
            ],
        }
    )
    assert len(provider.requests) == 2

"""Serial admission preserves the original cap, complete cycles and future work."""

import copy

import pytest
from pydantic import ValidationError
from test_planner_capacity_v17 import handoff_graph
from test_router_intelligence_phase2 import ScriptedMock
from test_verified_capacity_v16 import generate, prepared

from forge_core.budget_policy import serial_start_allowance, validate_serial_policy
from forge_core.domain import DomainError
from forge_core.graph_domain import GraphProposal
from forge_core.model_call_budget import ModelCallBudgetLedger
from forge_core.provider_pool import ProviderPool
from forge_core.providers import ProviderConfig, ProviderGateway
from forge_core.quest_graph import QuestGraphService
from forge_core.runtime import ModelCallContext
from forge_core.team_composition import TeamCompositionService


def serial_graph():
    data = handoff_graph()
    data.update(
        max_total_tokens=180000,
        coordination_reserve_tokens=18000,
        serial_capacity_policy={"version": "serial-capacity-v1", "shared_reserve_tokens": 100000},
    )
    for node in data["nodes"]:
        node["budget_tokens"] = 25000
    return data


def serial_team(tmp_path):
    store, quest = prepared(
        tmp_path,
        content='Assess inputs/unicode.json. Task execution limits: {"max_total_tokens":180000,"max_nodes":2,"max_members":2}',
    )
    graph = serial_graph()
    plan = generate(store, quest, ScriptedMock(graph))
    service = QuestGraphService(store)
    service.approve(quest.id, plan["digest"], 1, expected_version=1, actor="local_user")
    gateway = ProviderGateway(
        ProviderConfig(
            id="p",
            kind="openai_compatible",
            base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8788/v1",
            credential_ref="FORGE_PROVIDER_KEY_TEST",
            allow_insecure_loopback=True,
            supports_tools=True,
            supports_json_schema=True,
        )
    )
    teams = TeamCompositionService(store, capacity_providers=ProviderPool({"p": gateway}))
    roles = [
        {
            "id": "research" if node["key"] == "n0" else "reviewer",
            "task_node_key": node["key"],
            "tools": node["allowed_tools"],
            "input_tokens": 22952,
            "output_tokens": 2048,
        }
        for node in graph["nodes"]
    ]
    tools = sorted({tool for node in graph["nodes"] for tool in node["allowed_tools"]})
    limits = {
        "max_members": 2,
        "max_depth": 1,
        "max_concurrency": 1,
        "max_total_tokens": 150000,
        "allowed_tools": tools,
    }
    team = teams.propose(quest.id, roles, limits, strategy="greedy", expected_version=2)
    teams.approve(quest.id, 1, team["proposal_digest"], expected_version=2, actor="local_user")
    ledger = ModelCallBudgetLedger(store.path, token_limit=180000, concurrency_limit=1)
    return store, quest, plan, team, roles, limits, teams, ledger


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "mutation", ["branch", "cycle_component", "failure", "cost", "overcap", "unknown_version"]
)
def test_serial_policy_is_explicit_token_only_connected_chain(mutation):
    graph = serial_graph()
    if mutation == "branch":
        graph["nodes"].append({**graph["nodes"][1], "key": "third"})
        graph["edges"].append({"source": "n0", "target": "third", "condition": "success"})
    elif mutation == "cycle_component":
        graph["nodes"].extend([{**graph["nodes"][0], "key": key} for key in ("c", "d")])
        graph["edges"].extend(
            [
                {"source": "c", "target": "d", "condition": "success"},
                {"source": "d", "target": "c", "condition": "success"},
            ]
        )
    elif mutation == "failure":
        graph["edges"][0]["condition"] = "failure"
    elif mutation == "cost":
        graph.update(max_cost_microunits=100, cost_currency="USD")
    elif mutation == "overcap":
        graph["serial_capacity_policy"]["shared_reserve_tokens"] = 170000
    else:
        graph["serial_capacity_policy"]["version"] = "serial-unbounded"
    with pytest.raises(DomainError):
        validate_serial_policy(graph)


def test_serial_plan_and_team_share_one_reserve_without_relabeling_baselines(tmp_path):
    store, quest, plan, team, _roles, _limits, _teams, ledger = serial_team(tmp_path)
    assert sum(node["budget_tokens"] for node in plan["nodes"]) == 50000
    assert sum(member["estimated_tokens"] for member in team["members"]) == 50000
    assert all(member["execution_token_limit"] == 125000 for member in team["members"])
    assert team["limits"]["max_total_tokens"] == 150000
    with store.unit_of_work() as work:
        row = work.connection.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM quest_plans WHERE id=?", (plan["id"],)
        ).fetchone()
        allowance = serial_start_allowance(
            store,
            work.connection,
            work.get_quest(quest.id),
            row,
            plan["nodes"][0],
            team["members"][0],
            ledger,
        )
        assert allowance["baseline_tokens"] == 25000
        assert allowance["shared_reserve_tokens"] == 100000
        assert allowance["future_baseline_tokens"] == 25000
        assert 25000 <= allowance["execution_token_limit"] <= 125000
        assert (
            allowance["minimum_current_cycle"]
            >= team["members"][0]["capacity_preflight"]["minimum_node_tokens"]
        )


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["unknown", "opening", "member", "future_baseline", "ledger"])
def test_serial_admission_fails_closed_without_refunding_original_ledger(tmp_path, mutation):
    store, quest, plan, team, _roles, _limits, _teams, ledger = serial_team(tmp_path)
    member = copy.deepcopy(team["members"][0])
    if mutation == "unknown":
        ledger.admit(
            ModelCallContext(
                call_id="unknown",
                purpose="planner",
                workspace_id=store.workspace.id,
                quest_id=quest.id,
            ),
            "p",
            "big",
            input_tokens=100,
            output_tokens=100,
            remote_timeout=1,
        )
    elif mutation in {"opening", "future_baseline"}:
        with store.unit_of_work() as work:
            work.connection.execute(
                "INSERT INTO model_budget_opening VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                ("opening", store.workspace.id, quest.id, 100000, None, None),
            )
    elif mutation == "member":
        member["execution_token_limit"] += 1
    else:
        ledger = ModelCallBudgetLedger(store.path, token_limit=1000000, concurrency_limit=1)
    with store.unit_of_work() as work:
        before = work.connection.total_changes
        row = work.connection.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM quest_plans WHERE id=?", (plan["id"],)
        ).fetchone()
        with pytest.raises(DomainError):
            serial_start_allowance(
                store,
                work.connection,
                work.get_quest(quest.id),
                row,
                plan["nodes"][0],
                member,
                ledger,
            )
        assert work.connection.total_changes == before


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["parallel", "partial_baseline", "unfunded_pool", "cost"])
def test_serial_team_cannot_weaken_approved_policy(tmp_path, mutation):
    store, quest, _plan, _team, roles, limits, teams, _ledger = serial_team(tmp_path)
    if mutation == "parallel":
        limits["max_concurrency"] = 2
    elif mutation == "partial_baseline":

        teams.propose(
            quest.id,
            roles,
            limits,
            strategy="greedy",
            expected_version=store.get_quest(quest.id)["version"],
        )


def test_ordinary_graph_sum_contract_is_unchanged():
    graph = serial_graph()
    graph.pop("serial_capacity_policy")
    for node in graph["nodes"]:
        node["required_capabilities"] = {}
        node["budget_tokens"] = 100000
    with pytest.raises((ValidationError, DomainError)):
        GraphProposal.model_validate(graph)

def handoff_graph():
    graph = capacity_graph()
    graph.update(max_total_tokens=360000, coordination_reserve_tokens=36000)
    first = graph["nodes"][0]
    first.update(budget_tokens=140000, required_predecessor_deliveries=[])
    second = copy.deepcopy(first)
    second.update(
        key="reader",
        objective="Independently assess the complete approved predecessor findings.",
        required_input_paths=[],
        required_predecessor_deliveries=[first["key"]],
        allowed_tools=["worker_read_completed_delivery"],
        capacity_bounds={
            "max_source_receipt_bytes": 8192,
            "max_artifact_bytes": 1,
            "max_delivery_bytes": 3072,
        },
    )
    graph["nodes"].append(second)
    graph["edges"] = [{"source": first["key"], "target": "reader", "condition": "success"}]
    return graph


@pytest.mark.parametrize("wire", [GraphWire, CapacityGraphWire])
def test_all_exposed_wire_properties_are_required_without_defaults(wire):
    schema = wire.model_json_schema()
    objects = [schema, *schema["$defs"].values()]
    for value in objects:
        if value.get("type") == "object":
            assert set(value["properties"]) == set(value["required"])
            assert all("default" not in field for field in value["properties"].values())


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["missing_edge", "failure_edge", "duplicate", "missing_tool"])
def test_handoff_contract_requires_direct_success_edge_and_explicit_tool(mutation):
    raw = handoff_graph()
    if mutation == "missing_edge":
        raw["edges"] = []
    elif mutation == "failure_edge":
        raw["edges"][0]["condition"] = "failure"
    elif mutation == "duplicate":
        raw["nodes"][1]["required_predecessor_deliveries"] *= 2
    else:
        raw["nodes"][1]["allowed_tools"] = []
    for node in raw["nodes"]:
        node["required_capabilities"] = {}
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        GraphProposal.model_validate(raw)

"""Native HTTP/Gateway serial integration; scripted local server, no real model."""

import asyncio
import json
from dataclasses import replace

import pytest
from test_predecessor_delivery_v17 import offline_loopback_gateway
from test_serial_capacity_v17 import serial_team
from test_worker_intelligence_phase2 import delivery

from forge_core.domain import DomainError
from forge_core.evidence import CompletionGate, NodeVerifier
from forge_core.governance import GovernanceService
from forge_core.independent_review import IndependentReviewService
from forge_core.model_call_budget import ModelCallBudgetLedger
from forge_core.provider_pool import ProviderPool
from forge_core.store import Store
from forge_core.team_composition import TeamCompositionService
from forge_core.tool_engine import ToolEngine
from forge_core.worker_runtime import WorkerManager


def canonical(value):
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))


@pytest.mark.parametrize("tamper", [False, True])
def test_native_serial_two_nodes_reopen_keep_one_pool_and_original_cap(tmp_path, tamper):
    store, quest, plan, team, _roles, _limits, _teams, _ledger = serial_team(tmp_path)
    GovernanceService(store).grant_workspace(quest.id, "inputs", "local_user")
    first_delivery = delivery("Complete original producer findings and source reference.")
    first_delivery["findings"] = ["中文 source is retained whole; no model result substitutes evidence."]

    def responder(body, ordinal):
        if ordinal in {1, 4}:
            name = "file_read" if ordinal == 1 else "worker_read_completed_delivery"
            arguments = {"path": "inputs/unicode.json"} if ordinal == 1 else {"node_key": "n0"}
            return {"content": None, "tool_calls": [{"id": f"native-{ordinal}", "type": "function", "function": {"name": name, "arguments": canonical(arguments)}}]}
        if ordinal in {2, 5}:
            return {"content": canonical(first_delivery if ordinal == 2 else delivery("Independently checked predecessor findings."))}
        assert ordinal in {3, 6} and not body.get("tools")
        return {"content": canonical({"verdict": "PASS", "findings": [], "revision_goals": [], "confidence": 0.8})}

    with offline_loopback_gateway(store, responder) as (gateway, requests):
        # Reuse the native local HTTP server without overriding execution mode
        # or manufacturing attempts/settlements. Match the approved fixture ID.
        gateway.config = replace(gateway.config, id="p")
        gateway._budget_ledger = ModelCallBudgetLedger(store.path, token_limit=180000, concurrency_limit=1)
        assert gateway.execution_mode == "live"
        providers = ProviderPool({"p": gateway})
        teams = TeamCompositionService(store, capacity_providers=providers, budget_ledger=gateway.budget_ledger)
        manager = WorkerManager(store, providers, ToolEngine(store), team_authority=teams, global_token_limit=180000)
        first = manager.start(quest.id, plan["id"], "n0", team_digest=team["proposal_digest"], member_index=0)
        assert first["token_limit"] == 125000
        with pytest.raises(DomainError):
            manager.start(quest.id, plan["id"], "reader", team_digest=team["proposal_digest"], member_index=1)
        if tamper:
            with store.unit_of_work() as work:
                row = work.connection.execute("SELECT capsule_json FROM worker_capsules WHERE run_id=?", (first["id"],)).fetchone()
                capsule = json.loads(row[0])
                capsule["serial_start_allowance"]["execution_token_limit"] -= 1
                work.connection.execute("UPDATE worker_capsules SET capsule_json=? WHERE run_id=?", (canonical(capsule), first["id"]))
            with pytest.raises(DomainError):
                asyncio.run(manager.run(first["id"]))
            assert requests == []
            return
        assert asyncio.run(manager.run(first["id"]))["state"] == "review_pending"
        assert asyncio.run(IndependentReviewService(manager).review(first["id"]))["verdict"] == "PASS"
        NodeVerifier(store).verify(quest.id, "n0")
        assert manager.get(first["id"])["state"] == "succeeded"
        with store.connection() as connection:
            original_pools = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute("SELECT * FROM worker_budget_ledger WHERE scope='serial_reserve' ORDER BY scope_id")]
            assert len(original_pools) == 3
            assert all(row["tokens_allocated"] == 100000 for row in original_pools)
            original_attempts = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute("SELECT * FROM model_budget_attempts ORDER BY created_at")]
        reopened = Store(store.path, workspace=store.workspace)
        teams = TeamCompositionService(reopened, capacity_providers=providers, budget_ledger=gateway.budget_ledger)
        resumed = WorkerManager(reopened, providers, ToolEngine(reopened), team_authority=teams, global_token_limit=180000)
        second = resumed.start(quest.id, plan["id"], "reader", team_digest=team["proposal_digest"], member_index=1)
        assert second["token_limit"] == first["token_limit"] == 125000
        assert asyncio.run(resumed.run(second["id"]))["state"] == "review_pending"
        assert asyncio.run(IndependentReviewService(resumed).review(second["id"]))["verdict"] == "PASS"
        assert NodeVerifier(reopened).verify(quest.id, "reader")["status"] == "completed"
        assert len(requests) == 6
        tool_message = next(item for item in requests[4]["messages"] if item["role"] == "tool")
        assert json.loads(tool_message["content"])["delivery"] == first_delivery
        with reopened.connection() as connection:
            connection.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
            connection.execute("BEGIN")
            attempts = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute("SELECT * FROM model_budget_attempts ORDER BY created_at")]
            assert attempts[:3] == original_attempts
            assert len(attempts) == 6 and all(row["state"] == "settled" for row in attempts)
            assert sum(row["input_charged"] + row["output_charged"] for row in attempts) == 240 < 180000
            assert all(row["input_charged"] is not None and row["output_charged"] is not None for row in attempts)
            pools = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute("SELECT * FROM worker_budget_ledger WHERE scope='serial_reserve' ORDER BY scope_id")]
            assert pools == original_pools
            allocations = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM worker_budget_ledger WHERE scope IN ('global','quest','team')").fetchall()
            assert len(allocations) == 3
            assert all(row["tokens_allocated"] == 150000 <= row["token_limit"] <= 180000 for row in allocations)
            runs = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM worker_runs ORDER BY created_at").fetchall()
            assert len(runs) == 2 and sum(row["token_spent"] for row in runs) == 240
            assert all(row["state"] == "succeeded" and row["execution_mode"] == "live" for row in runs)
            work = type("ReadWork", (), {"connection": connection})()
            CompletionGate(reopened).check(work, connection.execute("SELECT * FROM quests WHERE id=?", (quest.id,)).fetchone())
            assert connection.total_changes == 0

## Required Phase 2 acceptance

1. Preserve one persistent user-facing Router/conversation and private native Workers.
2. Require valid original-request/constraint sources, bounded schemas and explicit authenticated plan/team/replacement approval. Default Review remains enabled.
3. Admit every model attempt through the durable Gateway token/concurrency ledger; retain unknown usage/effects and never infer remote cancellation from a timeout.
4. Enforce tool policy, current grants, exact approvals, durable intents, receipts and execution-mode provenance. Mock records cannot prove live completion.
5. Bind fresh review verdicts to original criteria, actual artifacts/receipts and the latest delivery. `NEEDS_REVISION` must contain actionable goals and stay within cumulative budgets and round limits.
6. Recheck approval history/current bindings, artifact hashes, tool results and applicable fixed semantic verifiers at completion. A model PASS or JSON syntax alone does not establish domain correctness.
7. Record L1/L2/L3 live metrics and independently inspect artifacts. Demonstrate observed failure/repair, review revision, actual archive/readback and Core restart boundaries rather than inferring them from records or directory names.
8. Run checks against the final source snapshot and preserve failed attempts and historical evidence. A complex live task must satisfy the intended continuity condition before Phase 2 is declared complete.
9. Permit artifact replacement only with explicitly approved `file_revise`, the same current Worker's latest successful receipt chain, unchanged file hash and current workspace grant. Recheck the chain and latest bytes at review/completion; retain immutable prior versions. Existing create-only contracts gain no permission.
10. Keep parser/fixed-suite revision feedback distinguishable from LLM review or PASS. Bind semantic failure to the actual suite/report/source/receipt and latest delivery, require explicit revision authority and remaining original budgets with no unresolved actions/calls, and rerun the real suite after repair. Charge settled truncated reviews before bounded retry; never reset cumulative budgets or replay unknown remote outcomes. Lease renewal must retain fencing, current authority and the original task deadline.

## Known limits

V7 guidance covers new intermediate JSON artifacts and delivery_review handoffs with downstream consumers
toward about 4 KiB (at most 6 KiB) only when all assigned requirements fit. Complete code, final reports
and required detailed schemas remain full even when larger. This is soft writing
guidance: no stored artifact is truncated, no hard report-size gate is added, and
original packet/PASS/source/raw/context/evidence requirements remain unchanged.
Planner guidance recommends about two model contexts of cumulative allocation for
a source-heavy entry node, when the task ceiling permits, and at least ten percent
coordination reserve within the original total. V8 removes the fixed intermediate-output
preference and preserves enough per-call output for complete schema-valid tool
arguments and delivery. Shared source citation IDs avoid repeating full hashes while
preserving exact references.
New/replacement team proposals and approval enforce a trusted operator concurrency
cap; existing approved teams and historical evidence retain their contracts. Core
supplies Composer and WorkerManager the Worker concurrency cap `2`, independently
of the Gateway model-call concurrency cap. Both resource limits remain enforced.
The live harness takes the smaller CLI/scenario total-token and concurrency limits
and records the effective values. V8–v12 full/live outcomes are recorded; this round's final state remains partial; see the v12 evidence record.


For new native TeamWire proposals, only explicit `output_schema_json=null`
selects a deep copy of `STRICT_DELIVERY_OUTPUT_SCHEMA`: the model must supply
all eight delivery fields and confidence within 0–1, with no Core-inserted defaults.
The contract is checked under any node criterion through JSON Schema and bounded
repair. Legacy/default direct RoleSpec contracts and explicit older schemas retain
their original meaning; historical approvals/results are unchanged. Non-finite
JSON values are rejected through the existing bounded repair path. Strict structure
does not establish semantic correctness or replace review/evidence gates.

V8 removes the intermediate output_tokens=2048 preference: per-call output must
fit complete schema-valid tool arguments and delivery. Worker instructions cover
the current node's approved objective, role and criteria; downstream nodes retain
their own deliverables. Planner guidance uses one node only when the entire task
is simple read-only analysis and preserves explicitly requested specialist/count
requirements. Composer guidance preserves unique role IDs and correct specialties,
and prefers max_steps=16 only when the user's ceiling permits. Native Core configures
a shared self-repair/review-revision maximum of four; existing counters, original
steps/tokens/tools/cost/time and review-round limits still bind every attempt.
Worker concurrency two remains independent of Gateway model-call concurrency.

V9 rejects a generated node with a concrete artifact verifier unless that same
node already permits `file_write`; feedback uses the original bounded Planner
schema-repair path and inserts no tool authority. Worker requests with an effective per-request allowance ≥8192 show remaining
model steps, tool calls and cumulative tokens, and point to integrity-bound archived
source_refs/current artifact receipts. This guides reuse of evidence without
assuming the repeated-read cause is proved. A tool batch exceeding remaining calls
is rejected before any tool executes and may use the existing bounded repair path;
the settled model attempt stays charged. Original tool/step/token/cost/time and
repair/round limits remain unchanged. Publisher adds numeric retry totals/breakdown
and allowlisted review reason/context fields; prompt/reply/log/artifact bodies stay
excluded, and missing historical fields remain unknown/null. V9 full/live
outcomes are recorded below; V12 frozen results are recorded; whole-task complex continuity remains incomplete.

start: pragma_source | plain_source
pragma_source: PRAGMA_LINE NEWLINE SOURCE

NEWLINE: /\r?\n/
