tools.name: exec

tools.description:
Waits on a yielded `exec` cell and returns new output or completion.
- Use `wait` only after `exec` returns `Script running with cell ID ...`.
- `cell_id` identifies the running `exec` cell to resume.
- `yield_time_ms` controls how long to wait for more output before yielding again. Defaults to 10000 ms.
- `max_tokens` limits how much new output this wait call returns. Defaults to 10000 tokens.
- `terminate: true` stops the running cell; false or omitted waits for output.
- `wait` returns only the new output since the last yield, or the final completion or termination result for that cell.
- If the cell is still running, `wait` may yield again with the same `cell_id`.
- If the cell has already finished, `wait` returns the completed result and closes the cell.
tools.name: wait

cell_id.description: Identifier of the running exec cell.

max_tokens.description: Output token budget for this wait call. Defaults to 10000 tokens.

terminate.description: True stops the running exec cell; false or omitted waits for output.

yield_time_ms.description: Wait before yielding more output. Defaults to 10000 ms.

tools.description: Request user input for one to three short questions and wait for the response. This tool is only available in Plan mode.
tools.name: request_user_input

questions.description: Questions to show the user. Prefer 1 and do not exceed 3

header.description: Short header label shown in the UI (12 or fewer chars).

options.description: Provide 2-3 mutually exclusive choices. Put the recommended option first and suffix its label with "(Recommended)". Do not include an "Other" option in this list; the client will add a free-form "Other" option automatically.

description.description: One short sentence explaining impact/tradeoff if selected.

question.description: Single-sentence prompt shown to the user.

tools.description: Tools for reading and waiting on time.

tools.description: Pause execution for a specified duration. The sleep ends early when new input arrives for the active turn. Returns the elapsed wall-clock time.
tools.name: sleep

duration_ms.description: How long to sleep in milliseconds. Must be between 1 and 43200000.

        Spawns an agent to work on the specified task. If your current task is `/root/task1` and you spawn_agent with task_name "task_3" the agent will have canonical task name `/root/task1/task_3`.
You are then able to refer to this agent as `task_3` or `/root/task1/task_3` interchangeably. However an agent `/root/task2/task_3` would only be able to communicate with this agent via its canonical name `/root/task1/task_3`.
The spawned agent will have the same tools as you and the ability to spawn its own subagents.

It will be able to send you and other running agents messages, and its final answer will be provided to you when it finishes.
The new agent's canonical task name will be provided to it along with the message.

Note that passing `fork_turns="none"` will not pass any surrounding context to the spawned subagent, which may cause the agent to lack the context it needs to complete its task, whereas `fork_turns="all"` will provide the subagent with all surrounding context.

tools.description:
Control native apps or browsers on the user’s computer by reading or operating UI. Prefer purpose-built skills, connectors, APIs, or CLIs when available.

On the first invocation of `cua_repl`, or after resetting it, execute exactly one of the API calls shown below, optionally assigning its result to a variable. Do not add other API calls, waits, or snapshots to that invocation.
The tool result will include documentation and, when creating or selecting a tab or selecting an app, its initial UI state. Selecting a browser does not open a tab. Read that result before continuing.
Use only APIs described in the tool instructions or returned documentation.

When you need an inventory of available apps, browsers, and tabs, get a snapshot of all enabled surfaces. Otherwise, use the relevant entry point below:

```javascript
await cua.getState();
```

Use the first matching browser control option from the user's request:

For a tab @-mention (`mention=tab-v1`):
Pass the complete `plugin://...` URL to get the referenced tab.

```javascript
let tab = await cua.getTab({ mention: tabMentionUrl });
```

For an existing tab identified by URL in browser context (including the current IAB tab):

```javascript
let tab = await cua.getTab({ url }, { browser: browserId });
```

Known tab ID (`tabId` or `providerTabId`) and browser (name or browser @-mention):

```javascript
let tab = await cua.getTab(tabId, { browser: browserId });
```

To open a URL in the in-app browser (`@Browser`):

```javascript
let tab = await cua.createBrowserTab("iab", url, { visible: boolean });
```

To open a URL in another named browser: pass its name directly; do not call `getBrowser` first.

```javascript
let tab = await cua.createBrowserTab(browserName, url, browserOptions);
```

Known URL, only when the user has not specified a browser by name or @-mention:

```javascript
let browser = await cua.getBrowser({ url });
```

Browser IDs and options:

- `"mcpapps"`: use `cua.getBrowser({ id: "mcpapps" })` for existing full-screen MCP Apps in the task’s side panel.
- `"iab"` (in-app browser): in `createBrowserTab`, use `visible: true` to show the browser; `false` to keep it hidden.
- `"dot"` (Dot): use only when present in browser inventory. It accesses tabs on Dot's active main thread. `cua.getTab(tabId, { browser: "dot" })` selects an existing tab. `cua.createBrowserTab("dot", url, { visible: boolean })` creates one with the same visibility options as `"iab"`.
- `"chrome"` (@Chrome), `"edge"` (@Edge): pass a short, emoji-prefixed `sessionName` (e.g. `"🔎 Task"`) to `createBrowserTab` when starting a task.

On Windows, choose the requested window by app and title from the inventory. Pass the selected window's ID as returned.

```javascript
let app = await cua.getApp({ windowId: selected.id });
```

To add other content to the tool result, use `nodeRepl.write(value)` for text or other values and `await nodeRepl.emitImage(image)` for images. The APIs listed above already display their documentation or UI state; do not wrap their results in `write` or `emitImage`.

If your context begins with a summary of an existing computer use task, call `await cua.rewriteDocumentation()` before continuing the computer use task to ensure you have a complete view of the necessary documentation.

Several `cua_repl.js` calls may work toward the same goal. As soon as you observe the final outcome of the CUA part of the task, make your next tool call `cua_repl.js` with only `completion_summary`, exactly once. Do this before using another tool for the next part of the user’s request or sending your reply, even if the overall request continues. If you hand control to the user, wait to summarize until the handoff has ended and you’ve observed the final outcome of the CUA part of the task. This tool is part of plugin `unified-computer-use`.

# FORGE — Agent Intelligence Sprint
## Phase 2: From Agent Infrastructure to Autonomous Intelligence

你现在正式进入 FORGE 的下一阶段开发。

本轮不以桌面端发布为目标，而是以真正跑通自主多智能体系统为目标。

用户已经授权你使用本地配置的 Provider。你可以使用现有 Provider 进行真实模型调用、协议测试、Agent 实验和端到端任务验证。

本轮必须把重心从基础设施转移到 Agent Intelligence。

不要继续大规模开发 UI，不要优先处理安装包和 Tauri 外观问题。

核心任务是让 FORGE 真正成为一个能够长期自主工作的 Agent 系统。

---

# 一、首先重新审计当前代码

当前开发分支：

`codex/phase1-continuous`

先读取：

- docs/STATUS.md
- docs/ROADMAP.md
- docs/QUALITY_GATES.md
- docs/PRODUCT_ARCHITECTURE.md
- docs/ROUTER_AND_WORKER_PROTOCOL.md
- docs/MODEL_REGISTRY_AND_TEAM_COMPOSITION.md
- docs/CONTEXT_MEMORY_GOVERNANCE.md
- 所有 Phase 1 Milestone 报告

重点阅读源码：

- forge_core/router.py
- forge_core/worker_runtime.py
- forge_core/team_composition.py
- forge_core/quest_graph.py
- forge_core/dispatcher.py
- forge_core/context_service.py
- forge_core/memory.py
- forge_core/providers/
- forge_core/tool_engine.py
- forge_core/evidence.py
- forge_core/governance.py

先建立一份真正的 Agent 执行链路图。

区分：
1. 已经真实实现的功能。
2. 通过 Mock 验证的功能。
3. 已经通过真实 Provider 验证的功能。
4. 只有接口或数据模型的功能。
5. 目前无法端到端工作的功能。

不要重新实现已经完成的模块。

不要为了让报告好看而隐藏已有缺陷。

审计完成后直接进入开发，不需要等待用户再次批准。

# 二、本地 Provider：正式启用真实模型

用户已经允许使用本地 Provider。

要求：

1. 检查 FORGE 当前 Provider 配置。
2. 检查本地 Provider 服务是否可用。
3. 获取可用模型列表。
4. 检查模型的 Tool Calling、Structured Output、Streaming 能力。
5. 检查模型实际上下文和输出限制。
6. 检查 Token 预算和并发限制。
7. 运行真实模型的最小对话测试。
8. 运行真实模型的 Router 决策测试。
9. 运行真实 Worker 工具调用测试。

如果本地 Provider 是 OpenAI-compatible 服务，优先使用现有 Adapter。

不要新建一套绕过 Gateway 的 Provider 实现。

安全要求：

- 不要打印 API Key。
- 不要把凭据写入源码、日志、Git 或实验报告。
- 不要读取与 FORGE Provider 配置无关的个人文件。
- 不要修改用户原有 Provider 服务配置。
- 不要自动增加无限 Token 预算。
- 不要将 Mock 响应标记为真实模型结果。

如果某个模型不支持 Tool Calling，应该由 Router 选择兼容模型或采用安全的结构化调用适配方案，不要假设所有模型都具备相同能力。

本地 Provider 可能是代理服务，必须区分：
- FORGE 到本地代理的请求成功。
- 上游真实模型调用成功。
- 模型实际返回正确结果。

三者不能混为一谈。

# 三、核心任务：升级 Persistent Router

当前 Router 已经具备模型驱动决策基础，但还需要进一步增强。

目标：

Router 不应该只是一个分类器，而应该成为一个长期存在的自主 Agent。

## 3.1 Router Agent Loop

实现完整的循环：

Observe
→ Understand
→ Retrieve
→ Reason
→ Decide
→ Act
→ Observe Result
→ Reflect
→ Continue

Router 必须具备：

- 持续理解用户目标。
- 自动关联历史 Quest。
- 判断是否创建新 Quest。
- 判断是否继续现有 Quest。
- 识别用户约束。
- 识别任务优先级。
- 识别阻塞条件。
- 根据执行结果调整计划。
- 主动决定何时请求用户帮助。
- 在适当时机主动汇报进展。

不要把所有推理都写成固定 Prompt。

需要建立结构化决策协议，并对模型输出进行严格校验。

## 3.2 Router 与 Planner 分离

Router 负责：
- 用户意图理解。
- 任务生命周期管理。
- Quest 选择。
- 团队协调。
- 结果汇总。
- 用户交互。

Planner 负责：
- 目标分析。
- 子任务拆解。
- DAG 生成。
- 依赖关系推导。
- 成功标准定义。
- 任务执行顺序优化。

Planner 可以作为后台专用 Agent，但不能取代 Router。

## 3.3 复杂任务识别

支持：
- 普通聊天。
- 单步骤执行。
- 多步骤任务。
- 长期研究任务。
- 软件开发任务。
- 多模态任务。
- 多 Quest 并行任务。

不要为了增加 Agent 数量而把简单问题拆成复杂任务。

简单任务应该直接回答。

复杂任务才启动团队。

---

# 四、Dynamic Team Intelligence

这是 FORGE 最重要的创新方向之一。

目前已经具备模型注册、角色合同和基础组队算法。

接下来需要让团队真正根据任务需求动态形成。

## 4.1 Model Intelligence

完善模型画像：

- Coding
- Mathematics
- Research
- Architecture
- Planning
- Design
- Vision
- Writing
- Tool Calling
- Instruction Following

增加实际线上表现：

- Task Success Rate
- Tool Call Success Rate
- Retry Rate
- Schema Compliance
- Average Latency
- P95 Latency
- Token Consumption
- Cost
- Review Pass Rate

注意：

能力评分必须有来源、样本数、测试时间和置信度。

真实数据与用户手动评分分开保存。

不能把一次成功调用直接当成模型能力评分。

## 4.2 Dynamic Team Composer

Router 将 Quest 交给 Composer。

Composer 根据：

- Task Requirements
- Model Capabilities
- Model Reliability
- Tool Compatibility
- Token Budget
- Time Budget
- Coordination Overhead

选择团队。

支持：

- Single Agent
- Sequential Team
- Parallel Team
- Hierarchical Team
- Specialist Team
- Dynamic Expansion

要求模型与角色彻底解耦。

一个模型可以承担多个角色，一个角色也可以根据任务动态切换模型。

## 4.3 团队自适应

执行过程中：

- Worker 可以请求帮助。
- Router 可以增加专家。
- Router 可以替换表现不佳的模型。
- Router 可以重新分配未完成节点。
- Reviewer 可以要求返工。
- Planner 可以重新规划剩余 DAG。

但已完成节点、历史证据和已执行的外部动作不能因为重组而丢失。

团队规模、派生深度、预算和重试次数必须有界。

---

# 五、真正的 Native Worker Agent Loop

不要只把 Worker 当作任务执行函数。

Worker 必须拥有自己的推理循环和工作上下文。

完整过程：

接收任务
→ 理解任务合同
→ 检索必要上下文
→ 选择工具
→ 请求模型
→ 执行工具
→ 读取结果
→ 判断是否完成
→ 必要时修正
→ 输出结构化结果
→ 提交证据
→ 通知 Router

## 5.1 Worker 类型

完善以下角色：

Research Agent：
- 检索资料。
- 整理来源。
- 分析相关工作。
- 提供研究结论。

Math Agent：
- 数学推导。
- 公式验证。
- 数值计算。
- 检查推理漏洞。

Architect Agent：
- 设计系统架构。
- 定义接口。
- 分析依赖。
- 检查技术风险。

Coding Agent：
- 阅读代码。
- 编写代码。
- 修改代码。
- 运行测试。
- 修复错误。

Experiment Agent：
- 设计实验。
- 执行实验。
- 记录结果。
- 生成可复现报告。

Reviewer Agent：
- 检查成果。
- 对照成功标准。
- 检查证据。
- 给出通过或返工决定。

Planner Agent：
- 拆解任务。
- 更新 DAG。
- 管理依赖。
- 处理失败后的重新规划。

## 5.2 Worker 自我修正

Worker 不能遇到错误就直接失败。

应该能够：

1. 读取错误信息。
2. 判断错误类型。
3. 分析可能原因。
4. 选择修复策略。
5. 再次执行。
6. 对比修复前后的结果。
7. 判断是否需要求助。

区分：
- 代码错误。
- 工具错误。
- Provider 错误。
- 任务理解错误。
- 预算耗尽。
- 依赖阻塞。
- 外部资源不可用。

不同错误采用不同恢复策略。

禁止无限循环。

## 5.3 Worker 交付协议

每个 Worker 必须提交：

- Summary
- Findings
- Decisions
- Artifacts
- Evidence References
- Unresolved Issues
- Confidence
- Next Actions

不能只返回一段自由文本。

---

# 六、Reviewer：建立真正的独立审查机制

Reviewer 不应该只是让另一个模型重新总结一次结果。

它必须检查：

1. 是否完成原始目标。
2. 是否满足成功标准。
3. 是否存在未经验证的假设。
4. 产物是否真实存在。
5. 产物是否与执行记录对应。
6. 测试是否真实运行。
7. 是否存在逻辑错误。
8. 是否存在明显遗漏。
9. 是否存在安全问题。

Reviewer 应当拥有独立的上下文。

不要将 Coding Agent 的全部内部推理直接复制给 Reviewer。

Reviewer 应获得：
- 原始任务合同。
- 成功标准。
- 实际产物。
- 可信工具回执。
- 必要的研究来源。
- 测试结果。

审查结果：

PASS
NEEDS_REVISION
REJECT
BLOCKED

NEEDS_REVISION 必须能够创建有明确修改目标的返工任务。

设置最大审查轮次。

Reviewer 不能通过模型自述或 Mock 证据判定成功。

---

# 七、Context Compaction 与 Memory 深度增强

目前 M6 已经实现了有界 Context Archive、Recall 和预算管理。

但长期单一对话仍然有容量边界。

本轮重点解决这个问题。

## 7.1 Task-Centric Compaction

不要简单按时间截断历史。

采用多层上下文：

L0：Recent Interaction
L1：Active Quest Context
L2：Project Memory
L3：Long-term Experience

保留：
- 原始用户目标。
- 用户明确约束。
- 重要决策。
- 已完成节点。
- 当前阻塞。
- 产物路径。
- 证据来源。
- 失败经验。
- 后续行动。

每个压缩摘要必须保留来源引用。

压缩后必须能恢复到原始证据。

## 7.2 解决历史消息无限增长

不要为了保存所有用户约束而无限注入原始消息。

建立约束抽取和引用机制：

- 将用户约束单独索引。
- 保留原始消息 ID。
- 生成有来源的结构化 Constraint Record。
- 检测约束冲突。
- 检测约束是否过期。
- 必要时重新读取原始消息。

模型抽取出的约束先标记为待验证。

用户明确确认的约束与模型推测严格区分。

## 7.3 Memory Retrieval

改进 Recall：

- 语义检索。
- 关键词检索。
- Quest 关联检索。
- 时间检索。
- 来源可靠性过滤。
- 冲突检测。
- 过期过滤。

建立 Retrieval Evaluation Dataset。

测试 Router 是否能准确找到历史 Quest、决策、文件和用户约束。

不要只根据摘要文本相似度判断召回成功。

---

# 八、Agent 之间的协作机制

建立正式的 Agent Communication Protocol。

不允许把自由文本群聊作为主要协调机制。

支持：

TASK_ASSIGNMENT
TASK_ACCEPTED
TASK_COMPLETED
HELP_REQUEST
REVIEW_REQUEST
REVISION_REQUEST
DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED
MODEL_UNAVAILABLE
BUDGET_WARNING
AGENT_FAILED

重要消息持久化。

Router 负责协调。

Worker 不能绕过 Router 自行修改其他 Worker 的任务。

对于跨 Worker 共享的产物，必须通过有权限的 Artifact 和 Receipt 接口访问。

---

# 九、真正跑通复杂任务

本轮必须新增真实端到端实验。

不要只写单元测试。

建立三种任务难度：

## Level 1：简单任务

例如：

“分析这个 Python 项目，指出三个最值得优先修复的问题。”

验证：
- Router 判断。
- Quest 创建。
- 单 Worker 执行。
- 结果回传。

## Level 2：多 Agent 协作

例如：

“调研一个开源 Agent 框架，比较其架构，写一份技术分析报告。”

验证：
- Research Agent。
- Architect Agent。
- Coding/Writer Agent。
- Reviewer Agent。
- Router 汇总。

## Level 3：复杂自主开发

例如：

“研究一个新的 Agent 算法，提出技术方案，实现实验代码，运行实验，并分析结果。”

验证：
- Planner。
- Research Agent。
- Math Agent。
- Architect Agent。
- Coding Agent。
- Experiment Agent。
- Reviewer Agent。

复杂任务必须真实调用 Provider、真实执行工具、真实产生文件。

必须能在中途重启 Core 后继续执行。

## 实验数据

每次实验保存：

- Run ID
- Provider
- Model ID
- Execution Mode
- Model Calls
- Tool Calls
- Token Usage
- Duration
- Retry Count
- Review Results
- Artifact Hashes
- Final Status

真实模型实验与 Mock 实验分开统计。

失败实验必须保留。

---

# 十、算法研究：不要只做工程拼装

FORGE 有三个值得深入的自主研究方向：

1. Capability-Aware Dynamic Team Composition。
2. Evidence-Driven Autonomous Governance。
3. Task-Centric Context Compression。

本轮建立真正可复现的 Benchmark。

重点：

### Team Composition
比较：
- Single Model
- Static Team
- Greedy Selection
- Capability Coverage
- Complementarity
- Dynamic Recomposition

### Context Compression
比较：
- Full Context
- Recency Truncation
- Conventional Summary
- Task-Centric Compression
- Task-Centric Compression + Source Recall

### Agent Governance
比较：
- Model Claim Only
- Tool Receipt Verification
- Independent Reviewer
- Evidence-Gated Completion

至少建立多个不同难度和领域的任务。

使用固定测试集、统一预算和独立评分。

报告成功率、成本、延迟、Token、返工次数和证据完整率。

小样本结果必须明确标记为探索性实验，不允许夸大统计结论。

---

# 十一、本轮明确不做的事情

暂时不投入主要开发资源于：

- UI 视觉重构。
- Tauri 安装包优化。
- NSIS 发布。
- 动画效果。
- 桌面端页面扩展。
- 非必要的数据库重构。

现有桌面端保持可用即可。

如果发现会阻塞 Agent 运行的底层缺陷，可以修复，但不要将桌面测试变成主线。

---

# 十二、执行顺序

请连续执行以下阶段，不需要每个阶段都等待用户确认：

Sprint A：Provider 和 Agent Loop 深度审计及真实调用。

Sprint B：Persistent Router + Planner 智能化。

Sprint C：Dynamic Team Intelligence。

Sprint D：Native Worker 自主执行与自我修正。

Sprint E：Independent Reviewer 与返工闭环。

Sprint F：Context Compaction + Long-term Memory。

Sprint G：Agent Communication Protocol + 故障恢复。

Sprint H：真实复杂任务端到端验收。

Sprint I：三项核心算法 Benchmark 与消融实验。

每个阶段必须有独立测试和可复现报告。

如果发现现有架构不支持目标，应先提出最小必要架构调整，并通过 ADR 记录，不要推倒重写。

---

# 十三、工程约束

1. 保持一个长期用户对话入口。
2. Router 是唯一面向用户的 Agent。
3. Worker 是真正的后台执行 Agent。
4. 不允许通过创建多个用户 Conversation 规避上下文问题。
5. 不允许把 Codex、DSH 或 Claude Code 当作执行后端。
6. 不允许使用伪造的执行记录。
7. 不允许把 Mock 结果标记为 Live。
8. 不允许绕过 Approval、Policy 和 Evidence。
9. 不允许无限 Agent 派生。
10. 不允许无限重试。
11. 不允许无预算模型调用。
12. 保留历史测试和审计证据。
13. 不自动推送或合并 GitHub。
14. 不删除用户原有数据和实验记录。

可以使用多个 Codex 子任务并行分析和实现，但必须指定唯一集成负责人，避免多人同时修改相同核心文件。

---

# 十四、最终交付标准

最终必须让 FORGE 能够：

1. 长期与用户保持同一个对话。
2. 理解用户复杂目标。
3. 自动生成 Quest。
4. 自动规划 DAG。
5. 从模型库选择模型。
6. 动态组建 Agent 团队。
7. 后台并行执行任务。
8. Agent 之间结构化协作。
9. 自动发现错误并修复。
10. Reviewer 独立检查结果。
11. 不合格任务自动返工。
12. 上下文压缩后恢复工作。
13. 长期记忆跨任务复用。
14. Core 重启后继续执行。
15. 所有成果具备可信证据。

生成：

`docs/PHASE2_AGENT_INTELLIGENCE_REPORT.md`

`docs/PHASE2_STATUS.md`

`docs/PHASE2_EXPERIMENTS.md`

`docs/audit/phase2/verification.json`

最终报告必须明确区分真实模型验证、Mock 验证、合成实验和未完成项目。

现在开始执行。

本轮的成功标准不是增加了多少代码，而是 FORGE 是否真正能够自主完成一个复杂任务，并且在失败、返工、上下文压缩和 Core 重启后仍然保持任务连续性。要多开子代理并行，本地provider直接用本地workbuddy-api 的wb-in里面的deepseek-v4.1-flash

先建立一份真正的 Agent 执行链路图。

区分：
1. 已经真实实现的功能。
2. 通过 Mock 验证的功能。
3. 已经通过真实 Provider 验证的功能。
4. 只有接口或数据模型的功能。
5. 目前无法端到端工作的功能。

不要重新实现已经完成的模块。

不要为了让报告好看而隐藏已有缺陷。

审计完成后直接进入开发，不需要等待用户再次批准。

# 二、本地 Provider：正式启用真实模型

用户已经允许使用本地 Provider。

要求：

1. 检查 FORGE 当前 Provider 配置。
2. 检查本地 Provider 服务是否可用。
3. 获取可用模型列表。
4. 检查模型的 Tool Calling、Structured Output、Streaming 能力。
5. 检查模型实际上下文和输出限制。
6. 检查 Token 预算和并发限制。
7. 运行真实模型的最小对话测试。
8. 运行真实模型的 Router 决策测试。
9. 运行真实 Worker 工具调用测试。

如果本地 Provider 是 OpenAI-compatible 服务，优先使用现有 Adapter。

不要新建一套绕过 Gateway 的 Provider 实现。

安全要求：

- 不要打印 API Key。
- 不要把凭据写入源码、日志、Git 或实验报告。
- 不要读取与 FORGE Provider 配置无关的个人文件。
- 不要修改用户原有 Provider 服务配置。
- 不要自动增加无限 Token 预算。
- 不要将 Mock 响应标记为真实模型结果。

如果某个模型不支持 Tool Calling，应该由 Router 选择兼容模型或采用安全的结构化调用适配方案，不要假设所有模型都具备相同能力。

本地 Provider 可能是代理服务，必须区分：
- FORGE 到本地代理的请求成功。
- 上游真实模型调用成功。
- 模型实际返回正确结果。

三者不能混为一谈。

# 三、核心任务：升级 Persistent Router

当前 Router 已经具备模型驱动决策基础，但还需要进一步增强。

目标：

Router 不应该只是一个分类器，而应该成为一个长期存在的自主 Agent。

## 3.1 Router Agent Loop

实现完整的循环：

Observe
→ Understand
→ Retrieve
→ Reason
→ Decide
→ Act
→ Observe Result
→ Reflect
→ Continue

Router 必须具备：

- 持续理解用户目标。
- 自动关联历史 Quest。
- 判断是否创建新 Quest。
- 判断是否继续现有 Quest。
- 识别用户约束。
- 识别任务优先级。
- 识别阻塞条件。
- 根据执行结果调整计划。
- 主动决定何时请求用户帮助。
- 在适当时机主动汇报进展。

不要把所有推理都写成固定 Prompt。

需要建立结构化决策协议，并对模型输出进行严格校验。

## 3.2 Router 与 Planner 分离

Router 负责：
- 用户意图理解。
- 任务生命周期管理。
- Quest 选择。
- 团队协调。
- 结果汇总。
- 用户交互。

Planner 负责：
- 目标分析。
- 子任务拆解。
- DAG 生成。
- 依赖关系推导。
- 成功标准定义。
- 任务执行顺序优化。

Planner 可以作为后台专用 Agent，但不能取代 Router。

## 3.3 复杂任务识别

支持：
- 普通聊天。
- 单步骤执行。
- 多步骤任务。
- 长期研究任务。
- 软件开发任务。
- 多模态任务。
- 多 Quest 并行任务。

不要为了增加 Agent 数量而把简单问题拆成复杂任务。

简单任务应该直接回答。

复杂任务才启动团队。

---

# 四、Dynamic Team Intelligence

这是 FORGE 最重要的创新方向之一。

目前已经具备模型注册、角色合同和基础组队算法。

接下来需要让团队真正根据任务需求动态形成。

## 4.1 Model Intelligence

完善模型画像：

- Coding
- Mathematics
- Research
- Architecture
- Planning
- Design
- Vision
- Writing
- Tool Calling
- Instruction Following

增加实际线上表现：

- Task Success Rate
- Tool Call Success Rate
- Retry Rate
- Schema Compliance
- Average Latency
- P95 Latency
- Token Consumption
- Cost
- Review Pass Rate

注意：

能力评分必须有来源、样本数、测试时间和置信度。

真实数据与用户手动评分分开保存。

不能把一次成功调用直接当成模型能力评分。

## 4.2 Dynamic Team Composer

Router 将 Quest 交给 Composer。

Composer 根据：

- Task Requirements
- Model Capabilities
- Model Reliability
- Tool Compatibility
- Token Budget
- Time Budget
- Coordination Overhead

选择团队。

支持：

- Single Agent
- Sequential Team
- Parallel Team
- Hierarchical Team
- Specialist Team
- Dynamic Expansion

要求模型与角色彻底解耦。

一个模型可以承担多个角色，一个角色也可以根据任务动态切换模型。

## 4.3 团队自适应

执行过程中：

- Worker 可以请求帮助。
- Router 可以增加专家。
- Router 可以替换表现不佳的模型。
- Router 可以重新分配未完成节点。
- Reviewer 可以要求返工。
- Planner 可以重新规划剩余 DAG。

但已完成节点、历史证据和已执行的外部动作不能因为重组而丢失。

团队规模、派生深度、预算和重试次数必须有界。

---

# 五、真正的 Native Worker Agent Loop

不要只把 Worker 当作任务执行函数。

Worker 必须拥有自己的推理循环和工作上下文。

完整过程：

接收任务
→ 理解任务合同
→ 检索必要上下文
→ 选择工具
→ 请求模型
→ 执行工具
→ 读取结果
→ 判断是否完成
→ 必要时修正
→ 输出结构化结果
→ 提交证据
→ 通知 Router

## 5.1 Worker 类型

完善以下角色：

Research Agent：
- 检索资料。
- 整理来源。
- 分析相关工作。
- 提供研究结论。

Math Agent：
- 数学推导。
- 公式验证。
- 数值计算。
- 检查推理漏洞。

Architect Agent：
- 设计系统架构。
- 定义接口。
- 分析依赖。
- 检查技术风险。

Coding Agent：
- 阅读代码。
- 编写代码。
- 修改代码。
- 运行测试。
- 修复错误。

Experiment Agent：
- 设计实验。
- 执行实验。
- 记录结果。
- 生成可复现报告。

Reviewer Agent：
- 检查成果。
- 对照成功标准。
- 检查证据。
- 给出通过或返工决定。

Planner Agent：
- 拆解任务。
- 更新 DAG。
- 管理依赖。
- 处理失败后的重新规划。

## 5.2 Worker 自我修正

Worker 不能遇到错误就直接失败。

应该能够：

1. 读取错误信息。
2. 判断错误类型。
3. 分析可能原因。
4. 选择修复策略。
5. 再次执行。
6. 对比修复前后的结果。
7. 判断是否需要求助。

区分：
- 代码错误。
- 工具错误。
- Provider 错误。
- 任务理解错误。
- 预算耗尽。
- 依赖阻塞。
- 外部资源不可用。

不同错误采用不同恢复策略。

禁止无限循环。

## 5.3 Worker 交付协议

每个 Worker 必须提交：

- Summary
- Findings
- Decisions
- Artifacts
- Evidence References
- Unresolved Issues
- Confidence
- Next Actions

不能只返回一段自由文本。

---

# 六、Reviewer：建立真正的独立审查机制

Reviewer 不应该只是让另一个模型重新总结一次结果。

它必须检查：

1. 是否完成原始目标。
2. 是否满足成功标准。
3. 是否存在未经验证的假设。
4. 产物是否真实存在。
5. 产物是否与执行记录对应。
6. 测试是否真实运行。
7. 是否存在逻辑错误。
8. 是否存在明显遗漏。
9. 是否存在安全问题。

Reviewer 应当拥有独立的上下文。

不要将 Coding Agent 的全部内部推理直接复制给 Reviewer。

Reviewer 应获得：
- 原始任务合同。
- 成功标准。
- 实际产物。
- 可信工具回执。
- 必要的研究来源。
- 测试结果。

审查结果：

PASS
NEEDS_REVISION
REJECT
BLOCKED

NEEDS_REVISION 必须能够创建有明确修改目标的返工任务。

设置最大审查轮次。

Reviewer 不能通过模型自述或 Mock 证据判定成功。

---

# 七、Context Compaction 与 Memory 深度增强

目前 M6 已经实现了有界 Context Archive、Recall 和预算管理。

但长期单一对话仍然有容量边界。

本轮重点解决这个问题。

## 7.1 Task-Centric Compaction

不要简单按时间截断历史。

采用多层上下文：

L0：Recent Interaction
L1：Active Quest Context
L2：Project Memory
L3：Long-term Experience

保留：
- 原始用户目标。
- 用户明确约束。
- 重要决策。
- 已完成节点。
- 当前阻塞。
- 产物路径。
- 证据来源。
- 失败经验。
- 后续行动。

每个压缩摘要必须保留来源引用。

压缩后必须能恢复到原始证据。

## 7.2 解决历史消息无限增长

不要为了保存所有用户约束而无限注入原始消息。

建立约束抽取和引用机制：

- 将用户约束单独索引。
- 保留原始消息 ID。
- 生成有来源的结构化 Constraint Record。
- 检测约束冲突。
- 检测约束是否过期。
- 必要时重新读取原始消息。

模型抽取出的约束先标记为待验证。

用户明确确认的约束与模型推测严格区分。

## 7.3 Memory Retrieval

改进 Recall：

- 语义检索。
- 关键词检索。
- Quest 关联检索。
- 时间检索。
- 来源可靠性过滤。
- 冲突检测。
- 过期过滤。

建立 Retrieval Evaluation Dataset。

测试 Router 是否能准确找到历史 Quest、决策、文件和用户约束。

不要只根据摘要文本相似度判断召回成功。

---

# 八、Agent 之间的协作机制

建立正式的 Agent Communication Protocol。

不允许把自由文本群聊作为主要协调机制。

支持：

TASK_ASSIGNMENT
TASK_ACCEPTED
TASK_COMPLETED
HELP_REQUEST
REVIEW_REQUEST
REVISION_REQUEST
DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED
MODEL_UNAVAILABLE
BUDGET_WARNING
AGENT_FAILED

重要消息持久化。

Router 负责协调。

Worker 不能绕过 Router 自行修改其他 Worker 的任务。

对于跨 Worker 共享的产物，必须通过有权限的 Artifact 和 Receipt 接口访问。

---

# 九、真正跑通复杂任务

本轮必须新增真实端到端实验。

不要只写单元测试。

建立三种任务难度：

## Level 1：简单任务

例如：

“分析这个 Python 项目，指出三个最值得优先修复的问题。”

验证：
- Router 判断。
- Quest 创建。
- 单 Worker 执行。
- 结果回传。

## Level 2：多 Agent 协作

例如：

“调研一个开源 Agent 框架，比较其架构，写一份技术分析报告。”

验证：
- Research Agent。
- Architect Agent。
- Coding/Writer Agent。
- Reviewer Agent。
- Router 汇总。

## Level 3：复杂自主开发

例如：

“研究一个新的 Agent 算法，提出技术方案，实现实验代码，运行实验，并分析结果。”

验证：
- Planner。
- Research Agent。
- Math Agent。
- Architect Agent。
- Coding Agent。
- Experiment Agent。
- Reviewer Agent。

复杂任务必须真实调用 Provider、真实执行工具、真实产生文件。

必须能在中途重启 Core 后继续执行。

## 实验数据

每次实验保存：

- Run ID
- Provider
- Model ID
- Execution Mode
- Model Calls
- Tool Calls
- Token Usage
- Duration
- Retry Count
- Review Results
- Artifact Hashes
- Final Status

真实模型实验与 Mock 实验分开统计。

失败实验必须保留。

---

# 十、算法研究：不要只做工程拼装

FORGE 有三个值得深入的自主研究方向：

1. Capability-Aware Dynamic Team Composition。
2. Evidence-Driven Autonomous Governance。
3. Task-Centric Context Compression。

本轮建立真正可复现的 Benchmark。

重点：

### Team Composition
比较：
- Single Model
- Static Team
- Greedy Selection
- Capability Coverage
- Complementarity
- Dynamic Recomposition

### Context Compression
比较：
- Full Context
- Recency Truncation
- Conventional Summary
- Task-Centric Compression
- Task-Centric Compression + Source Recall

### Agent Governance
比较：
- Model Claim Only
- Tool Receipt Verification
- Independent Reviewer
- Evidence-Gated Completion

至少建立多个不同难度和领域的任务。

使用固定测试集、统一预算和独立评分。

报告成功率、成本、延迟、Token、返工次数和证据完整率。

小样本结果必须明确标记为探索性实验，不允许夸大统计结论。

---

# 十一、本轮明确不做的事情

暂时不投入主要开发资源于：

- UI 视觉重构。
- Tauri 安装包优化。
- NSIS 发布。
- 动画效果。
- 桌面端页面扩展。
- 非必要的数据库重构。

现有桌面端保持可用即可。

如果发现会阻塞 Agent 运行的底层缺陷，可以修复，但不要将桌面测试变成主线。

---

# 十二、执行顺序

请连续执行以下阶段，不需要每个阶段都等待用户确认：

Sprint A：Provider 和 Agent Loop 深度审计及真实调用。

Sprint B：Persistent Router + Planner 智能化。

Sprint C：Dynamic Team Intelligence。

Sprint D：Native Worker 自主执行与自我修正。

Sprint E：Independent Reviewer 与返工闭环。

Sprint F：Context Compaction + Long-term Memory。

Sprint G：Agent Communication Protocol + 故障恢复。

Sprint H：真实复杂任务端到端验收。

Sprint I：三项核心算法 Benchmark 与消融实验。

每个阶段必须有独立测试和可复现报告。

如果发现现有架构不支持目标，应先提出最小必要架构调整，并通过 ADR 记录，不要推倒重写。

---

# 十三、工程约束

1. 保持一个长期用户对话入口。
2. Router 是唯一面向用户的 Agent。
3. Worker 是真正的后台执行 Agent。
4. 不允许通过创建多个用户 Conversation 规避上下文问题。
5. 不允许把 Codex、DSH 或 Claude Code 当作执行后端。
6. 不允许使用伪造的执行记录。
7. 不允许把 Mock 结果标记为 Live。
8. 不允许绕过 Approval、Policy 和 Evidence。
9. 不允许无限 Agent 派生。
10. 不允许无限重试。
11. 不允许无预算模型调用。
12. 保留历史测试和审计证据。
13. 不自动推送或合并 GitHub。
14. 不删除用户原有数据和实验记录。

可以使用多个 Codex 子任务并行分析和实现，但必须指定唯一集成负责人，避免多人同时修改相同核心文件。

---

# 十四、最终交付标准

最终必须让 FORGE 能够：

1. 长期与用户保持同一个对话。
2. 理解用户复杂目标。
3. 自动生成 Quest。
4. 自动规划 DAG。
5. 从模型库选择模型。
6. 动态组建 Agent 团队。
7. 后台并行执行任务。
8. Agent 之间结构化协作。
9. 自动发现错误并修复。
10. Reviewer 独立检查结果。
11. 不合格任务自动返工。
12. 上下文压缩后恢复工作。
13. 长期记忆跨任务复用。
14. Core 重启后继续执行。
15. 所有成果具备可信证据。

生成：

`docs/PHASE2_AGENT_INTELLIGENCE_REPORT.md`

`docs/PHASE2_STATUS.md`

`docs/PHASE2_EXPERIMENTS.md`

`docs/audit/phase2/verification.json`

最终报告必须明确区分真实模型验证、Mock 验证、合成实验和未完成项目。

# FORGE v4 — Persistent Router Agent System

FORGE is a self-built, general-purpose autonomous Agent desktop application.

## Engineering status — 2026-11-15

Phase 2 backend acceptance is in progress. The latest frozen V21 suite passed
**1,560 tests**, with one existing warning in 445.09 seconds; Ruff, formatting,
dependency and whitespace checks passed. Its three strict live runs all failed
strict acceptance. All 18 model attempts settled (83,527 tokens). L1 reached a
real Worker and three successful source reads, then blocked before review;
L2/L3 failed during planning. No mid-execution restart occurred. V22 is fixing
incomplete Planner diagnostics and inaccurate Worker delivery-validation feedback.

See the [current status](docs/PHASE2_STATUS.md), [Phase 2 report](docs/PHASE2_AGENT_INTELLIGENCE_REPORT.md),
[experiments](docs/PHASE2_EXPERIMENTS.md) and [V21 historical boundary](docs/audit/phase2/acceptance-independent-v21-boundary.md).
Historical failures and original evidence remain preserved. The real algorithm
microstudy scored 25/90 task successes; it does not establish general policy gains.
Frontend work is being handled separately; packaging is outside this sprint.

Phase 1 Milestones 1–6 provide the persistence, governance, Registry, DAG, native Workers, tool/evidence and context/budget foundation. Historical M6 verification passed 372 tests; one bounded live continuation succeeded after five retained diagnostic failures. The [M7 backend hardening round](docs/PHASE1_MILESTONE7_BACKEND_HARDENING.md) passed 488 local tests. Desktop Alpha, final native integration and packaging are deferred; these historical backend results do not establish a desktop release.

See [current status](docs/STATUS.md), the [Phase 0 audit report](docs/PHASE0_AUDIT.md), and the report's dependency-ordered development plan. The release references `codex/MASTER_PROMPT.md`, but that file is missing from the supplied archive.

**The user has one persistent conversation.** A persistent Router Agent owns that conversation and coordinates multiple long-running Quests and hidden Worker Sessions. Workers have isolated execution contexts, but they are never presented as separate user conversations.

## Product invariants

1. One persistent user-facing conversation per workspace.
2. One persistent Router identity and resumable state per workspace.
3. Multiple durable Quests can run behind that conversation.
4. Worker Sessions are private execution contexts, not user-facing chats.
5. Worker events are selectively relayed into the single conversation timeline.
6. Model Provider, Model Profile, Role Template, Agent Instance, Quest and Session are separate domain entities.
7. Model Registry uses provider metadata, FORGE benchmark results, online performance and explicit user overrides.
8. Team composition combines reusable role templates with bounded dynamic role synthesis.
9. FORGE owns its Agent Loop, Router, Worker Runtime, Tool Engine, Memory, Governance and Evidence.
10. Codex, DSH and Claude Code are architectural references only, never execution backends.

## What this release contains

- Typed Python domain layer and repository interfaces.
- SQLite persistence with schema versioning and transaction boundaries.
- Persistent `main` conversation and Router identity.
- Quest lifecycle state machine and hidden Worker Session records.
- Durable event log with sequence cursor.
- Model Registry and explainable capability-fit team composition baseline.
- Provider gateway and explicit unconfigured provider; Mock protocol tests are labelled.
- FastAPI API with input validation and consistent error handling.
- React single-conversation UI with background Quest panel.
- Automated tests for persistence, lifecycle, router classification and team composition.
- Architecture, threat model, ADRs, detailed roadmap and Codex execution prompts.

## Important maturity statement

This is an engineering foundation with bounded context recovery, sourced lexical and model semantic recall, and evidence-gated execution. The Router uses a configured Provider or explicitly fails. Mock tests, synthetic experiments and real-provider observations are identified separately. The current independent reviewer uses the approved Worker's model in a fresh context. Bounded feedback-driven remaining-DAG proposals are implemented; their general quality, arbitrary-scale continuity and complex-task correctness remain subject to recorded acceptance. Plan/team/replacement approval stays authenticated and Review mode remains enabled. A proposal record alone never proves execution.

## Backend setup

The model-driven Router requires explicit provider configuration. Set the process environment
variables `FORGE_PROVIDER_ID`, `FORGE_PROVIDER_KIND` (for example `openai_compatible`),
`FORGE_PROVIDER_BASE_URL`, `FORGE_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_REF` (for example
`FORGE_PROVIDER_KEY_EXAMPLE`), `FORGE_ROUTER_MODEL_ID`, and
`FORGE_ROUTER_CONTEXT_LIMIT` (an operator-supplied maximum context window). Put the actual
credential only in the process environment variable named by the credential reference. Set
`FORGE_PROVIDER_SUPPORTS_TOOLS=true` and `FORGE_PROVIDER_SUPPORTS_JSON_SCHEMA=true` only when
the provider supports them. Without configuration the Core starts but Router message calls fail
explicitly; no keyword or mock provider is selected automatically. The optional `request_id`
in a message request allows safe retry: reuse it only for the same input.
For live calls, register an enabled model with the same provider and model ID and explicitly set
both `tool_calling_support` and `structured_output_support` to supported. Unknown capabilities
are rejected. Values submitted through the model API are recorded as user overrides.

Provider timing, Worker ownership and review/output limits use the process environment:

| Variable | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `FORGE_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | Per-attempt timeout in seconds; finite and greater than `0`, at most `600`; defaults to `30`. A timeout does not prove the upstream operation stopped. |
| `FORGE_PROVIDER_MAX_RETRIES` | Additional Gateway retries, integer `0`–`3`; defaults to `1`. Each HTTP attempt requires its own budget admission. |
| `FORGE_WORKER_LEASE_SECONDS` | Worker ownership lease, finite and greater than `0`, at most `600`; defaults to `60`. Valid current owners renew between steps, capped by the task deadline. The local call wait is bounded by the current lease; an upstream operation may remain unresolved after that wait ends. |
| `FORGE_REVIEW_MAX_ROUNDS` | Maximum review rounds; integer `1`–`4`, defaults to `2`. The live acceptance harness explicitly selects `3`, matching its scenario cap. This does not reset budgets or change historical runs. |
| `FORGE_PROVIDER_REASONING_EFFORT` | Optional explicit OpenAI-compatible/DeepSeek request setting: `none`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` or `max`. Unset sends no setting. Configure only for a model that advertises support; Anthropic configuration rejects it. |
| `FORGE_ROUTER_OUTPUT_RESERVE` | Router response-token ceiling and reserved output allowance; integer `1`–`8192`, defaults to `2048`. `FORGE_ROUTER_CONTEXT_LIMIT` must be greater than this value. A registered model's known output limit must also support it. |
| `FORGE_ROUTER_CONTEXT_LIMIT` | Operator-supplied Router context ceiling, required when setting a Router model. Core startup requires an integer greater than `2048` and greater than the configured output reserve. |

The Phase 2 live acceptance harness uses a 120-second timeout, a 150-second Worker lease and zero additional
Gateway retries, with a Router output reserve of `4096` and `FORGE_REVIEW_MAX_ROUNDS=3`
within the scenario's three-round cap. Router/Planner schema repair remains a separately bounded stage;
neither setting authorizes replay of an unresolved external action.

The current WorkBuddy acceptance harness explicitly requests `reasoning_effort=none`,
which the local proxy implementation advertises for the requested model. This is
an operator setting, not independent proof of the upstream model's internal behavior.
Earlier diagnostic runs used the proxy default and retain their separate results.

The Router reads a bounded snapshot and calls the provider outside the database write
transaction. A successful decision and its messages commit together; provider errors, invalid
decisions, or budget failures leave no messages or Quest changes for that turn. The caller can
retry with the same request ID. The context budget uses a conservative UTF-8 byte estimate,
reserves output and request overhead, and also respects a known registry context window. Tool
access is limited to read-only Core queries. Worker execution separately requires approved plan/team contracts and governed tool permissions.

Python 3.11+ recommended.

```bash
cd backend
python -m venv .venv
# Windows PowerShell:
.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
# macOS/Linux:
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install --require-hashes -r requirements-lock.txt
python -m pip install --no-deps --no-build-isolation -e .
pytest
python -m forge_api
```

The lock file is verified on Windows with Python 3.13; other platforms and Python versions have not been verified. The editable installation requires build tooling already available. API documentation endpoints are disabled.

### Core authentication and development bootstrap

Core requires a fresh cryptographically random 32-byte process secret; `.env` is explicitly rejected. For manual browser development, supply it as 64 hex characters in `FORGE_CORE_SECRET` using a protected input method and enter the same secret into the UI's password field. Never place it in command history, source files, URLs, logs, or persistent browser storage. In the native desktop integration, the parent supplies the secret through a private pipe and the UI receives the derived session bearer in memory. Restarting Core invalidates old bearer tokens. Native integration is still undergoing final verification.

The unauthenticated public loopback `/health` returns only liveness and a random per-process session challenge; an authenticated request also receives Router identity and background status. A trusted client computes the lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over the UTF-8 challenge using the decoded 32-byte secret, and sends `Authorization: Bearer <digest>` on API requests. Requests without an Origin are allowed only with authentication and a loopback peer and Host; browser requests must also use an explicitly allowed Origin. These boundaries protect against unauthorized webpages and other untrusted clients; they do not protect secrets from an attacker who can read the same OS user's process memory. Keep the development server and any allowed origin trusted.

The authenticated user API supports `POST /api/approvals`, `GET /api/approvals?quest_id=...`, `GET /api/approvals/{id}`, and POSTs to `/{id}/decision` or `/{id}/revoke`. Workspace grants use `GET`/`POST /api/quests/{id}/grants` and `POST /api/quests/{id}/grants/revoke`. Decisions and grants record the authenticated local user, not a caller-supplied actor. The bearer represents that user; it must never be exposed to a model or registered as an Agent tool. These routes do not execute actions or accept trusted evidence. The M7 desktop approval and scope controls are under integration testing.

### Workspace and Settings

`python -m forge_api` is the shared Core launcher. From the repository root on Windows, `./scripts/run-backend.ps1` sets up the virtual environment and uses that launcher without shell activation. Pass `-WorkspaceRoot 'D:\YourWorkspace'` to the script, or `python -m forge_api --workspace-root 'D:\YourWorkspace'` directly. Workspace roots must be absolute paths.

The default Workspace is independent of the checkout, installation and shell directory:

| OS | Default Workspace root |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | `%LOCALAPPDATA%/FORGE/workspaces/default` |
| macOS | `~/Library/Application Support/FORGE/workspaces/default` |
| Linux | `${XDG_DATA_HOME:-~/.local/share}/forge/workspaces/default` |

The database defaults to `<WorkspaceRoot>/data/forge.sqlite3`. Settings are loaded as follows:

1. Choose the root using `--workspace-root`, then the process variable `FORGE_WORKSPACE_ROOT`, then the OS default (in that order). A root in `.env` is rejected because the root determines which file to read.
2. Load `<WorkspaceRoot>/.env` if present. `FORGE_ENV_FILE` in the process environment can select another file; relative file names resolve from the root. An explicitly selected missing file is an error. The shell directory's `.env` is ignored. Copy `backend/.env.example` to the selected Workspace root.
3. Process variables override file values. Supported settings are `FORGE_WORKSPACE_ID`, `FORGE_DB_PATH`, `FORGE_HOST` and `FORGE_PORT`; empty values and invalid ports fail startup. `.env` does not expand variables or modify the process environment.
4. Resolve relative database paths from the root and normalize them to absolute paths. The default Workspace ID is a hash of the normalized root; an explicit stable ID supports moving a Workspace. A database already bound to another ID is rejected.

The CLI and desktop Core bootstrap use the same Workspace settings and a new process secret. Direct `uvicorn forge_api.main:app` requires the same secret and loopback binding; prefer the shared launcher.

After a workspace restore, a restore fence blocks writes until an offline review succeeds. Close the desktop and Core, inspect the restored workspace and rollback directory, then use the packaged Python executable with the exact manifest hash and rollback directory shown by the application (replace every placeholder):

```powershell
& 'C:\path\to\packaged\python.exe' -I -m forge_api.maintenance review-restore --workspace-root 'C:\path\to\workspace' --manifest-sha256 '<64-lowercase-hex>' --rollback-directory '.forge-previous-<32-hex>' --reason '<10+ character review reason>'
```

The review validates the source hash, rollback directory name, reason, historical receipts and budget state; unresolved effects or reservations cause it to fail closed. Acknowledging an unknown native operation is a separate action and does not clear the restore fence or establish that the operation succeeded.

Legacy databases are **not discovered or moved automatically**. If an earlier version used `backend/data/forge.sqlite3` or another CWD-relative location, stop its Core process, back up the database with SQLite's backup API (or copy the database and WAL files together while stopped), and set `FORGE_DB_PATH` to its absolute path. The first successful open migrates it in place to the current schema without changing the Router ID or existing records. Migration failure rolls back the entire pending chain; unknown future versions and ambiguous version metadata are rejected. Downgrades are unsupported.

Events and pending Outbox rows commit in the same transaction as their associated business changes. Durable per-consumer delivery uses leases, fencing, bounded retries, Inbox deduplication and dead-letter/replay records. Historical events migrate as pending. External tool effects require their own durable intents and receipts; event delivery alone does not make external effects exactly once.

### Approved Worker execution

`python_test` runs bounded pure Python function tests against a governed workspace
file using an isolated subprocess and an AST interpreter. Its approved parameters
are `path`, `function` and `suite.cases` (1–32 input/expected cases). It supports
bounded loops, helpers and recursion; imports, attributes, external calls, file or
network access, and arbitrary shell/pytest execution are unavailable. A failed
case records the actual and expected values in a failed immutable receipt. An
approved Worker can use `file_revise` on its own artifact, rerun the tests and
submit the new evidence within its original repair and resource limits. No new
dependency or environment variable is required.

Workers consume an approved Quest DAG and a separately approved team. Tool scopes, provider/model identity and token/tool/time/concurrency budgets are bound to those contracts. File writes additionally require a workspace grant; HTTPS/MCP actions require exact action approval and an operator allowlist. `FORGE_TOOL_NETWORK_HOSTS_JSON` is a JSON host list (at most 64); `FORGE_MCP_SERVERS_JSON` maps server names to `{"url":"https://example.invalid/mcp","tools":["example_tool"]}` (at most 16 servers), with the HTTPS host included in the allowlist. Defaults are empty and deny network access. These values are operator configuration, never model output. `jsonschema` validates Worker result contracts; it does not judge domain correctness. Help/reassignment produces a pending team proposal for authenticated approval. An uncertain action cannot be silently retried or discarded during replacement. Unsupported or failed fixed JSON criteria require manual review; infrastructure verification retries are bounded to three attempts.

A member's `input_tokens + output_tokens` defines its cumulative Worker/review
allowance across model turns; it may exceed a single model context window while
remaining within the approved node and team limits. Each request independently
fits the remaining allowance and model context, and `output_tokens` also caps
one response. Compaction does not reset cumulative usage.

# 开发协作约定

这些约定适用于整个仓库。用户在当前会话中的明确指令优先；子目录存在更具体的约定时，同时遵循适用的目录约定。

- 修改前先阅读 README、相关代码和适用的目录说明，确认当前 Git 状态。
- 优先使用内置补丁工具编辑文件；无法使用时，立即改用 PowerShell。写入文本时使用 UTF-8。
- 保留用户已有的改动，围绕当前任务修改代码。
- 开发方向包含 Python、JSON、前端和 Tauri。前端框架、应用结构以及 Python 与 Tauri 的交互方式仍待确定，新增框架和依赖时以用户需求及已有代码为依据。
- Python 代码遵循现有项目规范；JSON 使用有效语法；Tauri 原生命令遵循最小必要权限原则。
- 修改完成后，运行与改动相关的检查；在交付说明中写明结果和未完成事项。
- 新增依赖、启动步骤或必要环境变量时，同步更新 README；示例中只使用占位值。
- 除非用户指定其他分支，新功能分支使用 `codex/` 前缀。
# Phase 2 — Agent Intelligence 状态

更新：2026-11-15。V22 修复中，最终冻结快照、全套后端结果和 strict L1/L2/L3 尚未验证，Phase 2 未完成。最新 V21 历史全套 1,560 项后端通过、1 个 warning / 445.09 秒，但三层 strict 均失败：L1 真实 Worker 三次只读工具后 blocked，L2/L3 失败于 Planner。18 次调用最终结算 83,527 Token，最终未知 0，原中途未结算失败标记保留。V20 历史全套 1,490 项通过、1 个 warning / 312.74 秒，三层 strict 均失败，22 次调用结算 108,458 Token，最终未知 0，均无 Worker。V19 已结束：1,448 项后端通过、1 个 warning / 321.62 秒；三层 strict 均在计划批准前失败。12 次模型调用全部结算 58,229 Token，未知 0，三层均无 Worker、审阅或重启。V18 已保存 1,413 项后端通过、1 个 warning / 408.37 秒与三层 strict 失败，37 次调用结算 270,119 Token。V17 已作为全套通过、三层 strict 失败的历史快照保存。

"""Opt-in verified input admission and explicit review-cycle budget policy.

Measurements never execute tools, create receipts, or claim to predict usage.
Actual review still checks the complete packet and Provider request at runtime.
"""

import hashlib
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

from .constraints import ConstraintService, validate_execution_constraints
from .domain import DomainError

VERSION = "verified-capacity-v1"


class CapacityPreflightError(DomainError):
    def __init__(self, message, diagnostics):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.capacity_diagnostics = diagnostics


def canonical(value):
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))


def _size(value):
    return len(canonical(value).encode("utf-8"))


def source_paths(content):
    """Only literal relative file references; no directory expansion or role inference."""
    return sorted(set(re.findall(r"(?<![\w:/])(?:[\w.-]+/)+[\w.-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9]+", content)))[:32]


def discover_input_inventory(store, content):
    from .tool_engine import ToolEngine

    paths = []
    for relative in source_paths(content):
        path = Path(ToolEngine(store)._scope("file_read", {"path": relative}))
        # Output references remain unknown until a producer bound is declared.
        if path.is_file():
            paths.append(relative)
    return verified_input_inventory(store, paths)


def _input(store, relative):
    from .tool_engine import ToolEngine

    if not isinstance(relative, str) or len(relative) > 1000:
        raise DomainError("Invalid declared input path")
    path = Path(ToolEngine(store)._scope("file_read", {"path": relative}))
    root = Path(store.workspace.root).resolve()
    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size > 65536:
        raise DomainError("Declared input must be a bounded ordinary workspace file")
    data = path.read_bytes()
    try:
        content = data.decode("utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
        raise DomainError("Declared input must be UTF-8") from exc
    return {
        "path": path.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
        "bytes": len(data),
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
    }, content


def verified_input_inventory(store, paths):
    if len(paths) > 32 or len(paths) != len(set(paths)):
        raise DomainError("Duplicate or excessive declared inputs")
    inventory, contents = [], {}
    for relative in paths:
        item, content = _input(store, relative)
        if item["path"] in contents:
            raise DomainError("Input paths alias the same file")
        inventory.append(item)
        contents[item["path"]] = content
    # A supplied manifest is a claim to check against actual wrapper bytes, never
    # a trusted source_bytes estimate for an excerpt or the full repository file.
    for relative, content in contents.items():
        if Path(relative).name != "manifest.json":
            continue
        try:
            manifest = json.loads(content)
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise DomainError("Input manifest is invalid JSON") from exc
        if (
            isinstance(manifest, dict)
            and set(manifest) == {"scenario_id", "inputs"}
            and isinstance(manifest["scenario_id"], str)
        ):
            manifest = manifest["inputs"]
        if not isinstance(manifest, list) or len(manifest) > 32:
            raise DomainError("Input manifest must list bounded file identities")
        seen = set()
        for record in manifest:
            if not isinstance(record, dict) or not {"path", "sha256", "bytes"} <= set(record):
                raise DomainError("Input manifest lacks actual file identity")
            actual, _ = _input(store, record["path"])
            if actual["path"] in seen or any(record[key] != actual[key] for key in actual):
                raise DomainError("Input manifest does not match actual file bytes/hash")
            seen.add(actual["path"])
    return sorted(inventory, key=lambda item: item["path"])


def verify_input_inventory(store, inventory):
    actual = verified_input_inventory(store, [item["path"] for item in inventory])
    if actual != inventory:
        raise DomainError("Approved input inventory changed")
    return actual


def residual_budget_snapshot(connection, store, quest_id, ceiling, ledger=None):
    """Include settled, opening, and every unresolved reservation in all scopes."""
    table = connection.execute(
        "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='model_budget_attempts'"
    ).fetchone()
    scopes = [("quest", "quest_id=?", (quest_id,), ceiling)]
    if ledger is not None:
        scopes.append(("global", "1=1", (), ledger.token_limit))
        for name, value, column in (
            ("workspace", store.workspace.id, "workspace_id"),
            ("quest", quest_id, "quest_id"),
        ):
            limit = ledger.scope_limits.get((name, value), (ledger.token_limit, 1))[0]
            scopes.append((name, f"{column}=?", (value,), limit))
    observations = []
    for name, predicate, params, limit in scopes:
        spent = opening = 0
        if table:
            spent = connection.execute(
                "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(input_charged,input_reserved)+"
                f"COALESCE(output_charged,output_reserved)),0) FROM model_budget_attempts WHERE {predicate}",
                params,
            ).fetchone()[0]
            opening = connection.execute(
                f"SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tokens),0) FROM model_budget_opening WHERE {predicate}",
                params,
            ).fetchone()[0]
        observations.append(
            {
                "scope": name,
                "limit": limit,
                "charged_or_reserved": spent,
                "opening": opening,
                "remaining": max(0, limit - spent - opening),
            }
        )
    return {"remaining": min(item["remaining"] for item in observations), "scopes": observations}


def coordination_budget_snapshot(connection, store, quest_id, graph, ledger=None):
    """Keep the declared total reserve without reserving paid coordination twice."""
    snapshot = residual_budget_snapshot(
        connection, store, quest_id, graph["max_total_tokens"], ledger
    )
    exists = connection.execute(
        "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='model_budget_attempts'"
    ).fetchone()
    charged = (
        connection.execute(
            "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(input_charged,input_reserved)+"
            "COALESCE(output_charged,output_reserved)),0) FROM model_budget_attempts "
            "WHERE quest_id=? AND state='settled' AND input_charged IS NOT NULL "
            "AND output_charged IS NOT NULL AND purpose IN ('planner','team_composer','composer','router','router_notice','router_reflect','memory_semantic_retrieval','semantic_retrieval')",
            (quest_id,),
        ).fetchone()[0]
        if exists
        else 0
    )
    future = max(0, graph["coordination_reserve_tokens"] - charged)
    return {
        **snapshot,
        "declared_total_coordination_tokens": graph["coordination_reserve_tokens"],
        "coordination_already_settled": charged,
        "future_coordination_reserve_tokens": future,
        "max_worker_allocations_now": max(0, snapshot["remaining"] - future),
        "max_allocations_plus_future_coordination": snapshot["remaining"],
        "accounting": "Remaining already subtracts settled/opening/unresolved usage. Only fully settled, identified coordination reduces the future part of the declared total reserve; unknown/opening amounts never do. No charge or reservation is refunded.",
    }


def _receipt(store, item):
    _, content = _input(store, item["path"])
    return {
        "id": "receipt_" + "0" * 32,
        "tool_name": "file_read",
        "resource_scope": str(Path(store.workspace.root) / item["path"]),
        "result_digest": "0" * 64,
        "execution_mode": "live",
        "output": {"content": content, "sha256": item["sha256"], "bytes": item["bytes"]},
    }


def node_review_envelope(
    store,
    connection,
    quest,
    graph,
    node,
    member,
    provider,
    *,
    resource_sizing=False,
    _measurement_envelope=None,
    _measurement_pass=0,
):
    """Measure actual immutable sources with shared runtime review serialization.

    The explicit policy adds twice the remaining canonical JSON byte allowance
    for native JSON escaping. This is an enforced bound, not a usage forecast.
    """
    from .budget_policy import node_execution_limit, validate_serial_policy
    from .independent_review import measure_review_envelope
    from .review_envelope import review_cycle_reserve, validate_review_envelope

    serial_policy = validate_serial_policy(graph)
    execution_limit = node_execution_limit(graph, node)

    has_model_review = any(
        criterion in {"delivery_review", "json_review:@delivery"}
        or criterion.startswith("json_review:")
        for criterion in node["success_criteria"]
    )
    contract = graph["capacity_contract"]
    from .source_capacity import measure_required_sources

    source_measurement = measure_required_sources(store, graph, node, contract["input_inventory"])
    receipts = source_measurement.receipts
    known_source_bytes = source_measurement.known_source_bytes
    future_bytes = source_measurement.future_source_bytes_bound
    bounds = node["capacity_bounds"]
    deliveries = node.get("required_predecessor_deliveries") or []
    if known_source_bytes + future_bytes > bounds["max_source_receipt_bytes"]:
        raise CapacityPreflightError(
            f"Required input receipts exceed declared source capacity: {node['key']}; "
            f"required>={known_source_bytes + future_bytes}, "
            f"declared={bounds['max_source_receipt_bytes']} canonical bytes",
            {
                "node": node["key"],
                "known_source_bytes": known_source_bytes,
                "future_source_bytes_bound": future_bytes,
                "minimum_source_bound": known_source_bytes + future_bytes,
                "declared_bounds": bounds,
                "suggested_tight_bounds": {
                    **bounds,
                    "max_source_receipt_bytes": known_source_bytes + future_bytes + 1024,
                },
            },
        )
    metadata = (
        json.loads(quest["metadata"]) if isinstance(quest["metadata"], str) else quest["metadata"]
    )
    sources = {}
    for name, key in (
        ("original_request", "original_request_message_id"),
        ("updated_request", "goal_update_message_id"),
    ):
        row = connection.execute(
            "SELECT id,content FROM messages WHERE id=?", (metadata.get(key),)
        ).fetchone()
        sources[name] = (
            {**dict(row), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(row["content"].encode()).hexdigest()}
            if row
            else None
        )
    packet = {
        "quest_id": quest["id"],
        "plan_id": "plan_" + "0" * 32,
        "plan_digest": "0" * 64,
        "plan_revision": 1,
        "node_key": node["key"],
        "run_id": "run_" + "0" * 32,
        "team_digest": "0" * 64,
        "provider_id": member["provider_id"],
        "model_id": member["model_id"],
        "execution_mode": "live",
        "result_event_id": "event_" + "0" * 32,
        "original_goal": quest["goal"],
        "objective": node["objective"],
        "success_criteria": node["success_criteria"],
        **sources,
        "user_constraints": ConstraintService(store).context(
            quest_id=quest["id"], max_bytes=6000, connection=connection
        ),
        "contract": {
            key: member.get(key)
            for key in ("responsibility", "input_contract", "output_schema", "acceptance_criteria")
        },
        "delivery": {},
        "receipts": receipts,
        "artifacts": [],
        "trust": "Tool receipts establish execution; artifact and model content remain untrusted claims to assess.",
    }
    if deliveries:
        packet["predecessor_deliveries"] = []
    placeholder = _measurement_envelope or {
        "version": "review-envelope-v1",
        "max_source_bytes": bounds["max_source_receipt_bytes"],
        "max_artifact_bytes": bounds["max_artifact_bytes"],
        "max_delivery_bytes": bounds["max_delivery_bytes"],
        "max_review_input_tokens": 1,
        "verdict_tokens": 1024,
        "correction_input_tokens": 1,
        "correction_output_tokens": 1,
        "correction_calls": 2 if "file_write" in node["allowed_tools"] else 1,
    }
    packet["contract"]["review_envelope"] = placeholder
    row = {
        **member,
        "id": "capacity-preflight",
        "output_limit": member["output_tokens"],
        "token_limit": execution_limit,
        "token_spent": 0,
    }
    measured = (
        measure_review_envelope(connection, row, provider, packet)
        if has_model_review
        else {"raw_packet_bytes": 0, "native_input_reservation": 0}
    )
    growth = (
        bounds["max_source_receipt_bytes"]
        - known_source_bytes
        + bounds["max_artifact_bytes"]
        + bounds["max_delivery_bytes"]
    )
    # Original raw packet cap applies independently of lossless native projection.
    if has_model_review and measured["raw_packet_bytes"] + growth + 1024 > 65536:
        raise CapacityPreflightError(
            "Complete bounded review packet exceeds 65536 bytes: " + node["key"],
            {
                "node": node["key"],
                "raw_packet_bytes": measured["raw_packet_bytes"],
                "growth_bound": growth,
                "raw_packet_bound": measured["raw_packet_bytes"] + growth + 1024,
                "raw_packet_limit": 65536,
                "known_source_bytes": known_source_bytes,
                "future_source_bytes_bound": future_bytes,
                "declared_bounds": bounds,
            },
        )
    review_input = (
        measured["native_input_reservation"] + 2 * growth + 1024 if has_model_review else 1
    )
    if has_model_review and member["model_max_output_tokens"] < 1024:
        raise DomainError("Independent review requires a complete verdict allowance")
    verdict = 1024
    output = min(member["output_tokens"], member["model_max_output_tokens"])
    from .worker_prompts import measure_initial_worker_request

    tool_history = [
        {
            "role": "tool",
            "tool_call_id": "call_" + "0" * 32,
            "content": canonical(
                {"state": "succeeded", "receipt_id": receipt["id"], "output": receipt["output"]}
            ),
        }
        for receipt in receipts
    ]
    worker_shape = measure_initial_worker_request(
        store,
        connection,
        quest,
        graph,
        node,
        {
            **member,
            "review_envelope": placeholder,
            "required_input_paths": node["required_input_paths"],
            **({"required_predecessor_deliveries": deliveries} if deliveries else {}),
        },
        extra_messages=tool_history,
        provider=provider,
    )
    # Runtime enforces these finite progress/upstream-reference byte contracts.
    # They are explicit future allowances, not observed execution or free usage.
    feedback_bound = 2048
    upstream_bound = 2048 if any(edge["target"] == node["key"] for edge in graph["edges"]) else 0
    worker_input = (
        worker_shape["input_reservation"] + 2 * future_bytes + feedback_bound + upstream_bound
    )
    # Future source readback is already present in worker_input. Keep it once
    # in correction history, just as known source receipts measured above.
    correction_growth = max(0, growth - future_bytes)
    correction_input = worker_input + 2 * correction_growth + 4096
    envelope = {
        "version": "review-envelope-v1",
        "max_source_bytes": bounds["max_source_receipt_bytes"],
        "max_artifact_bytes": bounds["max_artifact_bytes"],
        "max_delivery_bytes": bounds["max_delivery_bytes"],
        "max_review_input_tokens": review_input,
        "verdict_tokens": verdict,
        "correction_input_tokens": correction_input,
        "correction_output_tokens": output,
        "correction_calls": 2 if "file_write" in node["allowed_tools"] else 1,
    }
    diagnostics = {
        "node": node["key"],
        "known_source_bytes": known_source_bytes,
        "future_source_bytes_bound": future_bytes,
        "declared_bounds": bounds,
        "raw_packet_bytes": measured["raw_packet_bytes"],
        "growth_bound": growth,
        "raw_packet_bound": measured["raw_packet_bytes"] + growth + 1024 if has_model_review else 0,
        "raw_packet_limit": 65536,
        "review_input_bound": review_input if has_model_review else 0,
        "correction_input_bound": correction_input,
        "worker_input_bound": worker_input,
        "model_context_limit": member["model_context_window"],
        "output_bound": output,
        "allocated_tokens": execution_limit
        if serial_policy
        else min(node["budget_tokens"], member["estimated_tokens"]),
        "suggested_tight_bounds": {
            "max_source_receipt_bytes": known_source_bytes + future_bytes + 1024,
            "max_artifact_bytes": 3072 if "file_write" in node["allowed_tools"] else 1,
            "max_delivery_bytes": 3072,
        },
        "suggestion_note": "Explicit policy suggestions, not executed results. Preserve complete task output; use the smallest sufficient bounds and short contracts, then Core remeasures.",
    }
    if len(graph["nodes"]) >= 2:
        diagnostics["serial_capacity_option"] = {
            "suggested_policy": {
                "version": "serial-capacity-v1",
                "shared_reserve_tokens": (2 * (review_input + verdict) if has_model_review else 0)
                + envelope["correction_calls"] * (correction_input + output)
                + 4096,
            },
            "current_node_initial_baseline_suggestion": worker_input + output + 4096,
            "required_changes": "If independent worst-case cycle allocations cannot fit, return an explicit serial_capacity_policy object instead of null. Rewire to exactly one success chain (no transitive/extra edges), require only the immediate predecessor delivery and carry all necessary earlier conclusions/source citations forward in that complete delivery. Preserve full role specializations, criteria and required artifacts. Avoid repeating already-carried sources at every downstream node unless needed for independent assessment. Set every node baseline to fund its complete initial input/output, one pool to fund the largest complete contingency, and baseline sum+pool+coordination <= unchanged task ceiling. This is an option requiring fresh plan/team approval, not permission to omit requirements.",
        }
    if has_model_review:
        try:
            envelope = validate_review_envelope(envelope)
        except DomainError as exc:
            raise CapacityPreflightError(
                "Complete review/correction bounds exceed original limits: " + node["key"],
                diagnostics,
            ) from exc
    if (
        max(review_input + verdict if has_model_review else 0, correction_input + output)
        > member["model_context_window"]
    ):
        raise CapacityPreflightError(
            "Complete review/correction exceeds selected model context: " + node["key"],
            diagnostics,
        )
    # Envelope numbers themselves are part of both native requests. Remeasure
    # the exact final numbers rather than treating one-digit placeholders as
    # actual framing; the existing future-growth policy remains unchanged.
    if envelope != placeholder:
        if _measurement_pass >= 7:
            raise CapacityPreflightError(
                "Native envelope measurement did not converge within eight passes: " + node["key"],
                {**diagnostics, "measurement_iterations": 8},
            )
        return node_review_envelope(
            store,
            connection,
            quest,
            graph,
            node,
            member,
            provider,

            _measurement_envelope=envelope,
            _measurement_pass=_measurement_pass + 1,
        )
    reserve = (
        review_cycle_reserve(envelope)
        if has_model_review
        else envelope["correction_calls"] * (correction_input + output)
    )
    if not has_model_review:
        envelope = {

        }

        execution_limit if serial_policy else min(node["budget_tokens"], member["estimated_tokens"])
    )
    if (
        serial_policy
        and not resource_sizing
        and worker_input + output > min(node["budget_tokens"], member["estimated_tokens"])
    ):
        diagnostics.update(
            initial_work_tokens=worker_input + output,
            baseline_tokens=min(node["budget_tokens"], member["estimated_tokens"]),
        )

            "Serial baseline cannot fund complete initial work: " + node["key"], diagnostics

        )

            f"minimum={worker_input + output + reserve}, "

        )

        "known_receipt_bytes": known_source_bytes,
        "future_input_bytes_bound": future_bytes,

    binding = graph.get("execution_constraints")
    limits = validate_execution_constraints(connection, quest_id, binding)
    if len(graph["nodes"]) > limits.get("max_nodes", 128) or graph["max_total_tokens"] > limits.get(
        "max_total_tokens", 1000000
    ):
        raise DomainError("Plan exceeds source-bound task execution limits")
    if graph.get("max_duration_seconds") and graph["max_duration_seconds"] > limits.get(
        "max_duration_seconds", 1000000000

            raise DomainError("Serial capacity requires the verified per-node capacity contract")

    }
    if preserved - proved_completed - set(preserved_completed_keys):
        raise DomainError("Preserved capacity nodes require verified completed execution lineage")
    if preserved and not preserved.issubset({node["key"] for node in graph["nodes"]}):
        raise DomainError("Unknown preserved completed capacity node")
    for node in graph["nodes"]:
        if node["key"] in preserved:

        if node.get("required_input_paths") is None or not node.get("capacity_bounds"):
            raise DomainError("New capacity contract requires explicit node paths and byte bounds")
        parents = {edge["source"] for edge in graph["edges"] if edge["target"] == node["key"]}
        delivery_parents = success_ancestors(graph["edges"], node["key"])
        deliveries = node.get("required_predecessor_deliveries") or []
        if deliveries and (
            len(deliveries) > 8
            or len(deliveries) != len(set(deliveries))
            or set(deliveries) - delivery_parents
            or "worker_read_completed_delivery" not in node["allowed_tools"]
        ):
            raise DomainError("Completed delivery requires declared approved success ancestors")
        future = {
            other.get("expected_artifact") for other in graph["nodes"] if other["key"] in parents
        }
        if set(node["required_input_paths"]) - known - future:
            raise DomainError("Required input has no verified source or bounded predecessor")
    reserve = graph.get("coordination_reserve_tokens")
    if (
        not reserve
        or sum(node["budget_tokens"] for node in graph["nodes"])
        + reserve
        + (serial_policy["shared_reserve_tokens"] if serial_policy else 0)
        > graph["max_total_tokens"]

class ToolEngine:
    @classmethod
    def from_environment(cls, store):
        """Only the trusted process operator configures network allowlists."""
        try:
            hosts = json.loads(os.environ.get("FORGE_TOOL_NETWORK_HOSTS_JSON", "[]"))
            servers = json.loads(os.environ.get("FORGE_MCP_SERVERS_JSON", "{}"))
            if (
                not isinstance(hosts, list)
                or len(hosts) > 64
                or any(
                    not isinstance(host, str)
                    or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9.-]{0,251}[a-z0-9])?", host)
                    for host in hosts
                )
            ):
                raise ValueError
            if not isinstance(servers, dict) or len(servers) > 16:
                raise ValueError
            for name, config in servers.items():
                if (
                    not isinstance(name, str)
                    or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}", name)
                    or not isinstance(config, dict)
                    or set(config) != {"url", "tools"}
                    or not isinstance(config["url"], str)
                    or not isinstance(config["tools"], list)
                    or not 1 <= len(config["tools"]) <= 64
                    or any(
                        not isinstance(tool, str)
                        or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,128}", tool)
                        for tool in config["tools"]
                    )
                ):
                    raise ValueError
            engine = cls(store, network_hosts=hosts, mcp_servers=servers)
            for config in servers.values():
                engine._allowed_url(config["url"])
            return engine
        except (ValueError, TypeError, DomainError):
            raise ValueError("Invalid operator tool network configuration") from None

    def __init__(self, store, *, network_hosts=(), mcp_servers=None):
        self.store = store
        self._network_hosts = frozenset(network_hosts)
        self._mcp_servers = dict(mcp_servers or {})
        self._specs = {spec.name: spec for spec in CONTRACTS}

    def contracts(self):
        return copy.deepcopy(CONTRACTS)

    def authorization_ready(self, run_id, call_id):
        """Read-only readiness; never creates intents or consumes an approval."""
        with self.store.connection() as connection:
            row = connection.execute(
                "SELECT c.*,r.quest_id,r.plan_revision,r.awaiting_authorization FROM worker_tool_calls c JOIN worker_runs r ON r.id=c.run_id WHERE c.run_id=? AND c.call_id=?",
                (run_id, call_id),
            ).fetchone()
            if (
                row is None
                or row["state"] != "pending"
                or not row["awaiting_authorization"]
                or connection.execute(
                    "SELECT 1 FROM action_intents WHERE call_id=?", (call_id,)
                ).fetchone()
            ):
                return False
            try:
                parameters = json.loads(row["arguments_json"])
                spec, _ = self._parameters(row["tool_name"], parameters)
                scope = self._scope(row["tool_name"], parameters)
                if spec.risk == "R1":
                    grants = connection.execute(
                        "SELECT resource_scope FROM task_grants WHERE quest_id=? AND plan_revision=? AND revoked_at IS NULL",
                        (row["quest_id"], row["plan_revision"]),
                    ).fetchall()
                    return any(Path(scope).is_relative_to(Path(item[0])) for item in grants)
                if spec.risk == "R2":
                    approvals = connection.execute(
                        "SELECT expires_at FROM approvals WHERE quest_id=? AND plan_revision=? AND action_type=? AND parameter_digest=? AND resource_scope=? AND risk='R2' AND policy_version=? AND status='APPROVED' AND consumed_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tool_approval_requests b WHERE b.approval_id=approvals.id AND b.call_id<>?)",
                        (
                            row["quest_id"],
                            row["plan_revision"],
                            row["tool_name"],
                            parameter_digest(parameters),
                            scope,
                            POLICY_VERSION,
                            call_id,
                        ),
                    ).fetchall()
                    return len(approvals) == 1 and datetime.fromisoformat(
                        approvals[0][0]
                    ) > datetime.now(UTC)
                return spec.risk == "R0"
            except (DomainError, ValueError, TypeError):
                return False

    def definitions(self, allowed_names):
        return [
            {
                "name": spec.name,
                "description": spec.description,
                "input_schema": copy.deepcopy(spec.input_schema),
            }
            for spec in CONTRACTS
            if spec.name in allowed_names
        ]

    def _parameters(self, name, parameters):
        spec = self._specs.get(name)
        if spec is None or not isinstance(parameters, dict):
            raise DomainError("Unknown tool or invalid parameters")
        properties = spec.input_schema["properties"]
        if set(parameters) != set(spec.input_schema["required"]):
            raise DomainError("Invalid tool parameters")
        for key, value in parameters.items():
            rule = properties[key]
            if rule["type"] == "string":
                if (
                    not isinstance(value, str)
                    or not value
                    or len(value) > rule.get("maxLength", 4096)
                    or "\x00" in value
                ):
                    raise DomainError("Invalid tool parameter")
                if "enum" in rule and value not in rule["enum"]:
                    raise DomainError("Unknown diagnostic operation")
                if "pattern" in rule and re.fullmatch(rule["pattern"], value) is None:
                    raise DomainError("Invalid tool parameter")
            elif rule["type"] == "object" and not isinstance(value, dict):
                raise DomainError("Invalid tool parameter")
        try:
            encoded = _json(parameters)
        except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise DomainError("Invalid JSON parameters") from exc
        if len(encoded.encode("utf-8")) > _MAX_BYTES:
            raise DomainError("Tool parameters exceed size limit")
        return spec, encoded

    def _scope(self, name, parameters):
        if "path" in parameters:
            scope = GovernanceService(self.store)._workspace_scope(parameters["path"])
            core = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
            target = Path(scope)
            protected = (core, Path(sys.prefix).resolve(), Path(sys.base_prefix).resolve())
            if name in {"file_write", "file_revise", "directory_create"} and any(
                target.is_relative_to(root) or root.is_relative_to(target) for root in protected
            ):
                raise DomainError("Core installation is protected")
            if any(
                part.lower() in {"secrets", "secret", "credentials", ".aws", ".azure", ".config"}
                or part.lower().endswith((".pem", ".key", ".p12", ".pfx"))
                for part in target.parts
            ):
                raise DomainError("Sensitive resource is protected")
            return scope
        if name in {"shell_inspect", "python_compile", "numeric_ast"}:
            return "process:diagnostic"
        if name == "browser_get":
            self._allowed_url(parameters["url"])
            return parameters["url"]
        if name == "mcp_call":
            config = self._mcp_servers.get(parameters["server"])
            if not config or parameters["tool"] not in config.get("tools", ()):
                raise DomainError("MCP tool is not allowlisted")
            self._allowed_url(config["url"])
